function saveBl1ndConfig()
  if not canSaveConfig then return end
  pcall(function()
    _Bl1nd_writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(collectBl1ndConfig()))
    _Bl1nd_writefile(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(collectBl1ndKeybindConfig()))
  end)
end

-- ========== STRETCH REZ (GLOBALE) ==========
local stretchPresets = {
    ["0.8"] = CFrame.new(0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,0.45,0, 0,0,1),
    ["1.0"] = CFrame.new(0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,0.65,0, 0,0,1),
    ["1.2"] = CFrame.new(0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,0.82,0, 0,0,1),
}
local stretchPresetMapping = {
    ["X1"]   = nil,
    ["X1.5"] = "1.2",
    ["X2"]   = "1.0",
    ["X3"]   = "0.8",
}
local stretchPresetOrder = {"X1", "X1.5", "X2", "X3"}
stretchCurrentIndex = 1          -- reso globale (non local)
stretchEnabled = false           -- reso globale
currentStretch = nil
stretchRezConn = nil

local function applyStretchPreset(index)
    -- Se il tracker è attivo, non siamo in fase di forzatura (lock) e l'utente sceglie un valore diverso da X1,
    -- aggiorna l'indice salvato in modo che il salvataggio usi quello.
    if not _G._Bl1ndDuelstretchUILock and _G.Bl1ndTrackerActive then
        _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex = index
    end

    stretchCurrentIndex = index
    local label = stretchPresetOrder[index]
    local key = stretchPresetMapping[label]
    if key then
        currentStretch = stretchPresets[key]
        stretchEnabled = true
    else
        currentStretch = nil
        stretchEnabled = false
    end
    if stretchRezConn then stretchRezConn:Disconnect(); stretchRezConn = nil end
    if stretchEnabled then
        stretchRezConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not stretchEnabled or not currentStretch then
                if stretchRezConn then stretchRezConn:Disconnect(); stretchRezConn = nil end
                return
            end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and currentStretch then
                cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * currentStretch
            end
        end)
    end
    if not _G._Bl1ndDuelstretchUILock and _G.Bl1ndRefreshStretchSelector then
        _G.Bl1ndRefreshStretchSelector()
    end
end

local function cycleStretch(direction)
    local newIdx = stretchCurrentIndex + direction
    if newIdx < 1 then newIdx = #stretchPresetOrder end
    if newIdx > #stretchPresetOrder then newIdx = 1 end
    applyStretchPreset(newIdx)
end

local function setStretchEnabled(on)
    if on then
        applyStretchPreset(stretchCurrentIndex == 1 and 2 or stretchCurrentIndex)
    else
        applyStretchPreset(1)
    end
end

-- Esponiamo le funzioni per usarle nella UI
_G.StretchRez = {
    apply = applyStretchPreset,
    cycle = cycleStretch,
    setEnabled = setStretchEnabled,
    getIndex = function() return stretchCurrentIndex end,
    isEnabled = function() return stretchEnabled end,
    getOrder = function() return stretchPresetOrder end,
}

function loadBl1ndConfig()
  if not canSaveConfig or not _Bl1nd_isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then return end
  local ok, data = pcall(function()
    return HttpService:JSONDecode(_Bl1nd_readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
  end)
  if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
  savedConfig = data
  local keybindData = data
  pcall(function()
    if _Bl1nd_isfile(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE) then
      local kb = HttpService:JSONDecode(_Bl1nd_readfile(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE))
      if type(kb) == "table" then keybindData = kb end
    end
  end)
  savedMainPositionTable = data.mainPosition
  savedMiniPositionTable = nil
  savedStealBarPositionTable = type(data.stealBarPosition) == "table" and data.stealBarPosition or nil
  _G.Bl1ndGuiLocked = data.guiLocked == true
  _G.Bl1ndMobileLocked = data.mobileButtonsLocked == true
  _G.Bl1ndStealBarLocked = data.stealBarLocked == true
  _G.Bl1ndHideMobileButtons = data.hideMobileButtons == true
  _G.Bl1ndMobileHideList = (type(data.mobileHideList) == "table") and data.mobileHideList or {}
  _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale = math.clamp(tonumber(data.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale) or tonumber(_G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale) or 0.75, 0.30, 1.35)
  _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonPositions = type(data.mobileButtonPositions) == "table" and data.mobileButtonPositions or {}
  applySavedKeybinds(keybindData.keybinds)
  if keybindData.tpDownKeybind ~= nil then
    if tostring(keybindData.tpDownKeybind) == "None" then
      tpDownKeybind = nil
    else
      tpDownKeybind = stringToKeyCode(keybindData.tpDownKeybind) or DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND
    end
  end
  for keyId, defaultKey in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    local savedKeys = keybindData and keybindData.keybinds
    if (not savedKeys or savedKeys[keyId] == nil) and speedKeybinds[keyId] == nil then
      speedKeybinds[keyId] = defaultKey
    end
  end
  NS = tonumber(data.NS) or NS
  CS = tonumber(data.CS) or CS
  LAGGER_SPEED = tonumber(data.LAGGER_SPEED) or LAGGER_SPEED
  LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED = tonumber(data.LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) or LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED
  currentSpeedMode = data.currentSpeedMode or currentSpeedMode
  if currentSpeedMode ~= "Normal" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Carry" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger Carry" then currentSpeedMode = "Normal" end
  autoCarrySpeedEnabled = data.autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true
  _G._Bl1ndAutoCarryMode = (data.autoCarryMode == "SOFT") and "SOFT" or "NORMAL"
  autoTPEnabled = data.autoTPEnabled == true
  autoTPHeight = tonumber(data.autoTPHeight) or autoTPHeight
  -- >>> TP DOWN METHOD <<<
  local _tpm = data.tpDownMethod
  _G._Bl1ndTPDownMethod = (_tpm == "SLOW" or _tpm == "ZIGZAG") and _tpm or "NORMAL"
  infJumpEnabled = data.infJumpEnabled == true
  if data.infJumpMode == "MANUAL" then infJumpMode = "MANUAL" else infJumpMode = "HOLD" end
  _G.Bl1ndLookAtEnabled = data.lookAtEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadius  = math.clamp(tonumber(data.lookAtRadius) or 20, 1, 200)
  antiRagdollEnabled = data.antiRagdollEnabled == true
  _G._Bl1ndAntiRagdollMode = (data.antiRagdollMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
  -- >>> TP RAGDOLL <<< il watcher va acceso o spento davvero, non basta
  -- il flag: e' lui che guarda lo stato del personaggio.
  if _G.Bl1ndTPRagdoll and _G.Bl1ndTPRagdoll.set then
    pcall(_G.Bl1ndTPRagdoll.set, data.tpRagdollEnabled == true)
  else
    _G.Bl1ndTPRagdollEnabled = data.tpRagdollEnabled == true
  end
  antiDieEnabled = data.antiDieEnabled == true
  _G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted = antiDieEnabled
  selectedDropMode = data.selectedDropMode or selectedDropMode
  _G.Bl1ndInstantResetVersion = math.clamp(tonumber(data.instantResetVersion) or 1, 1, 2)
  if _G.Bl1ndAfterDrop then
    _G.Bl1ndAfterDrop.enabled = data.afterDropEnabled == true
    _G.Bl1ndAfterDrop.action  = (data.afterDropAction == "TPBAT") and "TPBAT" or "AIMBOT"
  end
  if selectedDropMode ~= "Stand Still" then selectedDropMode = "TP UP" end
  selectedStealMode = data.selectedStealMode or selectedStealMode
  if selectedStealMode ~= "Semi" then selectedStealMode = "Normal" end
  _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled = data.radiusCircleEnabled == true   -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE <<<
  if type(data.radiusCircleColor) == "table" then
    _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleColor = Color3.fromRGB(
      math.clamp(tonumber(data.radiusCircleColor[1]) or 230, 0, 255),
      math.clamp(tonumber(data.radiusCircleColor[2]) or 230, 0, 255),
      math.clamp(tonumber(data.radiusCircleColor[3]) or 230, 0, 255)
    )
  end
  selectedSemiMode = data.selectedSemiMode or selectedSemiMode
  if selectedSemiMode ~= "V2" and selectedSemiMode ~= "V3" then selectedSemiMode = "V1" end
  _G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersion = (data.normalStealVersion == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
  autoStealEnabled = data.autoStealEnabled == true
  _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled = data.syncAfterHitEnabled == true
  if type(data.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii) == "table" then
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal = tonumber(data.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal) or _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal or 62
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi = tonumber(data.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi) or _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi or 60
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius = tonumber(data.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius) or _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius = tonumber(data.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius or 8
  end
  -- Fix: aggiorna il corretto slot di StealRadii in base al modo selezionato
  local _loadedRadius = tonumber(data.autoStealRadius) or autoStealRadius
  if not (type(data.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii) == "table") then
    -- Config vecchio senza Bl1ndDuelstealRadii: usa autoStealRadius per il modo corretto
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi = _loadedRadius
    else
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal = _loadedRadius
    end
  end
  autoStealRadius = _loadedRadius
  -- Ripristina valori semi steal
  -- (Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal non è ancora inizializzato qui, li salviamo in pending)
  _G._Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending = {
    autoGrabStopTime       = math.clamp(tonumber(data.semiAutoGrabStopTime) or 1.29, 0.01, 1.29),
    autoGrabStopPercent    = math.clamp(tonumber(data.semiAutoGrabStopPercent) or 75, 1, 100),
    autoGrabSetDelayRadius = tonumber(data.semiAutoGrabDelayRadius) or 8,
  }
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal then
    local A = _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal
    A.autoGrabStopTime       = _G._Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending.autoGrabStopTime
    A.autoGrabStopPercent    = _G._Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending.autoGrabStopPercent
    A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = _G._Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending.autoGrabSetDelayRadius
    A.autoGrabStopEnabled    = true
  end
  -- Applica i radii SemiV2 all'engine se già inizializzato
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2Steal then
    local B = _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2Steal
    B.radius     = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius     or B.radius     or 60
    B.semiRadius = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius or B.semiRadius or 8
  end
  if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal or autoStealRadius or 62
    autoStealRadius = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal
  elseif selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
    -- In Semi V2 autoStealRadius non viene usato per il radius del loop; usa SemiV2Radius
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60
    autoStealRadius = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius
  else
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi or autoStealRadius or 60
    autoStealRadius = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi
  end
  selectedAimbotMode = data.selectedAimbotMode or selectedAimbotMode
  -- compatibilita' con le config salvate prima della rinomina in Bat Aimbot V1/V2
  if selectedAimbotMode == "Anti Bypass" or selectedAimbotMode == "Bypass" then
    selectedAimbotMode = "V2"
  elseif selectedAimbotMode ~= "V2" then
    selectedAimbotMode = "V1"
  end
  AIMBOT_SPEED = tonumber(data.AIMBOT_SPEED) or AIMBOT_SPEED
  LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED = tonumber(data.LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED
  local _v2Spd = data.BAT_AIMBOT_V2_SPEED or data.ANTI_BYPASS_AIMBOT_SPEED
  local _v2Lag = data.BAT_AIMBOT_V2_LAGGER_SPEED or data.ANTI_BYPASS_LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Speed = tonumber(_v2Spd) or _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Speed or 58
  if _v2Lag == nil or tonumber(_v2Lag) == 58 then
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed = 40
  else
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed = tonumber(_v2Lag) or 40
  end
  TP_BAT_SPEED = tonumber(data.TP_BAT_SPEED) or TP_BAT_SPEED or 58
  autoSwingEnabled = data.autoSwingEnabled == true
  mirrorTPDownEnabled = data.mirrorTPDownEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn = data.normalAimbotEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = (data.batAimbotV2Enabled == true) or (data.antiBypassAimbotEnabled == true)
  -- >>> AIMBOT CHASE MODE BEGIN
  _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase = _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase or { V1 = "NORMAL", V2 = "NORMAL" }
  _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase.V1 = (data.aimbotChaseV1 == "BYPASS") and "BYPASS" or "NORMAL"
  _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase.V2 = (data.aimbotChaseV2 == "BYPASS") and "BYPASS" or "NORMAL"
  -- <<< AIMBOT CHASE MODE END
  tpBatAutoSwingEnabled = data.tpBatAutoSwingEnabled == true
  -- Il do-block TP Bat viene eseguito DOPO loadBl1ndConfig, quindi il bridge
  -- _G._Bl1ndDuelsetTPBatCameraLock non esiste ancora qui. Usiamo un pending value
  -- (stesso pattern di _Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending) che il do-block consuma all'avvio.
  if _G._Bl1ndDuelsetTPBatCameraLock then
    _G._Bl1ndDuelsetTPBatCameraLock(data.tpBatCameraLockEnabled == true)
  else
    _G._Bl1ndTPBatCameraLockPending = data.tpBatCameraLockEnabled == true
  end
  _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn = data.tpBatEnabled == true
  -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS <<<
  _G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion = math.clamp(tonumber(data.tpBatVersion) or 1, 1, 5)
  batCounterEnabled = data.batCounterEnabled == true
  if data.batCounterMode == "V2" then batCounterMode = "V2" else batCounterMode = "V1" end
  medCounterEnabled = data.medCounterEnabled == true

  _G.Bl1ndAntiBatEnabled          = data.antiBatEnabled == true   -- >>> ANTI BAT <<<

  antiKickEnabled = data.safeMode == true
  espEnabled = data.espEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndESPOn = espEnabled   -- >>> ANTI VOID <<<
  showTrackerEnabled = data.showTrackerEnabled == true
  ragdollCountdownEnabled = data.ragdollCountdownEnabled == true
  fpsBoostEnabled = data.fpsBoostEnabled == true
  antiLagVisualEnabled = data.antiLagVisualEnabled == true
  vividGraphicsEnabled = data.vividGraphicsEnabled == true
  if data.vividSaturation then _G._Bl1ndVivid.saturation = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividSaturation) or 0.6, 0, 2) end
  if data.vividBloomIntensity then _G._Bl1ndVivid.bloomIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividBloomIntensity) or 0.8, 0, 3) end
  if data.vividBloomSize then _G._Bl1ndVivid.bloomSize = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividBloomSize) or 24, 1, 56) end
  if data.vividDofFocus then _G._Bl1ndVivid.dofFocus = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividDofFocus) or 25, 1, 100) end
  if data.vividSunIntensity then _G._Bl1ndVivid.sunIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividSunIntensity) or 0.2, 0, 1) end
  xrayEnabled = data.xrayEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndBrainrotXRayEnabled = data.brainrotXRayEnabled == true   -- >>> BRAINROT X-RAY <<<
  highPingWarningEnabled = data.highPingWarningEnabled == true
  _G._Bl1ndKickWarn.enabled = data.kickWarningEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndUAKEnabled = data.ultimateAntiKick == true
  fovEnabled = data.fovEnabled == true
  fovValue = tonumber(data.fovValue) or fovValue
  noCamCollisionEnabled = data.noCamCollisionEnabled == true
  motionBlurEnabled = data.motionBlurEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = data.noPlayerCollisionEnabled == true
  unwalkEnabled = data.unwalkEnabled == true
  skyTheme = (type(data.skyTheme) == "string" and data.skyTheme) or skyTheme
  -- Migrazione: vecchio preset "Tech" rinominato in "Cyber"
  if skyTheme == "Tech" then skyTheme = "Cyber" end
    -- Stretch Rez state
  do
      local savedIdx = data.stretchCurrentIndex and math.max(1, math.min(data.stretchCurrentIndex, #stretchPresetOrder)) or 1
      local savedOn  = data.stretchEnabled == true
      -- >>> STRETCH REZ <<< il valore scelto nella tendina: X1 non e' una
      -- scelta possibile, quindi si ricade su X1.5.
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstretchPick = (savedIdx > 1) and savedIdx or 2
      -- Ripristina l'indice e lo stato (X1 = off, qualsiasi altro = on)
      if savedOn and savedIdx ~= 1 then
          applyStretchPreset(savedIdx)
      else
          stretchCurrentIndex = savedIdx
          stretchEnabled = false
      end
  end
  autoLeftEnabled = false
  autoRightEnabled = false
  -- >>> AUTO PLAY <<< si mette da parte quello che era stato salvato; a
  -- decidere se vale ancora (posto giusto, stesso server) ci pensa
  -- restore(), che e' dove sta tutta la regola.
  _G._AmbAutoPlaySavedJob  = (type(data.autoPlayJob) == "string" and data.autoPlayJob ~= "") and data.autoPlayJob or nil
  _G._AmbAutoPlaySavedSide = (data.autoPlaySide == "L" or data.autoPlaySide == "R") and data.autoPlaySide or nil
  if _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay and _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay.restore then
    pcall(_G.Bl1ndAutoPlay.restore)
  end
  headlessEnabled = data.headlessEnabled == true
  korbloxEnabled = data.korbloxEnabled == true

  -- >>> ANTI TP BAT <<<
  _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatEnabled        = data.antiTPBatEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatSpam           = data.antiTPBatSpam == true
  _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatVersion        = math.clamp(tonumber(data.antiTPBatVersion) or 1, 1, 4)
  _G.Bl1ndAntiVoidEnabled         = data.antiVoidEnabled == true   -- >>> ANTI VOID <<<
  -- >>> RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK BEGIN
  -- Qui si legge soltanto: il modulo non esiste ancora a questo punto del
  -- file, l'avvio avviene subito dopo la sua definizione.
  _G.Bl1ndRainbowJoystickEnabled  = data.rainbowJoystickEnabled == true
  -- <<< RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK END
  _G.Bl1ndRainbowToolsEnabled     = data.rainbowToolsEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndTransparentToolsEnabled = data.transparentToolsEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndCustomToolsEnabled      = data.customToolsEnabled == true
  _G.Bl1ndCustomToolSkins = _G.Bl1ndCustomToolSkins or {}
  _G.Bl1ndCustomToolSkins.Bat    = data.customToolSkinBat or "DiamondSword"
  _G.Bl1ndCustomToolSkins.Medusa = data.customToolSkinMedusa or "GoldenDesertEagle"
  _G.Bl1ndCustomSoundsEnabled     = data.customSoundsEnabled == true

  if type(data.avatarChanger) == "table" then
    -- _G._Bl1ndAvatarChanger non esiste ancora (viene creato dopo),
    -- salviamo i dati in pending e li applichiamo all'inizializzazione del blocco
    _G._Bl1ndAvatarChangerPending = data.avatarChanger
  end
  selectedAnimPackIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.selectedAnimPackIndex) or 1, 1, 7)
  _animPackSavedIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.animPackSavedIndex) or 1, 1, 7)
  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  if type(data.customAnimIds) == "table" then
    for _, slot in ipairs(_G.Bl1ndCustomAnimSlots) do
      local v = data.customAnimIds[slot]
      -- Solo cifre: qualsiasi altra cosa e' spazzatura e va scartata.
      _G.Bl1ndCustomAnimIds[slot] =
        (type(v) == "string" and v:match("^%d+$")) and v or ""
    end
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END
  if data.introEnabled ~= nil then _introEnabled = data.introEnabled == true end
  if data.selectedIntroMusic and INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[data.selectedIntroMusic] then selectedIntroMusic = data.selectedIntroMusic end
  if data.musicSelectedSong and MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS and MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[data.musicSelectedSong] then selectedMusicSong = data.musicSelectedSong end
  if data.musicVolume ~= nil then musicPlayerVolume = math.clamp(tonumber(data.musicVolume) or 1, 0, 2) end
  if data.musicSpeed ~= nil then musicPlayerSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(data.musicSpeed) or 1, 0.1, 2) end
  if data.musicAutoPlayNext ~= nil then musicAutoPlayNext = data.musicAutoPlayNext == true end
  if data.musicShuffleEnabled ~= nil then musicShuffleEnabled = data.musicShuffleEnabled == true end
  if data.musicLoopEnabled ~= nil then musicLoopEnabled = data.musicLoopEnabled == true end
  if autoLeftEnabled and autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled = false end
  if data.trackerColor then
    BoxedESPOptions = BoxedESPOptions or {}
    if typeof(data.trackerColor) == "Color3" then
      BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = data.trackerColor
    elseif type(data.trackerColor) == "table" then
      local r = tonumber(data.trackerColor.r) or tonumber(data.trackerColor.R) or 230
      local g = tonumber(data.trackerColor.g) or tonumber(data.trackerColor.G) or 230
      local b = tonumber(data.trackerColor.b) or tonumber(data.trackerColor.B) or 230
      BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
    end
  end
end

loadBl1ndConfig()


_G.Bl1ndCounterState = _G.Bl1ndCounterState or {}
_G.Bl1ndCounterState.batConn = nil
_G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = false
_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns = _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns or {}
_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medDebounce = false
_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medLastUsed = _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medLastUsed or 0
_G.Bl1ndMedusaCooldown = 25

function _G.Bl1ndFindMedusa()
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return nil end
  for _, t in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if t:IsA("Tool") then
      local n = t.Name:lower()
      if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
    end
  end
  local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
  if bp then
    for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
      if t:IsA("Tool") then
        local n = t.Name:lower()
        if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function _G.Bl1ndUseMedusaCounter()
  if not medCounterEnabled then return end
  if _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medDebounce then return end
  if tick() - (_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medLastUsed or 0) < _G.Bl1ndMedusaCooldown then return end
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return end
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medDebounce = true
  local med = _G.Bl1ndFindMedusa()
  if not med then
    _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medDebounce = false
    return
  end
  if med.Parent ~= c then
    local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(med) end) end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
  pcall(function() med:Activate() end)
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medLastUsed = tick()
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medDebounce = false
end

function _G.Bl1ndOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part)
  return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
    if part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then
      if medCounterEnabled then
        _G.Bl1ndUseMedusaCounter()
      end
    end
  end)
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter(char)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter()
  char = char or LP.Character
  if not char then return end
  for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
      table.insert(_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns, _G.Bl1ndOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part))
    end
  end
  table.insert(_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
      table.insert(_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns, _G.Bl1ndOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part))
    end
  end))
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter()
  for _, c in pairs(_G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns or {}) do
    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
  end
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medConns = {}
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.medDebounce = false
end

-- true SOLO durante la finestra di counter del Bat Counter V2:
-- fa ignorare al TP Bat la distanza minima di snap (come il Bat Aimbot V2)
_G.Bl1ndBatCounterV2On = false

_G.Bl1ndBatCounterSlapList = {"Bat", "Slap", "Iron Slap", "Gold Slap", "Diamond Slap", "Emerald Slap", "Ruby Slap", "Dark Matter Slap", "Flame Slap", "Nuclear Slap", "Galaxy Slap", "Glitched Slap"}

function _G.Bl1ndFindBatForCounter()
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return nil end
  local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
  for _, name in ipairs(_G.Bl1ndBatCounterSlapList) do
    local t = c:FindFirstChild(name) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name))
    if t then return t end
  end
  for _, ch in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if ch:IsA("Tool") and ch.Name:lower():find("bat") then return ch end
  end
  if bp then
    for _, ch in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
      if ch:IsA("Tool") and ch.Name:lower():find("bat") then return ch end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelswingBatForCounter(bat, char)
  if not bat or not char then return end
  local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if bat.Parent ~= char then
    if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
  local remote = bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteEvent") or bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteFunction")
  if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
    task.wait(0.15)
    pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
  else
    pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
    task.wait(0.15)
    pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
  end
end

function _G.Bl1ndCounterIsRagdoll(hum)
  if not hum then return false end
  local st = hum:GetState()
  return st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    or hum.PlatformStand == true
end

-- Versione usata dal bat counter: esclude FallingDown (piccoli bump non devono triggerare)
function _G.Bl1ndCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum)
  if not hum then return false end
  local st = hum:GetState()
  return st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    or hum.PlatformStand == true
end

-- ============================================================
-- BAT COUNTER V2: LOCK RAGDOLL NEMICO
-- Watcher identico a quello del Ragdoll Countdown nemico
-- (DescendantAdded -> BallSocketConstraint), ma indipendente:
-- funziona anche col Ragdoll Countdown spento.
-- Quando il nemico viene ragdollato parte un lock di 2.6s.
-- Se durante quei 2.6s veniamo ragdollati, il Bat Counter V2
-- IGNORA l'evento e non parte (nessuna attesa, si salta e basta).
-- Il lock e' a TEMPO, non sullo stato: se il watcher non vede nulla
-- il counter parte normalmente.
-- ============================================================
_G.Bl1ndBatCounterRagdollSeconds = _G.Bl1ndBatCounterRagdollSeconds or 2.6
_G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock = _G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock or {}
_G.Bl1ndBatCounterWatchConns = _G.Bl1ndBatCounterWatchConns or {}

function _G.Bl1ndBCMarkEnemyRagdoll(plr)
  if not plr or plr == LP then return end
  local secs = tonumber(_G.Bl1ndBatCounterRagdollSeconds) or 2.6
  _G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock[plr] = tick() + secs
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounterWatcher()
  local conns = _G.Bl1ndBatCounterWatchConns
  for k, c in pairs(conns) do
    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    conns[k] = nil
  end
  for k in pairs(_G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock) do
    _G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock[k] = nil
  end
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounterWatcher()
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounterWatcher()
  local conns = _G.Bl1ndBatCounterWatchConns

  local function hookChar(plr, char)
    if not char then return end
    local key = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_char"
    if conns[key] then pcall(function() conns[key]:Disconnect() end) end
    conns[key] = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
        _G.Bl1ndBCMarkEnemyRagdoll(plr)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function watchPlayer(plr)
    if plr == LP then return end
    local key = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_added"
    if conns[key] then pcall(function() conns[key]:Disconnect() end) end
    conns[key] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      hookChar(plr, char)
    end)
    if plr.Character then hookChar(plr, plr.Character) end
  end

  conns["_playerAdded"] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
  conns["_playerRemoving"] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    _G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock[plr] = nil
    local ka = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_added"
    local kc = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_char"
    if conns[ka] then pcall(function() conns[ka]:Disconnect() end) conns[ka] = nil end
    if conns[kc] then pcall(function() conns[kc]:Disconnect() end) conns[kc] = nil end
  end)

  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(plr)
  end
end

-- Giocatore piu' vicino a noi (vivo), senza limiti di distanza
function _G.Bl1ndGetNearestEnemy()
  local char = LP.Character
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not hrp then return nil end
  local myPos = hrp.Position
  local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP then
      local ec = plr.Character
      local ehrp = ec and ec:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local ehum = ec and ec:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if ehrp and ehum and ehum.Health > 0 then
        local d = (ehrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
        if d < bestDist then
          bestDist = d
          best = plr
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

-- true se il nemico piu' vicino e' stato ragdollato da meno di 2.6s
function _G.Bl1ndIsNearestEnemyRagdolled()
  local plr = _G.Bl1ndGetNearestEnemy()
  if not plr then return false end
  local lockUntil = _G.Bl1ndBatCounterEnemyLock[plr]
  return lockUntil ~= nil and lockUntil > tick()
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter()
  if _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batConn then return end
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = false
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounterWatcher then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounterWatcher) end
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not batCounterEnabled then return end
    if _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    -- Morto, o Instant Reset in corso: il ragdoll che si vede in questi due
    -- casi non e' un colpo preso, e' il nostro stesso reset (o la morte).
    -- Di regola il counter risponde a un hit, quindi qui non deve partire.
    -- Vale per V1 e V2: passano tutte e due da questo punto.
    if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    if _G._Bl1ndInstantResetBusy then return end
    if _G.Bl1ndCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum) then
      _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = true
      -- ANTI DIE QUI, non dentro il task.spawn piu' sotto. Li' arrivava
      -- 0.05s dopo, e questo ramo parte proprio perche' sei GIA' a terra
      -- ragdollato: 0.05s in quella situazione sono un'eternita'. Ora la
      -- protezione sale nello stesso frame in cui il ragdoll viene visto,
      -- prima di qualunque attesa, teletrasporto o swing.
      if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow) end
      if batCounterMode == "V2" then
        -- Se il nemico e' dentro il lock di 2.6s il counter NON parte e questo
        -- hit viene SALTATO del tutto (niente attesa, niente ricontrollo):
        -- il debounce si riapre solo quando usciamo dal nostro ragdoll,
        -- cosi' e' pronto per la volta successiva.
        if _G.Bl1ndIsNearestEnemyRagdolled then
          local okRag, enemyRag = pcall(_G.Bl1ndIsNearestEnemyRagdolled)
          if okRag and enemyRag then
            task.spawn(function()
              local t0 = tick()
              while tick() - t0 < 10 do
                local c2 = LP.Character
                local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h2 or not _G.Bl1ndCounterIsRagdollForBat(h2) then break end
                task.wait(0.1)
              end
              task.wait(0.2)
              _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = false
            end)
            return
          end
        end
        -- V2: salva CFrame, avvia tp bat in parallelo, dopo 0.4s ferma e ritorna
        task.spawn(function()
          task.wait(0.05)
          local wasTPBatOn = _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn == true
          local hrpNow = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local savedCF = hrpNow and hrpNow.CFrame or nil
          -- tp bat parte. Il flag dice al TP Bat di ignorare la distanza minima
          -- di 8 stud, esattamente come fa il Bat Aimbot V2.
          _G.Bl1ndBatCounterV2On = true
          if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync then _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync() end
          if not wasTPBatOn then
            _G.Bl1ndTPBatSilent = true
            if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat) end
            if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
          end
          local bat = _G.Bl1ndFindBatForCounter()
          if bat then task.spawn(function() _G.Bl1ndDuelswingBatForCounter(bat, char) end) end

          -- SNAP PROPRIO DEL COUNTER (non dipende dal loop del TP Bat).
          -- Il loop del TP Bat puo' non partire (Safe Mode), essere bloccato
          -- dall'Anti-Void o venire spento dal suo watcher ragdoll appena il
          -- nemico va a terra: in tutti quei casi lo snap non avveniva.
          -- Qui teletrasportiamo noi, ogni frame, senza nessuna soglia di
          -- distanza, esattamente come la fase 2 del Bat Aimbot V2.
          local snapConn
          snapConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local c2 = LP.Character
            local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not h2 or not hum2 or hum2.Health <= 0 then return end
            local t2 = _G.Bl1ndGetNearestEnemy and _G.Bl1ndGetNearestEnemy() or nil
            local tc2 = t2 and t2.Character
            local tr2 = tc2 and tc2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not tr2 then return end
            -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
            -- Se il nemico si e' tpato nel void si va sul punto d'origine,
            -- altrimenti lo snap ci porterebbe fuori mappa dietro di lui.
            local _bcPos = tr2.Position
            if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
              _bcPos = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posForPart(tr2, _bcPos)
            end
            -- <<< ANTI VOID END
            pcall(function()
              h2.CFrame = CFrame.new(_bcPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
              h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
              h2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
          end)

          task.wait(0.4)
          if snapConn then pcall(function() snapConn:Disconnect() end) snapConn = nil end
          _G.Bl1ndBatCounterV2On = false
          if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync then _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync() end
          if not wasTPBatOn then
            if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat) end
            _G.Bl1ndTPBatSilent = false
            if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
          end
          if savedCF then
            local hrpBack = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrpBack then
              pcall(function()
                hrpBack.CFrame = savedCF
                hrpBack.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
              end)
            end
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
          _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = false
        end)
      else
        -- V1: look at + bat partono insieme, dopo 0.7s si ripristina look at
        task.spawn(function()
          local wasLookAtEnabled = _G.Bl1ndLookAtEnabled
          local savedRadius = _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadius
          _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadius = math.huge
          -- look at e bat partono insieme
          if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt) end
          local bat = _G.Bl1ndFindBatForCounter()
          if bat then task.spawn(function() _G.Bl1ndDuelswingBatForCounter(bat, char) end) end
          task.wait(0.7)
          _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadius = savedRadius
          if wasLookAtEnabled then
            if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt) end
          else
            if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopLookAt then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstopLookAt) end
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
          _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = false
        end)
      end
    end
  end)
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounter()
  if _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batConn then
    _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batConn:Disconnect()
    _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batConn = nil
  end
  _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce = false
  _G.Bl1ndBatCounterV2On = false
  -- Il watcher dei ragdoll nemici serve anche al TP Ragdoll: se e' acceso
  -- lui, si lascia in piedi invece di spegnerlo insieme al Bat Counter.
  if not _G.Bl1ndTPRagdollEnabled then
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounterWatcher then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounterWatcher) end
  end
end

startBatCounter = _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter
stopBatCounter = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounter
setupMedusaCounter = _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter
stopMedusaCounter = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter

-- ============================================================
-- NO PLAYER COLLISION v3 (event-driven)
-- Sostituisce il vecchio blocco a polling. Differenze:
--   1. ZERO loop. Ogni BasePart e' registrata una volta con
--      GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"): se qualcosa la riaccende
--      torna a false nello STESSO frame, non dopo 0.2s.
--   2. DescendantAdded sul character: accessori, tool equipaggiati e
--      arti che arrivano tardi al respawn vengono presi subito.
--   3. Copre anche l'assembly esterna (brainrot trasportato, hitbox
--      weldate ma parented in workspace), che prima era ignorata.
--   4. Spegne anche le TUE parti: sono le uniche di cui hai il network
--      ownership, quindi replicano davvero sul client dell'altro.
--   5. Ref-count: TP Bat e toggle utente possono tenerla accesa insieme
--      senza pestarsi i piedi (Bl1ndNoCollisionAcquire/Release).
-- Tutto dentro un do-end: non consuma slot locals nel main chunk.
-- ============================================================
_G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionState = _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionState or {}

do
  local NPC = _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionState
  NPC.connections = NPC.connections or {}
  NPC.parts       = NPC.parts or {}       -- part -> {conn, destroy, cc, ct}
  NPC.charConns   = NPC.charConns or {}   -- character -> {conns}
  NPC.holders     = NPC.holders or {}     -- tag -> true
  NPC.running     = NPC.running or false

  -- Parti del corpo R6 + R15
  local BODY = {
    HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
    ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true,
    LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
    RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
    LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true,
    RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true,
  }

  local function isOn() return NPC.running == true end

  -- Rete di sicurezza per le scritture interne del motore che non emettono
  -- GetPropertyChangedSignal. Passa su tutti i giocatori, ma UNA VOLTA AL
  -- SECONDO, non ad ogni frame come faceva il vecchio TP Bat.
  -- Abbassalo a 0.25 se vedi ancora micro-spinte entrando nei nemici;
  -- mettilo a 0 per restare puramente event-driven.
  local SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL = 1

  -- ---------- registro parti ----------
  local function lockPart(part, killTouch)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if NPC.parts[part] then return end

    local e = {cc = part.CanCollide, ct = part.CanTouch}
    NPC.parts[part] = e

    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
    if killTouch then pcall(function() part.CanTouch = false end) end

    -- Cuore del fix: reazione immediata, non ogni 0.2s.
    e.conn = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      if part.CanCollide then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end) end
    end)

    e.destroy = part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      if part:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
      if e.conn then pcall(function() e.conn:Disconnect() end) end
      if e.destroy then pcall(function() e.destroy:Disconnect() end) end
      NPC.parts[part] = nil
    end)
  end

  local function unlockPart(part)
    local e = NPC.parts[part]
    if not e then return end
    if e.conn then pcall(function() e.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    if e.destroy then pcall(function() e.destroy:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.parts[part] = nil
    if part and part.Parent then
      pcall(function() part.CanCollide = e.cc end)
      pcall(function() part.CanTouch = e.ct end)
    end
  end

  local hookHumanoid

  -- Riscrive CanCollide = false sulle parti gia' registrate di un character.
  -- Serve quando il motore le rimette a true senza emettere il segnale.
  local function reassert(char, isSelf)
    if not char then return end
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if obj:IsA("BasePart") and NPC.parts[obj] then
        if not (isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
          if obj.CanCollide then pcall(function() obj.CanCollide = false end) end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  hookHumanoid = function(hum, char, isSelf)
    if not NPC.charConns[char] then NPC.charConns[char] = {} end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hum.StateChanged:Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      -- differita di un frame: l'Humanoid scrive dopo il cambio di stato
      task.defer(function()
        if isOn() and char.Parent then reassert(char, isSelf) end
      end)
    end))
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FloorMaterial"):Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      task.defer(function()
        if isOn() and char.Parent then reassert(char, isSelf) end
      end)
    end))
  end

  -- ---------- aggancio character ----------
  -- isSelf: sul tuo character l'HRP resta collidibile o l'Humanoid sprofonda.
  local function hookCharacter(char, isSelf)
    if not char then return end
    if NPC.charConns[char] then return end
    NPC.charConns[char] = {}

    local function handle(obj)
      if not isOn() then return end
      if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
      if isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then return end
      lockPart(obj, not isSelf)
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do handle(obj) end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], char.DescendantAdded:Connect(handle))

    -- Salto, caduta, atterraggio, ragdoll: l'Humanoid rimette mano alle
    -- collisioni. Qui le riportiamo giu' subito dopo, senza polling.
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
      local hc
      hc = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if c:IsA("Humanoid") then
          hc:Disconnect()
          hookHumanoid(c, char, isSelf)
        end
      end)
      table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hc)
    else
      hookHumanoid(hum, char, isSelf)
    end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
      if parent == nil then
        for _, c in ipairs(NPC.charConns[char] or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        NPC.charConns[char] = nil
      end
    end))
  end

  -- ---------- assembly esterne (brainrot trasportato, hitbox) ----------
  local function ownedByOtherPlayer(part)
    local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
    if not root then return false end
    local model = root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if not model then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    return plr ~= nil and plr ~= LP
  end

  local function hookWorkspacePart(obj)
    if not isOn() then return end
    if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if NPC.parts[obj] then return end
    -- il weld arriva un frame dopo il parenting
    task.defer(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      if not obj.Parent then return end
      if ownedByOtherPlayer(obj) then lockPart(obj, true) end
    end)
  end

  -- ---------- start / stop interni ----------
  local function startCore()
    if NPC.running then return end
    NPC.running = true

    for _, c in ipairs(NPC.connections or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.connections = {}
    local function track(c) table.insert(NPC.connections, c) end

    local function watchPlayer(plr)
      if plr == LP then return end
      if plr.Character then hookCharacter(plr.Character, false) end
      track(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if isOn() then hookCharacter(char, false) end
      end))
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(plr) end
    track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer))

    if LP.Character then hookCharacter(LP.Character, true) end
    track(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      if isOn() then hookCharacter(char, true) end
    end))

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do hookWorkspacePart(obj) end
    track(Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookWorkspacePart))

    if SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL > 0 then
      local acc = 0
      track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not isOn() then return end
        acc = acc + (dt or 0)
        if acc < SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL then return end
        acc = 0
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local char = plr.Character
          if char then
            local isSelf = (plr == LP)
            reassert(char, isSelf)
            -- parti mai registrate (comparse in una finestra scoperta)
            for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
              if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not NPC.parts[obj] then
                if not (isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
                  lockPart(obj, not isSelf)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end))
    end
  end

  local function stopCore()
    if not NPC.running then return end
    NPC.running = false

    for _, c in ipairs(NPC.connections or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.connections = {}

    for char, conns in pairs(NPC.charConns) do
      for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
      NPC.charConns[char] = nil
    end

    for part in pairs(NPC.parts) do unlockPart(part) end
    NPC.parts = {}
  end

  -- Ripassata completa: riaggancia character e parti gia' presenti.
  -- Serve dopo un cambio di holder, per non restare in attesa del
  -- prossimo DescendantAdded.
  local function rescan()
    if not isOn() then return end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local char = plr.Character
      if char then
        if plr == LP then
          for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then lockPart(obj, false) end
          end
        else
          for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then lockPart(obj, true) end
          end
        end
        hookCharacter(char, plr == LP)
      end
    end
  end

  -- ---------- API ref-count ----------
  -- Permette a TP Bat e toggle utente di tenerla accesa insieme.
  function _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionAcquire(tag)
    NPC.holders[tag or "default"] = true
    startCore()
  end

  function _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionRelease(tag)
    NPC.holders[tag or "default"] = nil
    -- Il toggle utente vince sempre: finche' e' acceso non si spegne nulla,
    -- anche se il tag "user" si fosse perso per strada.
    if _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true then
      NPC.holders["user"] = true
      rescan()
      return
    end
    if next(NPC.holders) == nil then stopCore() end
  end
end

-- Toggle utente (chiamato dalla UI e da applyBl1ndConfig)
function enableNoPlayerCollision()
  _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = true
  _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionAcquire("user")
end

function disableNoPlayerCollision()
  _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = false
  _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionRelease("user")
end

-- Compatibilita' con il vecchio nome usato altrove nello script
function _G.Bl1ndDuelsetOtherPlayerCollision(state)
  if state == false then
    _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionAcquire("legacy")
  else
    _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionRelease("legacy")
  end
end

-- ===== UNWALK (logica da uranium.lua) =====
-- startUnwalk/stopUnwalk dichiarate outer: servono dopo il do-block (toggle UI, apply-config)
-- Le helper interne stanno nel do-block: i loro registri vengono liberati subito,
-- evitando il "out of local limits" al main chunk.
local startUnwalk, stopUnwalk
do
  local unwalkLoopConnection = nil

  local function killAllAnimations(char)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
      for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
      end
    end
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then animate.Disabled = true end
    if hum and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
      pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
    end
  end

  local function restoreAnimations(char)
    if not char then return end
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then
      animate.Disabled = false
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
      task.wait()
      pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
    end
  end

  local function startUnwalkLoop()
    if unwalkLoopConnection then return end
    unwalkLoopConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not unwalkEnabled then return end
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not hum then return end
      local hasAnim = false
      local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
      if animator then
        local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
        if #tracks > 0 then
          hasAnim = true
          for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop() end) end
        end
      end
      local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
      if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") and not animate.Disabled then
        animate.Disabled = true
        hasAnim = true
      end
      if hasAnim then pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end) end
    end)
  end

  local function stopUnwalkLoop()
    if unwalkLoopConnection then
      unwalkLoopConnection:Disconnect()
      unwalkLoopConnection = nil
    end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then restoreAnimations(char) end
  end

  startUnwalk = function()
    if unwalkEnabled then return end
    unwalkEnabled = true
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then killAllAnimations(char) end
    startUnwalkLoop()
  end

  stopUnwalk = function()
    if not unwalkEnabled then return end
    unwalkEnabled = false
    stopUnwalkLoop()
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then restoreAnimations(char) end
  end

  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    _G._Bl1ndWaitCharReady(char, 10)
    -- Animate arriva dopo Head/HRP/Humanoid: senza questa attesa
    -- lo script non verrebbe disabilitato e le animazioni resterebbero.
    pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("Animate", 3) end)
    if unwalkEnabled then
      killAllAnimations(char)
    else
      restoreAnimations(char)
    end
  end)
end
-- ===== FINE UNWALK =====

-- ===== ANIMATION PACKS =====
do
  local ANIM_PACKS = {
    -- NONE (index 1): nessun pack, usa animazioni default
    [1] = nil,
    -- Pack 1
    [2] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://619542203",
      walk = "rbxassetid://619544080",
      run  = "rbxassetid://619543231",
      jump = "rbxassetid://619542888",
      fall = "rbxassetid://619541867",
    },
    -- Pack 2
    [3] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://754637456",
      walk = "rbxassetid://754636298",
      run  = "rbxassetid://754635032",
      jump = "rbxassetid://754637084",
      fall = "rbxassetid://754636589",
    },
    -- Pack 3
    [4] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://1113742618",
      walk = "rbxassetid://1113741192",
      run  = "rbxassetid://1113740510",
      jump = "rbxassetid://1113742359",
      fall = "rbxassetid://1113742092",
    },
    -- Pack 4
    [5] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://126354114956642",
      walk = "rbxassetid://106810508343012",
      run  = "rbxassetid://124765145869332",
      jump = "rbxassetid://115715495289805",
      fall = "rbxassetid://93993406355955",
    },
    -- Pack 5
    [6] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://619535834",
      walk = "rbxassetid://619537468",
      run  = "rbxassetid://619536621",
      jump = "rbxassetid://619536283",
      fall = "rbxassetid://619535616",
    },
  }


  local function _animLoadTrack(animator, id)
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    local success, result = pcall(function()
      local objects = game:GetObjects(id)
      for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj:IsA("Animation") then return obj.AnimationId end
        local deep = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true)
        if deep then return deep.AnimationId end
      end
    end)
    animation.AnimationId = (success and result) and result or id
    return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
  end

  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  -- Le connessioni agli eventi dell'Humanoid non venivano MAI chiuse.
  -- Ogni ricarica del sistema (cambio pack, o cambio di un asset custom)
  -- ne aggiungeva un altro set sopra ai precedenti: i vecchi restavano
  -- vivi e continuavano a comandare Play/Stop sulle tracce, quindi la
  -- nuova animazione non prendeva il controllo finche' non respawnavi,
  -- perche' solo allora l'Humanoid vecchio moriva insieme alle connessioni.
  -- Ora si tengono in una lista e si chiudono a ogni stop.
  _G._Bl1ndAnimPackConns = _G._Bl1ndAnimPackConns or {}
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

  local function _animStopAll()
    for _, track in pairs(_animPackTracks) do
      pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
    end
    _animPackTracks = {}
    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
    for _, c in ipairs(_G._Bl1ndAnimPackConns) do
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    _G._Bl1ndAnimPackConns = {}
    -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END
  end

  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  -- L'indice 7 non ha una tabella fissa: si costruisce al volo dagli ID
  -- che l'utente ha inserito, e contiene SOLO gli slot valorizzati. Per
  -- gli altri movimenti resta l'animazione del gioco, esattamente come
  -- fa Uranium: non si forza niente su uno slot vuoto.
  local function _animCustomPack()
    local t, any = {}, false
    for _, slot in ipairs(_G.Bl1ndCustomAnimSlots) do
      local id = _G.Bl1ndCustomAnimIds[slot]
      if id and id ~= "" then
        t[slot] = "rbxassetid://" .. id
        any = true
      end
    end
    if not any then return nil end
    return t
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

  local function _animStartSystem(char)
    _animStopAll()
    if not _animPackSystemEnabled then return end
    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
    local pack
    if selectedAnimPackIndex == 7 then
      pack = _animCustomPack()
      -- Nessun ID impostato: si lascia il sistema nativo acceso invece di
      -- spegnere Animate e restare senza animazioni.
      if not pack then return end
    else
      pack = ANIM_PACKS[selectedAnimPackIndex]
    end
    if not pack then return end
    -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

    local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
    local Animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")

    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
    -- COPERTURA PARZIALE.
    -- Lo script Animate del gioco si accende o si spegne per TUTTO il
    -- personaggio: non esiste un modo di spegnerlo solo per l'idle. Finche'
    -- un pack copre tutti e cinque i movimenti la cosa non si nota, ma col
    -- pack CUSTOM puoi lasciare uno slot vuoto. Spegnendo Animate lo slot
    -- vuoto non aveva NIENTE da suonare, e la traccia custom precedente
    -- restava in loop: sembrava che l'asset venisse riapplicato di nascosto,
    -- mentre in realta' non era mai stato fermato.
    -- Se la copertura non e' completa, Animate resta ACCESO e le tracce
    -- custom girano sopra con priorita' Action, che vince su Idle e
    -- Movement del gioco. Dove non c'e' una traccia custom riemerge quella
    -- originale, che e' esattamente il comportamento voluto.
    local partial = false
    if selectedAnimPackIndex == 7 then
      for _, sl in ipairs({"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall"}) do
        if not pack[sl] then partial = true break end
      end
    end

    if not partial then
      if Animate then Animate.Disabled = true end
    elseif Animate then
      Animate.Disabled = false
    end
    task.wait(0.1)
    if not partial then
      for _, t in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end)
      end
    end
    -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

    for name, id in pairs(pack) do
      local track = _animLoadTrack(animator, id)
      track.Looped = (name == "idle" or name == "walk" or name == "run" or name == "fall")
      if partial then
        -- Sopra a tutto quello che suona il gioco.
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
      elseif name == "idle" then
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
      elseif name == "walk" or name == "run" then
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
      else
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
      end
      _animPackTracks[name] = track
    end

    local function playAnim(name, forceRestart)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled then return end
      -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
      if not _animPackTracks[name] then
        -- Slot senza asset: si FERMA la traccia custom in corso, altrimenti
        -- resta in loop e copre l'animazione del gioco. Prima si usciva e
        -- basta, ed e' per questo che togliendo l'idle continuavi a vedere
        -- l'animazione custom.
        local cur = _animPackTracks[_animPackCurrentAnim]
        if cur then pcall(function() cur:Stop(0.15) end) end
        _animPackCurrentAnim = name
        return
      end
      -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END
      if _animPackCurrentAnim == name and not forceRestart then return end
      if _animPackTracks[_animPackCurrentAnim] and _animPackCurrentAnim ~= name then
        pcall(function() _animPackTracks[_animPackCurrentAnim]:Stop(0.15) end)
      end
      _animPackCurrentAnim = name
      if forceRestart then _animPackTracks[name]:Stop() end
      _animPackTracks[name]:Play(0.15)
    end

    -- Hookiamo gli eventi PRIMA del play iniziale
    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN: ogni connessione va registrata <<<
    local _conns = _G._Bl1ndAnimPackConns
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled then return end
      local state = humanoid:GetState()
      if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
      if speed > 14 then playAnim("run")
      elseif speed > 0.5 then playAnim("walk")
      else playAnim("idle") end
    end))
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.Jumping:Connect(function(active)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled or not active then return end
      playAnim("jump", true)
    end))
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.FreeFalling:Connect(function(active)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled or not active then return end
      playAnim("fall")
    end))
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled then return end
      if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
        if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
          if humanoid.WalkSpeed > 14 then playAnim("run") else playAnim("walk") end
        else playAnim("idle") end
      end
    end))

    -- Determina l'animazione iniziale in base allo stato attuale del personaggio
    -- invece di forzare sempre idle
    local currentState = humanoid:GetState()
    if currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
      _animPackCurrentAnim = "jump"
      if _animPackTracks.jump then _animPackTracks.jump:Play(0.15) end
    elseif currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
      _animPackCurrentAnim = "fall"
      if _animPackTracks.fall then _animPackTracks.fall:Play(0.15) end
    elseif humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
      if humanoid.WalkSpeed > 14 then
        _animPackCurrentAnim = "run"
        if _animPackTracks.run then _animPackTracks.run:Play(0.15) end
      else
        _animPackCurrentAnim = "walk"
        if _animPackTracks.walk then _animPackTracks.walk:Play(0.15) end
      end
    else
      _animPackCurrentAnim = "idle"
      if _animPackTracks.idle then _animPackTracks.idle:Play(0.15) end
    end
  end

  local function _animRestoreDefault()
    _animStopAll()
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
      local Animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
      if Animate then Animate.Disabled = false end
      local humanoid = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
      if humanoid then
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("Animator")
        if animator then
          for _, t in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do t:Stop(0) end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  -- Flag condiviso tra Bl1ndDuelsetAnimPack e stopUnwalk override:
  -- alzato quando è il pack stesso a chiamare stopUnwalk (non l'utente),
  -- così stopUnwalk non fa il ripristino automatico in quel caso.
  local _packCallingStop = false

  -- Funzione pubblica: applica un pack per indice (1=NONE, 2-6=pack 1-5)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAnimPack = function(index)
    index = math.clamp(tonumber(index) or 1, 1, 7)   -- 7 = CUSTOM

    if index == 1 then
      -- L'utente ha cliccato NONE manualmente
      _animPackSystemEnabled = false
      _animRestoreDefault()
      selectedAnimPackIndex = 1

      if unwalkEnabled then
        -- Unwalk è attivo: l'utente ha confermato NONE esplicitamente
        -- Azzera il pack salvato così quando unwalk si spegne non ripristina niente
        _animPackSavedIndex = 1
        _animPackUnwalkWasActive = false
        -- Unwalk rimane ON, aggiornamento visivo già corretto (unwalk toggle è già acceso)
      else
        -- Unwalk non è attivo: torno a NONE normalmente
        -- Se c'era un flag unwalk pendente (unwalk era stato forzato OFF da un pack),
        -- lo riattivo perché l'utente è tornato a NONE
        if _animPackUnwalkWasActive then
          _animPackUnwalkWasActive = false
          _animPackSavedIndex = 1
          startUnwalk()
          if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(true) end
        end
      end

    else
      -- L'utente ha selezionato pack 1-5
      if unwalkEnabled then
        _animPackSavedIndex = index
        _animPackUnwalkWasActive = true
        _packCallingStop = true
        stopUnwalk()
        if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(false) end
      end
      selectedAnimPackIndex = index
      _animPackSystemEnabled = true
      local char = LP.Character
      if char then
        task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(char) end)
      end
    end

    if setAnimPackVisual then setAnimPackVisual(selectedAnimPackIndex) end
    -- >>> VISIBILE SOLO CON CUSTOM <<<
    if _G.Bl1ndCustomAnimSetRowVisible then
      _G.Bl1ndCustomAnimSetRowVisible(selectedAnimPackIndex == 7, true)
    end
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end

  -- Override di startUnwalk/stopUnwalk per gestire l'interazione col pack
  -- Si aggiunge alla logica esistente, non la sostituisce
  local _origStartUnwalk = startUnwalk
  local _origStopUnwalk  = stopUnwalk

  startUnwalk = function()
    -- Se c'è un pack attivo, salvalo e torna a NONE prima di avviare unwalk
    if selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 then
      _animPackSavedIndex = selectedAnimPackIndex
      _animPackUnwalkWasActive = true
      _animPackSystemEnabled = false
      _animRestoreDefault()
      selectedAnimPackIndex = 1
      if setAnimPackVisual then setAnimPackVisual(1) end
    end
    _origStartUnwalk()
  end

  stopUnwalk = function()
    _origStopUnwalk()
    -- Se chiamato internamente dal pack, non fare niente
    if _packCallingStop then
      _packCallingStop = false
      return
    end
    -- Se c'era un pack salvato prima che unwalk lo coprisse, ripristinalo
    if _animPackSavedIndex ~= 1 then
      local idx = _animPackSavedIndex
      _animPackSavedIndex = 1
      _animPackUnwalkWasActive = false
      task.delay(0.25, function()
        if not unwalkEnabled and _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAnimPack then
          _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAnimPack(idx)
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  -- Chiamata dal picker ogni volta che un ID viene aggiunto o tolto:
  -- se CUSTOM e' la selezione attiva il sistema va ricaricato subito,
  -- altrimenti la modifica si vedrebbe solo al respawn.
  function _G.Bl1ndReloadCustomAnimPack()
    if selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 7 then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    if _G.Bl1ndHasCustomAnim() then
      -- Si riparte da zero: _animStartSystem chiama _animStopAll, che ora
      -- chiude anche le connessioni, quindi il set nuovo e' l'unico attivo
      -- e l'asset appena inserito si applica subito, senza reset.
      _animPackSystemEnabled = true
      task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(char) end)
    else
      _animPackSystemEnabled = false
      _animRestoreDefault()
    end
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

  -- Avvio automatico del pack quando il personaggio riappare
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    _G._Bl1ndWaitCharReady(newChar, 10)
    pcall(function() newChar:WaitForChild("Animate", 3) end)
    if _animPackSystemEnabled and selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 then
      task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(newChar) end)
    end
  end)

  -- Avvio immediato se il personaggio è già spawnato
  if LP.Character and _animPackSystemEnabled and selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 then
    task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(LP.Character) end)
  end
end
-- ===== FINE ANIMATION PACKS =====



function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
  local ok, label = pcall(function()
    return LP.PlayerGui
      and LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame")
      and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame")
      and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame.DuelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("Timer")
      and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame.DuelsMachineTopFrame.Timer:FindFirstChild("Label")
  end)
  return (ok and label) or nil
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeCountdownNumber(text)
  local t = tostring(text or ""):upper():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  if t == "GO" or t == "START" or t == "READY" then return true end
  local n = tonumber(t)
  return n ~= nil and n >= 0 and n <= 10
end

-- Il numero che il cartello sta mostrando, oppure nil se non e' un conto
-- alla rovescia. "GO"/"START" valgono 0: il conto e' finito.
function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeCountdownValue()
  local label = _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
  if not label then return nil end
  local t = tostring(label.Text or ""):upper():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  if t == "GO" or t == "START" or t == "READY" then return 0 end
  local n = tonumber(t)
  if n ~= nil and n >= 0 and n <= 10 then return n end
  return nil
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeInDuelCountdown()
  local label = _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
  return label and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeCountdownNumber(label.Text) or false
end

_G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeBlockedTools = {
  bat=true, slap=true, sword=true, gun=true, pistol=true, rifle=true,
  medusa=true, hammer=true, axe=true, knife=true, katana=true, blade=true, fist=true,
}

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsCarryableTool(tool)
  if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
  local name = tool.Name:lower()
  for word in pairs(_G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeBlockedTools) do
    if name:find(word, 1, true) then return false end
  end
  return true
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeHoldingBrainrot()
  local ok, val = pcall(function() return LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") end)
  if ok and val == true then return true end
  local ok2, val2 = pcall(function() return LP:GetAttribute("AntiKick") end)
  if ok2 and val2 == true then return true end
  local char = LP.Character
  if not char then return false end
  local ok3, val3 = pcall(function() return char:GetAttribute("Stealing") end)
  if ok3 and val3 == true then return true end
  if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and type(_G.AutoCarrySpeed.IsCarryingBrainrot) == "function" then
    local okCarry, carrying = pcall(function() return _G.AutoCarrySpeed.IsCarryingBrainrot(char) end)
    if okCarry and carrying then return true end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({"Carrying", "IsCarrying", "Grabbed", "Holding", "StealHold", "HasGrab"}) do
    local v = char:FindFirstChild(name, true)
    if v then
      if v:IsA("BoolValue") and v.Value then return true end
      if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Value then return true end
      if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Value ~= "" then return true end
    end
  end
  for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
      local n = child.Name:lower()
      if n:find("brainrot") or n:find("animal") or n:find("carry") or n:find("grab") or n:find("steal") or n:find("hold") then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked()
  -- TP Ragdoll in corso: qui il blocco vale SEMPRE, anche a Safe Mode
  -- spenta. Non e' una precauzione come le altre, e' che in quei
  -- millesimi ti stai spostando a forza e qualunque automatismo che ti
  -- muove ti porterebbe altrove a meta' strada.
  if _G.Bl1ndTPRagdollBusy == true then return true end
  if not antiKickEnabled then return false end
  return _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeInDuelCountdown() or _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeHoldingBrainrot()
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop(reason)
  local stopped = false
  if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot(); stopped = true end
  if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2(false); stopped = true end
  if _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat(); stopped = true end
  if autoLeftEnabled then
    autoLeftEnabled = false
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoLeftVisual then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoLeft then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoLeft() end
    stopped = true
  end
  if autoRightEnabled then
    autoRightEnabled = false
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoRightVisual then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoRightVisual(false) end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoRight then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoRight() end
    stopped = true
  end
  if stopped and showActionNotification then pcall(function() showActionNotification(reason or "SAFE MODE LOCK") end) end
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart()
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked() then
    _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK")
    return false
  end
  return true
end

_G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeMonitorStarted = _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeMonitorStarted or false
if not _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeMonitorStarted then
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeMonitorStarted = true
  RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if antiKickEnabled and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked() then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK")
    end
  end)
end

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
  _G._Bl1ndWaitCharReady(char, 10)
  if medCounterEnabled then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter(char) end
  if batCounterEnabled then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter() end
end)

_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot = _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot or {conn = nil, target = nil, swingCooldown = false}

function _G.Bl1ndFindAimbotBat()
  local char = LP.Character
  if not char then return nil end
  for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
    if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name:lower():find("bat") or tool.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
      return tool
    end
  end
  local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
  if bp then
    for _, tool in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
      if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name:lower():find("bat") or tool.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
        return tool
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function _G.Bl1ndGetClosestAimbotTarget()
  local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root then return nil end
  local closest, minDist = nil, math.huge
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
      local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        -- Nel void la distanza va misurata sulla posizione fantasma,
        -- altrimenti il bersaglio risulta lontanissimo e il trigger
        -- dei 4 stud del V2 non scatta mai.
        local tPos = tRoot.Position
        if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
          tPos = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posFor(plr, tPos)
        end
        local dist = (tPos - root.Position).Magnitude
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END
        if dist < minDist then
          minDist = dist
          closest = tRoot
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return closest
end

function _G.Bl1ndGetNormalAimbotSpeed()
  if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    return tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
  end
  return tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58
end

function _G.Bl1ndGetBatAimbotV2Speed()
  if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    return tonumber(_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed) or 40
  end
  return tonumber(_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Speed) or 58
end

function _G.Bl1ndGetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues()
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    return tonumber(_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Speed) or 58, tonumber(_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed) or 40
  end
  return tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58, tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues(normalValue, laggerValue)
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    if normalValue then _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Speed = normalValue end
    if laggerValue then _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed = laggerValue end
  else
    if normalValue then AIMBOT_SPEED = normalValue end
    if laggerValue then LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED = laggerValue end
  end
end

function _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotSpeedBoxes()
  local n, l = _G.Bl1ndGetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues()
  if _G.Bl1ndAimbotSpeedBox then _G.Bl1ndAimbotSpeedBox.Text = tostring(n) end
  if _G.Bl1ndLaggerAimbotSpeedBox then _G.Bl1ndLaggerAimbotSpeedBox.Text = tostring(l) end
end

do
  local function antiVoidPositionForPlayer(player, position)
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then return _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posFor(player, position) end
    return position, false
  end
		local aimbotState = {

			aimbotState.velocityHistory = {}

			aimbotState.previousDirection = nil

		local function nearestTarget(root)
			local nearest, nearestDistance = nil, math.huge
			for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if candidate ~= LP and candidate.Character then
					local targetRoot = candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local targetHumanoid = candidate.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if targetRoot and targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
						local targetPosition = targetRoot.Position
						if type(antiVoidPositionForPlayer) == "function" then
							local ok, position = pcall(antiVoidPositionForPlayer, candidate, targetPosition)
							if ok and typeof(position) == "Vector3" then targetPosition = position end
						end
						local distance = (root.Position - targetPosition).Magnitude
						if distance < nearestDistance then nearest, nearestDistance = candidate, distance end
					end
				end
			end
			return nearest
		end

  function _G.Bl1ndResetVynxAimbotV1()
    resetTarget()
    aimbotState.stickyTarget = nil
    aimbotState.stickyUntil = 0
    aimbotState.lastScan = 0
    aimbotState.lastActivationTime = 0
    aimbotState.lastMode = nil
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.target = nil
  end
  function _G.Bl1ndRunVynxAimbotV1(currentCharacter, currentRoot, currentHumanoid, bat, deltaTime)
    local mode = (_G._Bl1ndAimbotChase or {}).V1 or "NORMAL"
    if aimbotState.lastMode ~= mode then
      _G.Bl1ndResetVynxAimbotV1()
      aimbotState.lastMode = mode
    end
    local nowPing = tick()
    if nowPing - (aimbotState.lastPingSample or -1) >= 0.5 then
      aimbotState.lastPingSample = nowPing
      local ok, value = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
      end)
      if ok and type(value) == "number" then
        aimbotState.realPingMs = math.floor(value)
        aimbotState.currentPing = math.clamp(value / 1000, aimbotConfig.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION, aimbotConfig.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION)
      end
    end
				-- Script 2 Bat Aimbot logic: DEFAULT and BYPASS are separate paths.
				if ((_G._Bl1ndAimbotChase or {}).V1 == "BYPASS") then
					-- Crystal (Akatsuki) bat aimbot logic ported fully for BYPASS mode
					local function crystalRotateRoot(root, direction)
						if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
						local axis = root.CFrame.LookVector:Cross(direction.Unit)
						local angle = math.asin(math.clamp(axis.Magnitude, -1, 1))
						root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = axis.Magnitude > 0.01 and axis.Unit * angle * 80 or Vector3.zero
					end
local function getBypassAimbotSpeed()
						local speed
						if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
							speed = tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
						else
							speed = tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or aimbotConfig.FOLLOW_SPEED or 57
						end
						return math.clamp(speed, 1, 120)
					end

					aimbotState.targetPlayer = nearestTarget(currentRoot)
					_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.target = aimbotState.targetPlayer and aimbotState.targetPlayer.Character and aimbotState.targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local targetCharacter = aimbotState.targetPlayer and aimbotState.targetPlayer.Character
					local targetRoot = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then resetTarget(); return end
					local targetPosition = targetRoot.Position
					if type(antiVoidPositionForPlayer) == "function" then
						local ok, position = pcall(antiVoidPositionForPlayer, aimbotState.targetPlayer, targetPosition)
						if ok and typeof(position) == "Vector3" then targetPosition = position end
					end
					local safeDelta = math.max(deltaTime or 0, 1 / 240)
					if aimbotState.lastTargetPos then
						local rawVelocity = (targetPosition - aimbotState.lastTargetPos) / safeDelta
						local velocityChange = rawVelocity - (aimbotState.targetVelocity or Vector3.zero)
						local maxChange = aimbotConfig.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE or 150
						if velocityChange.Magnitude > maxChange then
							rawVelocity = (aimbotState.targetVelocity or Vector3.zero) + velocityChange.Unit * maxChange
						end
						local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(rawVelocity.X, 0, rawVelocity.Z)
						local maxH = aimbotConfig.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY or 80
						if horizontalVelocity.Magnitude > maxH then
							horizontalVelocity = horizontalVelocity.Unit * maxH
							rawVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontalVelocity.X, rawVelocity.Y, horizontalVelocity.Z)
						end
						aimbotState.targetVelocity = rawVelocity
						local smooth = aimbotConfig.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING or 0.2
						aimbotState.smoothedVelocity = ((aimbotState.smoothedVelocity or rawVelocity) * (1 - smooth)) + (rawVelocity * smooth)
						local function pushHistory(history, value, maximum)
							table.insert(history, value)
							while #history > maximum do table.remove(history, 1) end
						end
						local function averageVector(history)
							if #history == 0 then return Vector3.zero end
							local total = Vector3.zero
							for _, value in ipairs(history) do total = total + value end
							return total / #history
						end
						aimbotState.velocityHistory = aimbotState.velocityHistory or {}
						aimbotState.accelerationHistory = aimbotState.accelerationHistory or {}
						aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory = aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory or {}
						aimbotState.verticalVelocityHistory = aimbotState.verticalVelocityHistory or {}
