						pushHistory(aimbotState.velocityHistory, aimbotState.smoothedVelocity, 8)
						local prev = aimbotState.velocityHistory[#aimbotState.velocityHistory - 1]
						if prev then
							pushHistory(aimbotState.accelerationHistory, (aimbotState.smoothedVelocity - prev) / safeDelta, 6)
						end
						local yVel = aimbotState.smoothedVelocity.Y
						if (aimbotState.lastYVelocity or 0) < -5 and yVel > 5 then
							aimbotState.airborneTime = 0
						end
						aimbotState.lastYVelocity = yVel
						if targetHumanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air or yVel > 2 then
							aimbotState.airborneTime = (aimbotState.airborneTime or 0) + safeDelta
							pushHistory(aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory, Vector3.new(aimbotState.smoothedVelocity.X, 0, aimbotState.smoothedVelocity.Z), 6)
							pushHistory(aimbotState.verticalVelocityHistory, yVel, 6)
						else
							aimbotState.airborneTime = 0
							aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
							aimbotState.verticalVelocityHistory = {}
						end
					end
					aimbotState.lastTargetPos = targetPosition

					local airborne = (aimbotState.airborneTime or 0) >= (aimbotConfig.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME or 0.08)
					local predictionVelocity = aimbotState.smoothedVelocity or aimbotState.targetVelocity or Vector3.zero
					if airborne and aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory and #aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
						local total = Vector3.zero
						for _, value in ipairs(aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory) do total = total + value end
						local aerialVelocity = total / #aimbotState.aerialVelocityHistory
						predictionVelocity = Vector3.new(aerialVelocity.X, (aimbotState.targetVelocity and aimbotState.targetVelocity.Y) or 0, aerialVelocity.Z) * (aimbotConfig.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR or 0.8)
					end
					local quickTurn = false
					local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(predictionVelocity.X, 0, predictionVelocity.Z)
					if horizontalVelocity.Magnitude > 5 then
						local direction = horizontalVelocity.Unit
						if aimbotState.previousDirection and aimbotState.previousDirection:Dot(direction) < 0.5 then
							quickTurn = tick() - (aimbotState.lastDirectionChangeTime or 0) < (aimbotConfig.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME or 0.12)
							aimbotState.lastDirectionChangeTime = tick()
						end
						aimbotState.previousDirection = direction
					end
					local serverDelay = (aimbotState.currentPing or 0.1) + (aimbotConfig.SERVER_TICKRATE or (1 / 60))
					if quickTurn then serverDelay = serverDelay * (aimbotConfig.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER or 1.5) end
					local predicted = targetPosition + predictionVelocity * serverDelay
					if aimbotState.accelerationHistory and #aimbotState.accelerationHistory > 0 then
						local total = Vector3.zero
						for _, value in ipairs(aimbotState.accelerationHistory) do total = total + value end
						local acceleration = total / #aimbotState.accelerationHistory
						predicted = predicted + acceleration * (aimbotConfig.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT or 0.3) * (serverDelay * serverDelay * 0.5)
					end
					local predictionTime = (aimbotConfig.PREDICTION_TIME or 0.22) * 1.1
					predicted = predicted + predictionVelocity * predictionTime
					if airborne then
						predicted = predicted + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * (aimbotConfig.GRAVITY or 196.2) * predictionTime * predictionTime, 0)
					end
					local flatPredictionVelocity = Vector3.new(predictionVelocity.X, 0, predictionVelocity.Z)
					if flatPredictionVelocity.Magnitude > 1 then
						predicted = predicted + flatPredictionVelocity.Unit * (aimbotConfig.PREDICT_AHEAD or 3)
					end
					local toTarget = predicted - currentRoot.Position
					crystalRotateRoot(currentRoot, toTarget)
					if (targetPosition - currentRoot.Position).Magnitude <= (aimbotConfig.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE or 13)
						and tick() - (aimbotState.lastActivationTime or 0) >= 0.3 then
						if autoSwingEnabled and bat then pcall(bat.Activate, bat) end
						aimbotState.lastActivationTime = tick()
					end
					if toTarget.Magnitude > (aimbotConfig.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE or 1) then
						local speed = getBypassAimbotSpeed()
						currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = toTarget.Unit * speed
					else
						currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5, 0)
					end
					return
				end

				-- DEFAULT: Vynx normal aimbot (sticky target + prediction + always swing). BYPASS path above stays original.
				local AIMBOT_STICKY_TIME = 1.25
				local AIMBOT_STICKY_MAX_DIST = 85
				local now = tick()
				local function stillValidTarget(plr)
					if not plr or not plr.Character then return false end
					local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if not tRoot or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
					if (tRoot.Position - currentRoot.Position).Magnitude > AIMBOT_STICKY_MAX_DIST then return false end
					return true
				end
				local targetPlayer = nil
				if aimbotState.stickyTarget and now < (aimbotState.stickyUntil or 0) and stillValidTarget(aimbotState.stickyTarget) then
					targetPlayer = aimbotState.stickyTarget
				elseif now - (aimbotState.lastScan or 0) <= 0.08 and aimbotState.stickyTarget and stillValidTarget(aimbotState.stickyTarget) then
					targetPlayer = aimbotState.stickyTarget
				else
					aimbotState.lastScan = now
					targetPlayer = nearestTarget(currentRoot)
					aimbotState.stickyTarget = targetPlayer
					aimbotState.stickyUntil = now + AIMBOT_STICKY_TIME
				end
				local targetCharacter = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
				local targetRoot = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				aimbotState.targetPlayer = targetPlayer
				_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.target = targetRoot
				if not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
					resetTarget()
					aimbotState.stickyTarget = nil
					currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
					currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					return
				end
				currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
				local myPos = currentRoot.Position
				local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
				local targetVel = targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
				local ghostPos, isGhost = antiVoidPositionForPlayer(targetPlayer, targetPos)
				targetPos = ghostPos
				if isGhost then targetVel = Vector3.zero end
				-- Prediction always on (Vynx)
				local predictPos = targetPos + targetVel * 0.14 + targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 0.3
				local direction = predictPos - myPos
				local flatDir = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
				if flatDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					flatDir = flatDir.Unit
				else
					flatDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
				end
				local chaseSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or aimbotConfig.FOLLOW_SPEED or 58, 1, 200)
				if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
					chaseSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40, 1, 200)
				end
				local desiredHeight = targetPos.Y + 3.7
				local yVel = (desiredHeight - myPos.Y) * 19.5 + targetVel.Y * 0.8
				if currentHumanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
					yVel = math.max(yVel, 13)
				end
				yVel = math.clamp(yVel, -70, 110)
				local desiredVel = Vector3.new(flatDir.X * chaseSpeed, yVel, flatDir.Z * chaseSpeed)
				currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Lerp(desiredVel, 0.8)

				local speed3 = targetVel.Magnitude
				local predictTime = math.clamp(speed3 / 150, 0.05, 0.2)
				local predictedPos = targetPos + targetVel * predictTime
				local toPredict = predictedPos - myPos
				if toPredict.Magnitude > 0.1 then
					local goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, predictedPos)
					local diffCF = currentRoot.CFrame:Inverse() * goalCF
					local rx, ry, rz = diffCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
					rx = math.clamp(rx, -2.5, 2.5)
					ry = math.clamp(ry, -2.5, 2.5)
					rz = math.clamp(rz, -2.5, 2.5)
					currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = currentRoot.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(
						Vector3.new(rx * 42, ry * 42, rz * 42)
					)
				end

				-- Vynx: free continuous swing (not distance-gated)
				local equipped = currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("Bat") or bat
				if autoSwingEnabled and equipped and equipped:IsA("Tool") and equipped.Parent == currentCharacter then
					local n = equipped.Name:lower()
					if n:find("bat", 1, true) or n:find("slap", 1, true) then
						pcall(function() equipped:Activate() end)
					end
				elseif autoSwingEnabled and bat and bat.Parent == currentCharacter then
					pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
				end

  end
end
-- <<< BL1ND V1 VYNX NORMAL / BYPASS CONTROLLER END

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot(keepV2)
  -- Anti Die SUBITO, prima riga della funzione. Stava nel wrapper in fondo
  -- al file: funzionava solo per chi chiamava il nome globale DOPO che i
  -- wrapper erano stati installati, e chi entrava per altre strade (o
  -- prima) partiva scoperto. Qui non c'e' strada che lo salti.
  if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow) end
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart and not _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart() then return false end
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoTPForAction then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoTPForAction() end
  -- keepV2 = true quando e' il Bat Aimbot V2 a usare questo chase come fase 1
  if not keepV2 then
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2(false) end
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = false
  end
  _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn = true
  _G.Bl1ndResetVynxAimbotV1()
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartChaseRagdollWatcher then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartChaseRagdollWatcher() end
  if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn then
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn:Disconnect()
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn = nil
  end
  local hum0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum0 then hum0.AutoRotate = false end
  _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or _G.Bl1ndFindAimbotBat()
    if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
      pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On ~= true then
      if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
      hum.AutoRotate = false
      bat = _G.Bl1ndFindAimbotBat()
      if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then pcall(hum.EquipTool, hum, bat) end
      _G.Bl1ndRunVynxAimbotV1(char, root, hum, bat, deltaTime)
      return
    end
    local target = _G.Bl1ndGetClosestAimbotTarget()
    if not target then return end
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.target = target

    -- >>> AIMBOT CHASE MODE BEGIN
    -- Se l'aimbot attivo e' in BYPASS si usa l'inseguimento alternativo.
    local _chaseKey  = (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true) and "V2" or "V1"
    local _chaseMode = (_G._Bl1ndAimbotChase and _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase[_chaseKey]) or "NORMAL"
    if _chaseMode == "BYPASS" then
      local myPos     = root.Position
      local targetPos = target.Position
      -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
      if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
        targetPos = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posForPart(target, targetPos)
      end
      -- <<< ANTI VOID END
      local direction = targetPos - myPos
      local flatDir   = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
      if flatDir.Magnitude > 0 then flatDir = flatDir.Unit else flatDir = Vector3.zero end
      -- >>> PATHFINDING <<< percorso vero verso il bersaglio, come Auto
      -- Left/Right ma DINAMICO: il nemico si muove, quindi il percorso si
      -- ricalcola spesso (0.35s) e subito se si e' spostato di 4 studs.
      if _G.Bl1ndPathfind and flatDir.Magnitude > 0 then
        local pd = _G.Bl1ndPathfind.dirTo("aimbot", myPos, targetPos,
                     {recompute = 0.35, drift = 4})
        if pd then flatDir = pd end
      end

      local chaseSpeed = (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
        and (_G.Bl1ndGetBatAimbotV2Speed and _G.Bl1ndGetBatAimbotV2Speed() or _G.Bl1ndGetNormalAimbotSpeed())
        or _G.Bl1ndGetNormalAimbotSpeed()

      -- >>> BAT AIMBOT V2: inseguimento alla stessa altezza del nemico <<<
      -- Il V1 sale di 3.7 stud e si stacca da terra; il V2 no, va dritto
      -- addosso al player restando al suo livello.
      local _isV2 = (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
      local desiredHeight = targetPos.Y + (_isV2 and 0 or 3.7)
      local yVel = (desiredHeight - myPos.Y) * 19.5
      if not _isV2 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then yVel = math.max(yVel, 13) end
      yVel = math.clamp(yVel, -70, 110)

      local desiredVel = Vector3.new(flatDir.X * chaseSpeed, yVel, flatDir.Z * chaseSpeed)
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Lerp(desiredVel, 0.8)

      local toTarget = targetPos - myPos
      if toTarget.Magnitude > 0.1 then
        local goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, targetPos)
        local diffCF = root.CFrame:Inverse() * goalCF
        local rx, ry, rz = diffCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
        rx = math.clamp(rx, -2.5, 2.5)
        ry = math.clamp(ry, -2.5, 2.5)
        rz = math.clamp(rz, -2.5, 2.5)
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(rx * 42, ry * 42, rz * 42))
      end

      -- Col V2 lo swing appartiene al TP Bat, non al chase.
      -- Niente soglia di distanza: qui c'era un "toTarget.Magnitude <= 8"
      -- che il ramo Normal non ha, ed e' il motivo per cui in Bypass il
      -- V1 iniziava a menare solo una volta arrivato addosso al nemico
      -- invece che dall'accensione.
      if autoSwingEnabled and bat and _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On ~= true
        and not _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown then
        _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = true
        pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
        task.delay(0.08, function()
          if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false end
        end)
      end
      return
    end
    -- <<< AIMBOT CHASE MODE END

    local targetVel = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local myPos = root.Position
    local targetPos = target.Position
    -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
      local gp, isGhost = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posForPart(target, targetPos)
      targetPos = gp
      -- fuori zona non c'e' niente da predire: il bersaglio e' fermo
      if isGhost then targetVel = Vector3.zero end
    end
    -- <<< ANTI VOID END
    -- >>> BAT AIMBOT V2: nessuna predizione <<<
    -- Il V1 anticipa il bersaglio (velocita' * 0.14 + un pezzo di LookVector);
    -- il V2 punta la posizione reale, senza anticipo.
    local _isV2 = (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
    local predictPos = targetPos
    if not _isV2 then
      predictPos = targetPos + targetVel * 0.14 + target.CFrame.LookVector * 0.3
    end
    local direction = predictPos - myPos
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
    local flatDir = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flatDir.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
    flatDir = flatDir.Unit
    -- >>> PATHFINDING <<< come nel ramo Bypass. La mira resta sul
    -- bersaglio, non sulla direzione del waypoint.
    if _G.Bl1ndPathfind then
      local pd = _G.Bl1ndPathfind.dirTo("aimbot", myPos, targetPos,
                   {recompute = 0.35, drift = 4})
      if pd then flatDir = pd end
    end
    local chaseSpeed = (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
      and (_G.Bl1ndGetBatAimbotV2Speed and _G.Bl1ndGetBatAimbotV2Speed() or _G.Bl1ndGetNormalAimbotSpeed())
      or _G.Bl1ndGetNormalAimbotSpeed()
    -- >>> BAT AIMBOT V2: inseguimento alla stessa altezza del nemico <<<
    -- Il V1 sale di 3.7 stud e si stacca da terra; il V2 no, va dritto
    -- addosso al player restando al suo livello.
    local desiredHeight = targetPos.Y + (_isV2 and 0 or 3.7)
    local yVel = (desiredHeight - myPos.Y) * 19.5
    if not _isV2 then
      -- anticipo verticale: solo V1
      yVel = yVel + targetVel.Y * 0.8
    end
    if not _isV2 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
      yVel = math.max(yVel, 13)
    end
    yVel = math.clamp(yVel, -70, 110)
    local desiredVel = Vector3.new(flatDir.X * chaseSpeed, yVel, flatDir.Z * chaseSpeed)
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Lerp(desiredVel, 0.8)
    -- Mira: il V1 anticipa in base alla velocita', il V2 guarda il punto reale.
    local predictedPos = targetPos
    if not _isV2 then
      local predictTime = math.clamp(targetVel.Magnitude / 150, 0.05, 0.2)
      predictedPos = targetPos + targetVel * predictTime
    end
    local toPredict = predictedPos - myPos
    if toPredict.Magnitude > 0.1 then
      local goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, predictedPos)
      local diffCF = root.CFrame:Inverse() * goalCF
      local rx, ry, rz = diffCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
      rx = math.clamp(rx, -2.5, 2.5)
      ry = math.clamp(ry, -2.5, 2.5)
      rz = math.clamp(rz, -2.5, 2.5)
      root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(rx * 42, ry * 42, rz * 42))
    end
    -- Col V2 lo swing appartiene al TP Bat, non al chase
    if autoSwingEnabled and bat and _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On ~= true
      and not _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown then
      _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = true
      pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
      task.delay(0.08, function()
        if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false end
      end)
    end
  end)
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot()
  _G.Bl1ndResetVynxAimbotV1()
  _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn = false
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopChaseRagdollWatcher then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopChaseRagdollWatcher() end
  -- Percorso buttato: al prossimo inseguimento si riparte da dove sei
  -- adesso, non da waypoint calcolati per un bersaglio vecchio.
  if _G.Bl1ndPathfind then pcall(_G.Bl1ndPathfind.reset, "aimbot") end
  if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot and _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn then
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn:Disconnect()
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.conn = nil
  end
  if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot then
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.target = nil
    _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
  end
  local c = LP.Character
  local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if root then
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  local hum2 = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum2 then hum2.AutoRotate = true end
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
end

-- ===== BAT AIMBOT V2 =====
-- Il V2 non ha piu' una logica di inseguimento propria: riusa il chase del
-- Bat Aimbot V1 (con le sue velocita' dedicate) e, appena arriva entro
-- BAT_AIMBOT_V2_TP_DISTANCE stud dal nemico, passa il controllo al TP Bat.
-- In questa fase il TP Bat ignora la sua distanza minima di 8 stud: lo snap
-- avviene comunque. Il TP Bat avviato a mano continua invece a rispettarla.
_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State = _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State or {conn = nil}
_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2TPDistance = 4

function _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2GetClosest()
  local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root then return nil, math.huge end
  local closest, minDist = nil, math.huge
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
      local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        -- Nel void la distanza va misurata sulla posizione fantasma,
        -- altrimenti il bersaglio risulta lontanissimo e il trigger
        -- dei 4 stud del V2 non scatta mai.
        local tPos = tRoot.Position
        if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
          tPos = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posFor(plr, tPos)
        end
        local dist = (tPos - root.Position).Magnitude
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END
        if dist < minDist then
          minDist = dist
          closest = tRoot
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return closest, minDist
end

-- Fase 1: chase con la logica del V1 (il flag keepV2 evita che il V1 spenga il V2)
function _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2StartChase()
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot(true) end
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2()
  -- Anti Die SUBITO, prima riga della funzione. Stava nel wrapper in fondo
  -- al file: funzionava solo per chi chiamava il nome globale DOPO che i
  -- wrapper erano stati installati, e chi entrava per altre strade (o
  -- prima) partiva scoperto. Qui non c'e' strada che lo salti.
  if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow) end
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart and not _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart() then return false end
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoTPForAction then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoTPForAction() end
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = true
  selectedAimbotMode = "V2"
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2StartChase()
  if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn then
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn:Disconnect()
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn = nil
  end
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then return end
    -- Mentre il TP Bat e' attivo comanda lui: nessun chase in parallelo.
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn then return end
    local target, dist = _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2GetClosest()
    local trigger = tonumber(_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2TPDistance) or 4
    if target and dist <= trigger then
      -- Fase 2: entro i 5 stud subentra il TP Bat (senza limite di distanza)
      -- Chiamata automatica: il bottone mobile del TP Bat resta spento.
      _G.Bl1ndTPBatSilent = true
      -- Lo swing parte solo 0.05s dopo l'inizio del TP
      _G._Bl1ndV2SwingGate = tick() + 0.05
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat() end
    elseif not _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn then
      -- Il TP Bat si e' spento (es. nemico ragdollato): si torna al chase V1.
      -- Piccolo cooldown per non ritentare ad ogni frame se lo start viene bloccato.
      local now = tick()
      if now - (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.lastChase or 0) >= 0.15 then
        _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.lastChase = now
        _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2StartChase()
      end
    end
  end)
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2(keepVisual)
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = false
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopChaseRagdollWatcher then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopChaseRagdollWatcher() end
  if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State and _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn then
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn:Disconnect()
    _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2State.conn = nil
  end
  if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot() end
  if _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat() end
  local c = LP.Character
  local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if root then
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum then
    hum.AutoRotate = true
    hum.PlatformStand = false
    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
  end
  if keepVisual ~= false and _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
end

function _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot()
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2() else _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = false end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot() end
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2() else _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = true end
    end
  else
    if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot()
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2(false) else _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On = false end
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot()
    end
  end
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  saveBl1ndConfig()
end

function _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual()
  if _G.Bl1ndAimbotSetVisual then
    if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
      _G.Bl1ndAimbotSetVisual(_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
    else
      _G.Bl1ndAimbotSetVisual(_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn == true)
    end
  end
end

_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStart = _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot
_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStop = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot
_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Start = _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2
_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2

-- Mirror TP Down
-- Helpers interne nel do-block: liberano 6 slot locals dal main chunk.
do
  local MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD = 3
  local MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y = -7.00
  local mirrorTPPreviousY = {}
  local mirrorTPLastTeleport = 0

  local function mirrorTPAimbotActive()
    return (_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true) or (_G.Bl1ndTPBatOn == true)
  end

  local function mirrorTPTeleportDown()
    local character = LP.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    local now = tick()
    if now - mirrorTPLastTeleport < 0.08 then return end
    mirrorTPLastTeleport = now
    local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y, root.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    pcall(function() root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
  end

  RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not mirrorTPDownEnabled or not mirrorTPAimbotActive() then
      table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
      return
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player ~= LP and player.Character then
        local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
          local currentY = root.Position.Y
          local previousY = mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId]
          if previousY and previousY - currentY >= MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD then
            pcall(mirrorTPTeleportDown)
            table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
            if type(showActionNotification) == "function" then
              pcall(function() showActionNotification("MIRROR TP!") end)
            end
            return
          end
          mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId] = currentY
        end
      end
    end
  end)

  function _G.Bl1ndDuelsetMirrorTPDown(enabled)
    mirrorTPDownEnabled = enabled == true
    if not mirrorTPDownEnabled then table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY) end
    if _G.Bl1ndMirrorTPDownSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndMirrorTPDownSetVisual(mirrorTPDownEnabled) end
  end
end -- fine do-block mirrorTP

-- ========================================================
-- NUOVO SISTEMA TP BAT (stile Uranium)
-- ========================================================

local tpBatEnabled = false
-- Tutte le variabili interne e le helper del blocco tpBat stanno nel do-end:
-- liberano ~11 slot locals dal main chunk evitando il limite di 200.
do
  local tpBatLoopConn = nil
  local tpBatRagdollConn = nil
  local tpBatResetConn = nil
  local tpBatSwingCooldown = 0
  local TP_BAT_SWING_COOLDOWN = 0.08
  local tpBatPlayerConns = {}
  -- Consuma il pending value lasciato da loadBl1ndConfig (che gira prima di questo do-block)
  local tpBatCameraLockEnabled = _G._Bl1ndTPBatCameraLockPending == true
  _G._Bl1ndTPBatCameraLockPending = nil
  -- Bridge su _G per l'accesso esterno al do-block (save/load/UI/reset)
  _G._Bl1ndGetTPBatCameraLock = function() return tpBatCameraLockEnabled end
  _G._Bl1ndDuelsetTPBatCameraLock = function(v) tpBatCameraLockEnabled = v end

  -- ============================================================
  -- NO-COLLISION: delegata al modulo No Player Collision v3.
  -- Prima il TP Bat rifaceva GetDescendants() su tutti i giocatori ad
  -- OGNI frame e al termine riaccendeva CanCollide/CanTouch su tutto,
  -- cancellando anche il lavoro del toggle No Player Collision (e
  -- riaccendendo parti che erano gia' false in origine, tipo accessori).
  -- Ora si limita a prenotare/rilasciare il modulo col tag "tpbat".
  -- ============================================================
  local function acquireNoCollision()
      if _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionAcquire then _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionAcquire("tpbat") end
  end

  local function releaseNoCollision()
      if _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionRelease then _G.Bl1ndNoCollisionRelease("tpbat") end
  end

  -- ============================================================
  -- GET CLOSEST ENEMY
  -- ============================================================
  local function getClosestEnemy()
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return nil, math.huge end
      local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root then return nil, math.huge end
      local closest, dist = nil, math.huge
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if p ~= LP and p.Character then
              local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if tr and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                  local d = (tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                  if d < dist then
                      dist = d
                      closest = p
                  end
              end
          end
      end
      return closest, dist
  end

  -- ============================================================
  -- AUTO SWING
  -- ============================================================
  local function trySwingBat()
      if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true then
        -- Chiamato dal Bat Aimbot V2: comanda l'Auto Swing del V2,
        -- non quello del TP Bat. Parte 0.05s dopo l'inizio del TP.
        if not autoSwingEnabled then return end
        if tick() < (_G._Bl1ndV2SwingGate or 0) then return end
      elseif not tpBatAutoSwingEnabled then
        return
      end
      local now = tick()
      if now - tpBatSwingCooldown < TP_BAT_SWING_COOLDOWN then return end
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local bat = char:FindFirstChild("Bat") or LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat")
      if bat then
          if bat.Parent == LP.Backpack then
              local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if hum then hum:EquipTool(bat) end
          end
          pcall(function()
              bat:Activate()
              tpBatSwingCooldown = now
          end)
      end
  end

  -- ============================================================
  -- RAGDOLL DETECTOR: disattiva tp bat quando il nemico ragdolla
  -- ============================================================
  local function onEnemyRagdollStarted()
      if not tpBatEnabled then return end
      -- Disattivazione ISTANTANEA al rilevamento hit (nessun cooldown)
      if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then
          -- Questo TP Bat e' la fase 2 del Bat Aimbot V2: l'hit spegne tutto il V2,
          -- cosi' il chase non riparte piu' da solo.
          if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2() return end
      end
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat()
  end

  local function setupEnemyRagdollDetector(enemyChar)
      local conn = enemyChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
          if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then onEnemyRagdollStarted() end
      end)
      return conn
  end

  local function watchEnemyPlayer(plr)
      if plr == LP then return end
      if tpBatPlayerConns[plr] then
          pcall(function() tpBatPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
      end
      tpBatPlayerConns[plr] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
          if char then
              local detectorConn = setupEnemyRagdollDetector(char)
              char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                  if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
              end)
          end
      end)
      if plr.Character then
          local detectorConn = setupEnemyRagdollDetector(plr.Character)
          plr.Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
              if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
          end)
      end
  end

  -- ============================================================
  -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS BEGIN
  -- V1 = logica storica (snap secco sul nemico).
  -- V2 = orbita fissa attorno al nemico.
  -- V3 = body spam pattern (spam di teleport ravvicinati).
  -- V4 = body spam 0.5 stud avanti rispetto alla direzione del nemico.
  -- V5 = vortex: spirale che si stringe/allarga (raggio max 3).
  --
  -- Tutte le versioni girano DENTRO questo do-block, quindi ereditano
  -- gratis l'infrastruttura gia' presente:
  --   * No Player Collision automatica (acquire/release col tag "tpbat")
  --   * Auto Stop sul ragdoll del nemico (detector condiviso)
  --   * Anti Void (posForPart + PhysicsRepRootPart a nil se il nemico e' nel void)
  --   * Auto Swing / Camera Lock / Safe Mode / save config / bottoni mobile
  --
  -- IMPORTANTE: Bat Aimbot V2 e Bat Counter V2 usano SEMPRE la V1.
  -- La versione scelta dall'utente viene ignorata mentre uno dei due comanda.
  -- Tutti i parametri stanno in una sola tabella per non consumare local slot.
  -- ============================================================
  local TPB = {
    velHist     = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    orbitAngle  = 0,
    spinAngle   = 0,
    -- V2
    orbitRadius = 4.2,
    orbitSpeed  = 80,
    -- V3 / V4
    spinSpeed   = 48,
    -- Stesso numero di teleport della V5, cosi' V3 e V4 picchiano quanto lei
    teleports   = 300,
    -- V5
    v5Teleports = 300,
    v5SpinSpeed = 60,
    v5RadiusMin = 1.5,
    v5RadiusMax = 3,
  }
  _G._Bl1ndTPB = TPB   -- tuning esterno (facoltativo)

  -- Velocita' del bersaglio filtrata (stessa formula delle logiche V2..V5)
  local function tpBatTrackVel(tr)
      local now = os.clock()
      local pos = tr.Position
      local vel = tr.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
      local h = TPB.velHist[tr]
      if h then
          local dt = now - h.t
          if dt > 0.004 and dt < 0.5 then
              local measured = (pos - h.p) / dt
              if measured.Magnitude < 180 then
                  local blend = math.clamp(dt * 12, 0.2, 0.85)
                  vel = (h.v or vel):Lerp(measured, blend)
              end
          end
      end
      TPB.velHist[tr] = { t = now, p = pos, v = vel }
      return vel
  end

  -- Snap "sicuro": evita CFrame.new(p, p) quando i due punti coincidono
  local function tpBatSnap(hrp, pos, lookAt)
      if (pos - lookAt).Magnitude > 0.001 then
          hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, lookAt)
      else
          hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
      end
      hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end

  local function tpBatFrame(dt)
      if not tpBatEnabled then return end
      dt = (type(dt) == "number" and dt > 0 and dt < 0.1) and dt or (1 / 60)

      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

      local target = getClosestEnemy()
      if not (target and target.Character) then return end
      local tr = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not tr then return end

      -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
      -- Nemico tpato nel void: si lavora sul punto d'origine.
      local _tpRaw, _tpGhost = tr.Position, false
      if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
          _tpRaw, _tpGhost = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posForPart(tr, tr.Position)
      end
      -- PhysicsRepRootPart si aggancia al nemico solo se e' ancora in mappa.
      if sethiddenproperty then
          if _tpGhost then
              pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil) end)
          else
              pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", tr) end)
          end
      end
      -- <<< ANTI VOID END

      -- Bat Aimbot V2 / Bat Counter V2 => SEMPRE V1
      local forcedV1 = (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
                    or (_G.Bl1ndBatCounterV2On == true)
      local ver = forcedV1 and 1 or math.clamp(tonumber(_G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion) or 1, 1, 5)

      if ver == 1 then
          -- ---------- V1: logica originale ----------
          local targetPos = _tpRaw + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)
          -- La distanza minima di 8 stud vale solo per il TP Bat avviato a mano.
          if forcedV1 or (hrp.Position - targetPos).Magnitude > 8 then
              hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
          end
      else
          -- ---------- BASE COMUNE V2..V5 ----------
          local center = _tpRaw + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)
          local flatVel = Vector3.zero
          if not _tpGhost then
              local tv = tpBatTrackVel(tr)
              flatVel = Vector3.new(tv.X, 0, tv.Z)
              if flatVel.Magnitude > 110 then
                  flatVel = flatVel.Unit * 110
              end
          end
          local predicted = center + flatVel * 0.05

          if ver == 2 then
              -- ---------- V2: ORBITA FISSA ----------
              TPB.orbitAngle = (TPB.orbitAngle or 0) + TPB.orbitSpeed * dt
              local ang = TPB.orbitAngle
              local orbitPos = predicted + Vector3.new(
                  math.cos(ang) * TPB.orbitRadius,
                  0,
                  math.sin(ang) * TPB.orbitRadius
              )
              tpBatSnap(hrp, orbitPos, predicted)
          else
              local look  = tr.CFrame.LookVector
              local right = tr.CFrame.RightVector

              -- V3 resta sul punto predetto, V4/V5 si spostano 0.5 stud avanti
              local anchor = predicted
              if ver ~= 3 and flatVel.Magnitude > 0.5 then
                  anchor = predicted + flatVel.Unit * 0.5
              end

              if ver == 5 then
                  -- ---------- V5: VORTEX ----------
                  TPB.orbitAngle = (TPB.orbitAngle or 0) + TPB.v5SpinSpeed * dt * 5
                  local ang = TPB.orbitAngle
                  local n = TPB.v5Teleports
                  local rMin, rMax = TPB.v5RadiusMin, TPB.v5RadiusMax
                  for i = 1, n do
                      local t = i / n
                      local radius = rMin + (rMax - rMin) * math.abs(math.sin(t * math.pi * 3))
                      local angle = ang + t * 12
                      local pos = anchor
                          + right * (math.cos(angle) * radius)
                          + look  * (math.sin(angle) * radius)
                          + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(angle * 1.5) * 0.15, 0)
                      tpBatSnap(hrp, pos, anchor)
                  end
                  local face = anchor + Vector3.new(
                      math.sin(ang) * 0.3,
                      0.1,
                      math.cos(ang) * 0.3
                  )
                  tpBatSnap(hrp, anchor + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0), face)
              else
                  -- ---------- V3 / V4: BODY SPAM PATTERN ----------
                  TPB.spinAngle = (TPB.spinAngle or 0) + TPB.spinSpeed * dt * 4.4
                  local spin = TPB.spinAngle
                  local c, s = math.cos(spin), math.sin(spin)
                  for i = 1, TPB.teleports do
                      local jx = ((i % 5) - 2) * 0.05
                      local jz = ((i % 7) - 3) * 0.04
                      local jy = ((i % 3) - 1) * 0.025
                      local ox = jx * c - jz * s
                      local oz = jx * s + jz * c
                      local pos = anchor + right * ox + look * (0.12 + oz) + Vector3.new(0, jy, 0)
                      tpBatSnap(hrp, pos, anchor)
                  end
                  local face = anchor + Vector3.new(
                      math.sin(spin) * 0.4,
                      0,
                      math.cos(spin) * 0.4
                  )
                  tpBatSnap(hrp, anchor + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0), face)
              end
          end
      end

      -- CAMERA LOCK: identico per tutte le versioni
      if tpBatCameraLockEnabled then
          pcall(function()
              workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                  workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position,
                  _tpRaw   -- >>> ANTI VOID <<<
              )
          end)
      end

      trySwingBat()
  end

  -- Cambio versione (UI / keybind). Non riavvia il TP Bat: il dispatcher
  -- legge _G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion ad ogni frame.
  function _G.Bl1ndDuelsetTPBatVersion(v)
      v = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1, 1, 5)
      _G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion = v
      TPB.orbitAngle = 0
      TPB.spinAngle = 0
      table.clear(TPB.velHist)
      if _G._Bl1ndTPBatSetVersionVisual then _G._Bl1ndTPBatSetVersionVisual(v) end
      if saveBl1ndConfig then saveBl1ndConfig() end
      return v
  end
  -- <<< TP BAT VERSIONS END

-- ===== AVVIO / ARRESTO =====
function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat()
  -- Anti Die SUBITO, prima riga della funzione. Stava nel wrapper in fondo
  -- al file: funzionava solo per chi chiamava il nome globale DOPO che i
  -- wrapper erano stati installati, e chi entrava per altre strade (o
  -- prima) partiva scoperto. Qui non c'e' strada che lo salti.
  if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.Bl1ndAntiDieArmNow) end
    if tpBatEnabled then return end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart and not _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeTryStart() then return false end

    -- Ferma gli altri aimbot se attivi
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot() end
    -- Se e' il Bat Aimbot V2 a chiamarci non spegniamo il V2: e' la sua fase 2.
    if not _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then
        if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2(false) end
    end

    tpBatEnabled = true
    _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn = true

    -- Prenota la no-collision per tutta la durata del TP Bat
    acquireNoCollision()

    -- ============================================================
    -- LOOP PRINCIPALE (Heartbeat):
    --   Solo snap al target + camera + autoswing.
    --   La no-collision e' prenotata una volta sotto, non per-frame.
    -- ============================================================
    -- NO-COLLISION: gestita dal modulo v3 (event-driven), non serve
    -- rifarla ogni frame.
    -- Il dispatcher sceglie la versione (V1..V5) ad ogni frame.
    if tpBatLoopConn then tpBatLoopConn:Disconnect() end
    TPB.orbitAngle = 0
    TPB.spinAngle = 0
    table.clear(TPB.velHist)
    tpBatLoopConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(tpBatFrame)

    -- Rilevamento ragdoll nemici (PlayerAdded + esistenti)
    if tpBatRagdollConn then tpBatRagdollConn:Disconnect() end
    tpBatRagdollConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchEnemyPlayer)
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        watchEnemyPlayer(plr)
    end

    -- Pulizia per-player quando qualcuno esce
    if tpBatResetConn then tpBatResetConn:Disconnect() end
    tpBatResetConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        if tpBatPlayerConns[plr] then
            pcall(function() tpBatPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
            tpBatPlayerConns[plr] = nil
        end
    end)

    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndTPBatSetVisual(true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    saveBl1ndConfig()
    return true
end

function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat()
    tpBatEnabled = false
    _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn = false
    if not (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true) and not (_G.Bl1ndCounterState and _G.Bl1ndCounterState.batDebounce == true) then
        _G.Bl1ndTPBatSilent = false
    end

    -- Disconnetti tutti i loop IMMEDIATAMENTE
    if tpBatLoopConn then
        tpBatLoopConn:Disconnect()
        tpBatLoopConn = nil
    end
    if tpBatRagdollConn then
        tpBatRagdollConn:Disconnect()
        tpBatRagdollConn = nil
    end
    if tpBatResetConn then
        tpBatResetConn:Disconnect()
        tpBatResetConn = nil
    end

    -- Disconnetti tutte le CharacterAdded per-player IMMEDIATAMENTE
    for plr, conn in pairs(tpBatPlayerConns) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(tpBatPlayerConns)

    -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS: azzera lo stato delle logiche V2..V5 <<<
    TPB.orbitAngle = 0
    TPB.spinAngle = 0
    table.clear(TPB.velHist)

    -- Aggiorna UI immediatamente
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndTPBatSetVisual(false) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    saveBl1ndConfig()

    -- Rilascia la prenotazione. Se il toggle No Player Collision e' acceso
    -- il modulo resta attivo; altrimenti ripristina i valori ORIGINALI di
    -- ogni parte (non un CanCollide = true a tappeto).
    task.delay(0.5, function()
        releaseNoCollision()
    end)
end

function _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat()
    -- Toggle manuale: il bottone mobile deve accendersi
    _G.Bl1ndTPBatSilent = false
    if tpBatEnabled then
        _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat()
    else
        _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat()
    end
end


end -- fine do-block tpBat

_G.Bl1ndTPBatOn = false  -- viene aggiornato dalle funzioni

-- ========================================================
-- RAGDOLL DETECTOR PER IL CHASE (Bat Aimbot V1 / V2)
-- Stessa identica logica del detector del TP Bat, ciclo di vita compreso:
-- le connessioni si creano allo start del chase e si staccano allo stop.
-- A chase spento non resta collegato nulla.
-- ========================================================
do
  local chaseRagdollEnabled = false
  local chaseRagdollPlayerConns = {}
  local chaseRagdollAddedConn = nil
  local chaseRagdollRemovingConn = nil

  local function onChaseEnemyRagdollStarted()
    if not chaseRagdollEnabled then return end
    -- Se il TP Bat sta girando comanda il suo detector interno.
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn then return end
    -- Disattivazione ISTANTANEA al rilevamento hit (nessun cooldown)
    if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then
      -- V2: si spegne tutto (chase + TP Bat), non riparte da solo.
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2() end
    elseif _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot() end
    end
  end

  local function setupChaseRagdollDetector(enemyChar)
    local conn = enemyChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then onChaseEnemyRagdollStarted() end
    end)
    return conn
  end

  local function watchChaseEnemyPlayer(plr)
    if plr == LP then return end
    if chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] then
      pcall(function() chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
    end
    chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      if char and chaseRagdollEnabled then
        local detectorConn = setupChaseRagdollDetector(char)
        char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
          if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
        end)
      end
    end)
    if plr.Character then
      local detectorConn = setupChaseRagdollDetector(plr.Character)
      plr.Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
      end)
    end
  end

  -- Avviato da StartNormalAimbot (vale sia per il V1 che per la fase 1 del V2)
  function _G.Bl1ndDuelstartChaseRagdollWatcher()
    if chaseRagdollEnabled then return end
    chaseRagdollEnabled = true
    if chaseRagdollAddedConn then chaseRagdollAddedConn:Disconnect() end
    chaseRagdollAddedConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchChaseEnemyPlayer)
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      watchChaseEnemyPlayer(plr)
    end
    if chaseRagdollRemovingConn then chaseRagdollRemovingConn:Disconnect() end
    chaseRagdollRemovingConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
      if chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] then
        pcall(function() chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
        chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] = nil
      end
    end)
  end

  -- Fermato da StopNormalAimbot / StopBatAimbotV2
  function _G.Bl1ndDuelstopChaseRagdollWatcher()
    chaseRagdollEnabled = false
    if chaseRagdollAddedConn then
      chaseRagdollAddedConn:Disconnect()
      chaseRagdollAddedConn = nil
    end
    if chaseRagdollRemovingConn then
      chaseRagdollRemovingConn:Disconnect()
      chaseRagdollRemovingConn = nil
    end
    for _, conn in pairs(chaseRagdollPlayerConns) do
      pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(chaseRagdollPlayerConns)
  end
end

-- Toggle del TP Bat "manuale" (keybind / bottone mobile).
-- Se il TP Bat attivo appartiene alla fase 2 del Bat Aimbot V2, il V2 viene
-- smontato del tutto e si riparte con un TP Bat normale, cosi' le due logiche
-- non si intrecciano.
function _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBatManual()
  -- Avvio manuale: il bottone mobile deve accendersi
  _G.Bl1ndTPBatSilent = false
  if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2() end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat() end
    return
  end
  if _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat then
    _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat()
  elseif _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat then
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat() else _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat() end
  end
end

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsetupNormalAutoSteal = function()
  _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal or {
    enabled = false,
    radius = 62,
    duration = 1.3,
    animals = {},
    promptCache = {},
    internalCache = {},
    scannerStarted = false,
    scanning = false,
    isStealing = false,
    stealConn = nil,
    refreshThread = nil,
    lastSteal = 0,
    cooldown = 0.08,
  }
  if _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.stealConn then pcall(function() _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.stealConn:Disconnect() end); _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.stealConn = nil end
  _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.enabled = false
  _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.isStealing = false

  local function barProgress(p)
    p = math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState("STEALING")
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(p)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function resetBar()
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end
    end)
  end

  local function getRoot()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
  end

  local function isMyBase(plotName)
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
    if not plot then return false end
    local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local yourBase = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
    return yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled == true
  end

  local function scanPlots()
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    a.animals = {}
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return end
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
      if plot:IsA("Model") and not isMyBase(plot.Name) then
        local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if podiums then
          for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
            if podium:IsA("Model") then
              local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
              local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
              if spawn then
                table.insert(a.animals, {
                  plot = plot.Name,
                  slot = podium.Name,
                  worldPosition = spawn.Position,
                  uid = plot.Name .. "_" .. podium.Name,
                })
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  local function ensureScanner()
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    if a.scannerStarted then return end
    a.scannerStarted = true
    task.spawn(function()
      task.wait(1)
      while _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal do
        if _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.enabled then
          pcall(scanPlots)
        end
        task.wait(3)
      end
    end)
  end

  local function findPrompt(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    local cached = a.promptCache[data.uid]
    if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(data.plot)
    local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    local podium = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(data.slot)
    local base = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    if not attach then return nil end
    for _, prompt in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
      if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        a.promptCache[data.uid] = prompt
        return prompt
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function cacheCallbacks(prompt)
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    if a.internalCache[prompt] then return end
    local data = {hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true}
    pcall(function()
      if getconnections then
        for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
          if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.hold, conn.Function) end
        end
        for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
          if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.trigger, conn.Function) end
        end
      end
    end)
    if #data.hold > 0 or #data.trigger > 0 then
      a.internalCache[prompt] = data
    end
  end

  -- Stesso identico check delle modalita' Semi: distanza dal prompt vivo
  -- (prompt.Parent.Parent = la parte Spawn), non da una posizione salvata.
  local function stillInRange(prompt)
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then return false end
    return (root.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude <= (tonumber(a.radius) or 62)
  end

  local function doSteal(prompt)
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or a.isStealing then return end
    if tick() - (a.lastSteal or 0) < (a.cooldown or 0.08) then return end
    cacheCallbacks(prompt)
    local data = a.internalCache[prompt]
    if not data or not data.ready then return end
    data.ready = false
    a.isStealing = true
    a.lastSteal = tick()
    pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.SetState("STEALING") end end)
    task.spawn(function()
      if #data.hold > 0 then
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end
      end
      local startTime = tick()
      local dur = 1.3
      a.duration = dur
      -- La barra si riempie in 1.25s e resta piena per gli ultimi 0.05s:
      -- cosi' il 100% e' visibile invece di comparire nello stesso frame del reset.
      local fillDur = math.max(dur - 0.05, 0.05)
      local aborted = false
      if _G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersion == "V2" then
        -- >>> AUTO STEAL V2 (Vynx) BEGIN
        -- Riempie fino all'85%, si ferma li' finche' non sei vicino al pet
        -- (8 stud), poi riparte e completa il furto.
        local PAUSE_AT, CLOSE_R, HOLD_MAX, ENTRY_DELAY = 0.85, 8, 2.6, 0.3
        local holdMin = dur * PAUSE_AT
        while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and tick() - startTime < holdMin do
          if not stillInRange(prompt) then aborted = true; break end
          barProgress(((tick() - startTime) / holdMin) * PAUSE_AT)
          task.wait(0.02)
        end
        if not aborted then
          local spawnPart = prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.Parent
          local function closeEnough()
            local r = getRoot()
            return r and spawnPart and spawnPart:IsA("BasePart")
              and (r.Position - spawnPart.Position).Magnitude <= CLOSE_R
          end
          local wasClose = closeEnough()
          local reached = wasClose
          while not reached and a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" do
            if not prompt.Parent or tick() - startTime > HOLD_MAX then aborted = true; break end
            barProgress(PAUSE_AT)
            if closeEnough() then reached = true; break end
            task.wait(0.02)
          end
          if not aborted and not wasClose then task.wait(ENTRY_DELAY) end
          if not aborted then
            local t0, rest = tick(), math.max(dur * (1 - PAUSE_AT), 0.05)
            while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and tick() - t0 < rest do
              barProgress(PAUSE_AT + (1 - PAUSE_AT) * ((tick() - t0) / rest))
              task.wait(0.02)
            end
          end
        end
        -- <<< AUTO STEAL V2 (Vynx) END
      else
      while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and tick() - startTime < dur do
        if not stillInRange(prompt) then
          aborted = true
          break
        end
        barProgress((tick() - startTime) / fillDur)
        task.wait(0.02)
      end
      end
      if aborted or not a.enabled or selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" then
        data.ready = true
        a.isStealing = false
        resetBar()
        return
      end
      barProgress(1)
      if #data.trigger > 0 then
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end
      end
      pcall(function() if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup then _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(1.25) end end)
      -- nessun wait: ripartenza immediata al prossimo Heartbeat
      data.ready = true
      a.isStealing = false
      resetBar()
    end)
  end

  local function nearestAnimal()
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then return nil end
    local radius = tonumber(a.radius) or 62

    -- STESSA SCELTA DEL BERSAGLIO DELLA SEMI.
    -- Prima si guardava la lista costruita dallo scan della Normal, che
    -- contiene TUTTI i podi (anche quelli vuoti), e si usava la
    -- worldPosition salvata al momento della scansione. Due problemi in
    -- uno: si prendeva di mira un podio senza niente sopra, e anche
    -- quando l'animale spariva la posizione vecchia restava buona,
    -- quindi lo steal partiva lo stesso a vuoto.
    -- La lista della Semi nasce invece dall'AnimalList del plot (solo
    -- slot davvero occupati) e la posizione viene risolta ADESSO dal
    -- podio: se non c'e' piu' niente, animalPos ritorna nil e quella
    -- voce non e' un bersaglio.
    -- #list > 0 e non solo "e' una tabella": lo scan condiviso ci mette un
    -- attimo a partire (aspetta ReplicatedStorage), e con la lista ancora
    -- vuota si usciva subito senza bersaglio invece di ripiegare sulla
    -- scansione propria. Era per quello che la Normal sembrava morta
    -- finche' non passavi da Semi e tornavi indietro.
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstealAnimals then
      local list = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealAnimals()
      if type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 then
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, data in ipairs(list) do
          local mine = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealIsMyBase and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealIsMyBase(data)
          local occupied = (not _G.Bl1ndDuelstealSlotOccupied)
                           or _G.Bl1ndDuelstealSlotOccupied(data)
          if not mine and occupied then
            local pos = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealAnimalPos and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealAnimalPos(data)
            if pos then
              local dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
              if dist <= radius and dist < bestDist then
                best, bestDist = data, dist
              end
            end
          end
        end
        return best
      end
    end

    -- Ripiego: la Semi non e' ancora stata inizializzata. Anche qui la
    -- posizione si risolve dal vivo, non dalla worldPosition salvata.
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, data in ipairs(a.animals) do
      if not isMyBase(data.plot) then
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(data.plot)
        local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        local podium = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(data.slot)
        if podium then
          local dist = (root.Position - podium:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
          if dist <= radius and dist < bestDist then
            best, bestDist = data, dist
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end

  _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealSetRadius = function(v)
    _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.radius = tonumber(v) or _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal.radius or 62
  end

  _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealStop = function()
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    a.enabled = false
    a.isStealing = false
    if a.stealConn then a.stealConn:Disconnect(); a.stealConn = nil end
    resetBar()
  end

  _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealStart = function()
    local a = _G.Bl1ndNormalSteal
    a.radius = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or a.radius or 62
    a.duration = 1.3
    a.enabled = true
    ensureScanner()
    pcall(scanPlots)
    -- Lista condivisa con la Semi: va fatta partire, se no resta vuota e
    -- nearestAnimal non ha niente su cui lavorare.
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelstealEnsureScan then pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealEnsureScan) end
    if a.stealConn then a.stealConn:Disconnect(); a.stealConn = nil end
    a.stealConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not a.enabled then return end
      if selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" then _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealStop(); return end
      if a.isStealing then return end
      local target = nearestAnimal()
      if not target then return end
      local prompt = findPrompt(target)
      if prompt then doSteal(prompt) end
    end)
  end

  _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealSync = function()
    if selectedStealMode == "Normal" and autoStealEnabled then
      _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealStart()
    else
      _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealStop()
    end
  end
end

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsetupNormalAutoSteal()

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsetupSemiAutoSteal = function()
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal = _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal or {}
  local A = _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal
  if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end); A.conn = nil end
  A.enabled    = false
  A.cooldown   = A.cooldown   or 0.05
  A.primeRange = A.primeRange or 80
  A.radius     = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or A.radius or 60
  -- applica valori salvati dal config (loadBl1ndConfig gira prima di questo setup)
  local pending = _G._Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending
  A.autoGrabStopTime       = (pending and pending.autoGrabStopTime)       or A.autoGrabStopTime       or 1.29
  A.autoGrabStopPercent    = (pending and pending.autoGrabStopPercent)    or A.autoGrabStopPercent    or 75
  A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = (pending and pending.autoGrabSetDelayRadius) or A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8
  A.autoGrabStopEnabled    = true
  _G._Bl1ndDuelsemiStealPending = nil


  A.conn = A.conn
  A.scanThread = A.scanThread
  A.plotSync = A.plotSync or {caches = {}, connections = {}}
  A.animals = A.animals or {}
  A.promptCache = A.promptCache or {}
  A.internalCache = A.internalCache or {}
  A.state = A.state or {active = false, startTime = 0, phase = "idle", label = "", lastResult = "", lastResultTime = 0}

  local function barSet(p, label)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState(label or "STEALING")
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1))
      end
    end)
  end

  local function barReset()
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end
    end)
  end

  local function rootPart()
    local char = LP.Character
    return char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or nil
  end

  local function splitPath(path)
    if typeof(path) == "table" then return path end
    local out = {}
    for part in string.gmatch(tostring(path), "[^%.]+") do
      table.insert(out, tonumber(part) or part)
    end
    return out
  end

  local function resolvePath(path, root)
    local current, parent, key = root, nil, nil
    for _, part in ipairs(splitPath(path)) do
      parent = current
      key = part
      current = current and current[part] or nil
    end
    return current, parent, key
  end

  local function applySyncDiff(channelName, packet)
    local cache = A.plotSync.caches[channelName]
    if typeof(cache) ~= "table" then return end
    local path, action, a, b = packet[1], packet[2], packet[3], packet[4]
    local current, parent, key = resolvePath(path, cache)
    if action == "Changed" then
      if parent ~= nil then parent[key] = a end
    elseif action == "ArrayInsert" then
      if current ~= nil then table.insert(current, b, a) end
    elseif action == "ArrayRemoved" then
      if current ~= nil then table.remove(current, b) end
    elseif action == "DictionaryInsert" then
      if current ~= nil then current[b] = a end
    elseif action == "DictionaryRemoved" then
      if current ~= nil then current[b] = nil end
    end
  end

  local function attachPlotChannel(remote, plots, requestData)
    if A.plotSync.connections[remote] then return end
    local channelName = tostring(remote.Name)
    if not plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then return end
    if requestData and A.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
      local ok, data = pcall(function() return requestData:InvokeServer(channelName) end)
      A.plotSync.caches[channelName] = (ok and typeof(data) == "table") and data or {}
    elseif A.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
      A.plotSync.caches[channelName] = {}
    end
    A.plotSync.connections[remote] = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(queue)
      for _, packet in ipairs(queue) do applySyncDiff(channelName, packet) end
    end)
  end

  local function ensureSync()
    if A.syncReady then return true end
    local ok = pcall(function()
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      A.packages = rs:WaitForChild("Packages", 10)
      A.datas = rs:WaitForChild("Datas", 10)
      A.plots = workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 10)
      if not (A.packages and A.datas and A.plots) then return end
      A.animalsData = require(A.datas:WaitForChild("Animals", 10))
      local sync = A.packages:WaitForChild("Synchronizer", 10)
      A.channelFolder = sync:WaitForChild("Channel", 10)
      A.routeRemote = sync:WaitForChild("CommunicationRoute", 10)
      A.requestData = sync:FindFirstChild("RequestData")
      for _, child in ipairs(A.channelFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(child, A.plots, A.requestData) end
      end
      A.channelFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(child, A.plots, A.requestData) end
      end)
      A.routeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(actions)
        for _, action in ipairs(actions) do
          local kind, channelName = action[1], tostring(action[2])
          if A.plots and A.plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then
            if kind == "ListenerAdded" then
              local remote = A.channelFolder and A.channelFolder:FindFirstChild(channelName)
              if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(remote, A.plots, A.requestData) end
            elseif kind == "ListenerRemoved" then
              for remote, conn in pairs(A.plotSync.connections) do
                if tostring(remote.Name) == channelName then
                  pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
                  A.plotSync.connections[remote] = nil
                  A.plotSync.caches[channelName] = nil
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      A.syncReady = true
    end)
    return ok and A.syncReady == true
  end

  local function getPlotOwner(plot)
    local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local frame = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
    if not label or label.Text == "Empty Base" then return nil end
    return label.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  end

  local function isMyBaseAnimal(animalData)
    if not animalData or not animalData.plot or not A.plots then return false end
    local plot = A.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
    if not plot then return false end
    local owner = getPlotOwner(plot)
    return owner == LP.DisplayName or owner == LP.Name
  end

  local function podiumFor(animalData)
    local plot = A.plots and A.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
    local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    return podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(animalData.slot) or nil
  end

  local function animalPos(animalData)
    local podium = podiumFor(animalData)
    return podium and podium:GetPivot().Position or nil
  end

  local function distToAnimal(animalData)
    local root = rootPart()
    local pos = animalPos(animalData)
    return root and pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
  end

  local function findPromptForAnimal(animalData)
    if not animalData then return nil end
    local cached = A.promptCache[animalData.uid]
    if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
    local podium = podiumFor(animalData)
    local base = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    if not attach then return nil end
    for _, prompt in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
      if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        A.promptCache[animalData.uid] = prompt
        return prompt
      end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function scanAllPlots()
    if not ensureSync() then return 0 end
    local newCache = {}
    for _, plot in ipairs(A.plots:GetChildren()) do
      local cache = A.plotSync.caches[plot.Name]
      local animalList = cache and cache.AnimalList
      if typeof(animalList) == "table" then
        for slot, animalData in pairs(animalList) do
          if type(animalData) == "table" then
            local animalName = animalData.Index
            local info = A.animalsData and A.animalsData[animalName]
            if info then
              table.insert(newCache, {
                name = info.DisplayName or animalName,
                plot = plot.Name,
                slot = tostring(slot),
                uid = plot.Name .. "_" .. tostring(slot),
              })
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    A.animals = newCache
    return #newCache
  end

  local function pickClosest()
    local root = rootPart()
    if not root then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, animalData in ipairs(A.animals) do
      if not isMyBaseAnimal(animalData) then
        local pos = animalPos(animalData)
        local dist = pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
        if dist <= (A.primeRange or 80) and dist < bestDist then
          best, bestDist = animalData, dist
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end

  local function buildCallbacks(prompt)
    if A.internalCache[prompt] then return end
    local data = {holdCallbacks = {}, triggerCallbacks = {}, ready = true}
    local okHold, holds = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    if okHold and type(holds) == "table" then
      for _, conn in ipairs(holds) do
        if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.holdCallbacks, conn.Function) end
      end
    end
    local okTrigger, triggers = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
    if okTrigger and type(triggers) == "table" then
      for _, conn in ipairs(triggers) do
        if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.triggerCallbacks, conn.Function) end
      end
    end
    if #data.holdCallbacks > 0 or #data.triggerCallbacks > 0 then A.internalCache[prompt] = data end
  end

  -- Valori semi steal
  A.autoGrabStopTime       = A.autoGrabStopTime       or 1.29  -- punto in cui la barra si ferma (V1, secondi)
  A.autoGrabStopPercent    = A.autoGrabStopPercent    or 75    -- punto in cui la barra si ferma (V3, percento)
  A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8     -- raggio trigger del secondo step
  A.autoGrabStopEnabled    = true                              -- sempre attivo
  A.cooldown = A.cooldown or 0.05

  local function executeSemi(prompt, animalData)
    if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not animalData then return false end
    buildCallbacks(prompt)
    local data = A.internalCache[prompt]
    if not data or not data.ready then return false end
    data.ready = false
    A.state.active  = true
    A.state.startTime = tick()
    A.state.phase   = "holding"
    A.state.label   = animalData.name or "Animal"

    task.spawn(function()
      local startTime = A.state.startTime
      local duration  = 1.3  -- durata fase hold (secondi)

      -- avvia hold callbacks
      for _, fn in ipairs(data.holdCallbacks) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end

      -- ====================== MODALITÀ STOP-AND-WAIT ======================
      -- Semi V3: identica alla V1, ma lo stop e' una PERCENTUALE della
      -- barra invece che un tempo in secondi. Si converte qui e da questo
      -- punto in poi il codice e' esattamente lo stesso, quindi anche
      -- l'anticipo di 0.05s della barra sul trigger resta identico.
      local stopTime = A.autoGrabStopTime  -- es. 1.29s
      if selectedSemiMode == "V3" then
        local pct = math.clamp(tonumber(A.autoGrabStopPercent) or 75, 1, 100)
        stopTime = duration * (pct / 100)
      end

      -- fase 1: avanza fino a stopTime
      while A.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Semi" do
        local elapsed = tick() - startTime
        if elapsed >= stopTime then break end
        barSet(math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1), "STEALING")
        local root = rootPart()
        if not root or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then break end
        if (root.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude > (tonumber(A.radius) or 60) then break end
        task.wait()
      end

      local stopProgress = math.clamp(stopTime / duration, 0, 1)
      barSet(stopProgress, "STEALING")

      -- fase 2: aspetta entrata nel delayRadius oppure timeout
      -- Budget contato dall'inizio del ciclo: dai 2.99 si tolgono sia il
      -- tempo gia' speso nella fase 1 (stopTime) sia quello che servira'
      -- per completare la barra (1.3 - stopTime).
      -- stopTime e' sempre in secondi (la V3 converte la % prima di qui),
      -- quindi la formula e' identica per V1 e V3.
      local phase2Timeout = math.max(2.99 - stopTime - math.max(duration - stopTime, 0), 0.05)
      local phase2Start = tick()

      while A.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Semi" do
        if tick() - phase2Start >= phase2Timeout then
          -- timeout: reset e riparti subito
          barReset()
          data.ready = true
          A.state.active = false
          A.state.phase  = "idle"
          executeSemi(prompt, animalData)
          return
        end

        if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then
          barReset()
          data.ready = true
          A.state.active = false
          A.state.phase  = "idle"
          return
        end

        local root = rootPart()
        if root then
          local dist = (root.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude
          if dist <= (A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8) then
            break  -- entrato nel raggio trigger
          elseif dist > (tonumber(A.radius) or 60) then
            barReset()
            data.ready = true
            A.state.active = false
            A.state.phase  = "idle"
            return
          end
        end
        task.wait()
      end

      -- fase 3: completa la barra da stopProgress a 1 e triggera
      if A.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
        -- Costo REALE della fase 3: nessun pavimento a 0.05, altrimenti il
        -- trigger slitta in avanti (con stopTime 1.29 restavano 0.01s ma se
        -- ne pagavano 0.05, quindi lo steal partiva 40ms tardi e il ciclo
        -- sforava la finestra di 2.99s).
        local fillDuration = math.max(duration - stopTime, 0)
        -- I 50ms sono solo l'anticipo VISIVO della barra: vengono presi da
        -- dentro fillDuration, non aggiunti dopo. Se la fase 3 dura meno di
        -- 50ms l'anticipo si accorcia insieme a lei.
        local barLead   = math.min(0.05, fillDuration)
        local fillRamp  = fillDuration - barLead
        local fillStart = tick()
        while true do
          local fp = (fillRamp > 0) and math.clamp((tick() - fillStart) / fillRamp, 0, 1) or 1
          barSet(stopProgress + fp * (1 - stopProgress), "STEALING")
          if fp >= 1 then break end
          task.wait()
        end
        barSet(1, "STEALING")
        if barLead > 0 then task.wait(barLead) end
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.triggerCallbacks) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end
        pcall(function() if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup then _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(1.25) end end)
        A.state.lastResult = "Stole " .. tostring(A.state.label)
      else
        A.state.lastResult = "Cancelled"
      end

      -- cleanup: nessun wait extra, ripartenza immediata
      A.state.active         = false
      A.state.phase          = "idle"
      A.state.lastResultTime = tick()
      data.ready = true
      barReset()
    end)
    return true
  end

  -- ---- lista bersagli condivisa con la modalita' Normal ----
  -- La Normal costruiva una lista sua scorrendo i podi: ci finiva DENTRO
  -- ogni podio esistente, pieno o vuoto che fosse. Questa invece nasce
  -- dall'AnimalList del plot, quindi contiene solo gli slot che hanno
  -- davvero un animale sopra. Esposta su _G perche' il blocco della
  -- Normal sta prima di questo nel file e non vede questi local.
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstealAnimals   = function() return A.animals end
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstealAnimalPos = function(d) return animalPos(d) end
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstealIsMyBase  = function(d) return isMyBaseAnimal(d) end

  -- Lo slot ha ANCORA un animale sopra, adesso.
  -- La lista viene ricostruita ogni 5 secondi, quindi da sola non basta:
  -- un animale appena rubato resta in elenco fino al giro dopo, e il
  -- podio esiste comunque (vuoto), quindi anche la posizione risulta
  -- valida. Le cache dei plot sono invece aggiornate dal vivo dai
  -- RemoteEvent del Synchronizer: chiedendo a loro si sa in quell'istante
  -- se lo slot e' occupato.
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstealSlotOccupied = function(d)
    if not d or not d.plot or not d.slot then return false end
    local cache = A.plotSync and A.plotSync.caches and A.plotSync.caches[d.plot]
    local list = cache and cache.AnimalList
