local normalModeValueLabel = nil
local aimbotButtonLabel = nil
local aimbotSpeedLabel = nil
local laggerAimbotSpeedLabel = nil
local combatAimbotKeybindLabel = nil


function getAimbotModeDisplay()
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    return "Bat Aimbot V2"
  end
  return "Bat Aimbot V1"
end

function refreshAimbotButtonLabel()
  if aimbotButtonLabel then
    aimbotButtonLabel.Text = getAimbotModeDisplay()
  end
end

function refreshAimbotModeLabels()
  local modeName = getAimbotModeDisplay()
  if aimbotSpeedLabel then
    aimbotSpeedLabel.Text = modeName .. " Speed"
  end
  if laggerAimbotSpeedLabel then
    laggerAimbotSpeedLabel.Text = modeName .. " Lagger Speed"
  end
  if combatAimbotKeybindLabel then
    combatAimbotKeybindLabel.Text = modeName
  end
  refreshAimbotButtonLabel()
  -- Aggiorna il testo del bottone mobile aimbot
  pcall(function()
    local mobileButtons = _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonRefs
    local aimbotEntry = mobileButtons and mobileButtons.aimbot
    local aimbotMobileBtn = aimbotEntry and aimbotEntry.btn
    if aimbotMobileBtn then
      aimbotMobileBtn.Text = (selectedAimbotMode == "V2") and "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV2" or "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV1"
    end
  end)
  -- Stessa versione anche nella lista Hide Mobile Buttons
  if _G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot then pcall(_G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot) end
  -- ...e nel segmento di sinistra dell'Auto After Drop
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAfterDropSelector then pcall(_G.Bl1ndRefreshAfterDropSelector) end
end

refreshSpeedModeRows = function()
  if normalModeValueLabel then
    -- Mostra la modalità corrente completa
    normalModeValueLabel.Text = currentSpeedMode
  end
end

-- MODE ROW COMBINATA (rimossa la seconda)
function modeDisplayRow(parent, order)
  local row = baseRow(parent, "Mode", order)
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
  -- Qui c'era BackgroundTransparency = 0.42, che sovrascriveva lo 0.3 di
  -- baseRow: la riga nasceva piu' chiara di tutte le altre e diventava
  -- uguale solo dopo il primo passaggio del mouse, perche' e' il MouseLeave
  -- di baseRow a riportarla a 0.3.
  local label = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
  if label then
    label.Text = "Mode"
    label.TextSize = 13
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    label.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  end
  local value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  value.Name = "ModeValue"
  value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  value.Text = currentSpeedMode
  value.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  value.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  value.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
  value.TextSize = 12
  value.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
  value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
  value.Position = UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 0)
  value.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0)
  value.ZIndex = 6
  value.Parent = row
  local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
  click.Name = "ModeClick"
  click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  click.Text = ""
  click.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  click.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  click.AutoButtonColor = false
  click.ZIndex = 8
  click.Parent = row
  normalModeValueLabel = value
  click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local mode = currentSpeedMode
    if mode == "Normal" then
      setSpeedMode("Carry")
    elseif mode == "Carry" then
      setSpeedMode("Normal")
    elseif mode == "Lagger" then
      setSpeedMode("Lagger Carry")
    elseif mode == "Lagger Carry" then
      setSpeedMode("Lagger")
    else
      setSpeedMode("Normal")
    end
  end)
  refreshSpeedModeRows()
  return row, value
end

function aimbotModeButtonRow(parent, order)
  local row, setVisual = toggleRow(parent, getAimbotModeDisplay(), false, order)
  aimbotButtonLabel = row and row:FindFirstChild("Label")
  _G.Bl1ndAimbotSetVisual = setVisual
  refreshAimbotButtonLabel()
  if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  _Bl1ndBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _Bl1ndBtn then
    _Bl1ndBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
      if _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot then _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot() end
    end)
  end
  return row, setVisual
end

    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  slideGradient.Parent = slide
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(slide, slideGradient, "slide")
  slideGradient.Rotation = 22

  local v1Text = Instance.new("TextLabel")

  v1Text.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  v1Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

  v1Text.Parent = holder

  local v2Text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  v2Text.Name = "V2Text"
  v2Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  v2Text.Text = "BAT AIMBOT V2"
  v2Text.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  v2Text.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  v2Text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
  v2Text.TextSize = 10
  v2Text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
  v2Text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  v2Text.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  v2Text.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  v2Text.ZIndex = 8
  v2Text.Parent = holder

  local v1Click = Instance.new("TextButton")
  v1Click.Name = "V1Click"
  v1Click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  v1Click.Text = ""
  v1Click.AutoButtonColor = false
  v1Click.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  v1Click.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  v1Click.ZIndex = 10
  v1Click.Parent = holder

  local v2Click = Instance.new("TextButton")
  v2Click.Name = "V2Click"
  v2Click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  v2Click.Text = ""
  v2Click.AutoButtonColor = false
  v2Click.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  v2Click.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  v2Click.ZIndex = 10
  v2Click.Parent = holder

  local function setMode(mode)
    -- accetta anche i vecchi nomi salvati nelle config precedenti
    if mode == "Bypass" or mode == "Anti Bypass" then
      mode = "V2"
    elseif mode ~= "V2" then
      mode = "V1"
    end
    selectedAimbotMode = mode
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotChaseRows then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotChaseRows() end   -- >>> AIMBOT CHASE MODE <<<
    refreshAimbotModeLabels()

      TextTransparency = onV2 and 0.5 or 0,

    tween(v2Text, {
      TextTransparency = onV2 and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onV2 and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end

    setMode("V1")
  end)
  v2Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setMode("V2")
  end)
  setMode(selectedAimbotMode)
  return holder, setMode
end

  slideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  slideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  slideStroke.Parent = slide
  local slideGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  slideGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
  })
  slideGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  slideGradient.Parent = slide
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(slide, slideGradient, "slide")
  slideGradient.Rotation = 22

  local normalText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  normalText.Name = "NormalText"
  normalText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  normalText.Text = "NORMAL"
  normalText.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  normalText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  normalText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
  normalText.TextSize = 11
  normalText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
  normalText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  normalText.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  normalText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  normalText.ZIndex = 8
  normalText.Parent = holder

  local semiText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  semiText.Name = "SemiText"
  semiText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  semiText.Text = "SEMI"
  semiText.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  semiText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  semiText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
  semiText.TextSize = 11
  semiText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
  semiText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  semiText.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  semiText.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  semiText.ZIndex = 8
  semiText.Parent = holder

  local normalClick = Instance.new("TextButton")
  normalClick.Name = "NormalClick"
  normalClick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  normalClick.Text = ""
  normalClick.AutoButtonColor = false
  normalClick.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  normalClick.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  normalClick.ZIndex = 10
  normalClick.Parent = holder

  local semiClick = Instance.new("TextButton")
  semiClick.Name = "SemiClick"
  semiClick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  semiClick.Text = ""
  semiClick.AutoButtonColor = false
  semiClick.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  semiClick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  semiClick.ZIndex = 10
  semiClick.Parent = holder

  local function setMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "Semi" then
      mode = "Normal"
    end
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii or {Normal = 62, Semi = 60, SemiV2Radius = 60, SemiV2SemiRadius = 8}
    -- Salva il radius corrente nel slot giusto prima di cambiare modo
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      -- non sovrascriviamo autoStealRadius per V2 (usa SemiV2Radius separato)
    else
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii[selectedStealMode] = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii[selectedStealMode]
    end
    selectedStealMode = mode
    -- Aggiorna il radiusBox con il valore corretto per il nuovo modo
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
      end
    else
      autoStealRadius = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii[selectedStealMode] or ((selectedStealMode == "Semi") and 60 or 62)
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius)
      end
    end
    -- Tween visivo PRIMA delle operazioni pesanti, cosi il rettangolo si muove subito
    local onSemi = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
    tween(slide, {
      Position = onSemi and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(normalText, {
      TextTransparency = onSemi and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onSemi and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(semiText, {
      TextTransparency = onSemi and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onSemi and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
    -- Mostra/nasconde subito i row Semi (sincrono, prima dello spawn)
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows then _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows() end
    -- Operazioni pesanti in background (saveConfig + sync con possibili WaitForChild/InvokeServer)
    -- cosi non bloccano il thread e non ritardano il tween
    task.spawn(function()
      saveBl1ndConfig()
      if _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealSetRadius then _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealSetRadius(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal or 62) end
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiAutoStealSetRadius then _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiAutoStealSetRadius(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi or 60) end
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2SetRadius then _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2SetRadius(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60) end
      if _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync then _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync() end
    end)
  end

  normalClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setMode("Normal")
  end)
  semiClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setMode("Semi")
  end)
  setMode(selectedStealMode)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsetStealMode = setMode
  return holder, setMode
end

    local isSoft = (mode == "SOFT")
    tween(acSlide, {
      Position = isSoft and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(acNormalText, {
      TextTransparency = isSoft and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isSoft and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(acSoftText, {
      TextTransparency = isSoft and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isSoft and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end

  local function setACMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "SOFT" then mode = "NORMAL" end
    if _G._Bl1ndAutoCarryMode ~= mode then
      -- Cambio mode: sblocca e ripristina la mode salvata, cosi' non resta stato sporco
      _G._Bl1ndAS.locked = false
      _G._Bl1ndAS.wasLow = false
      if _G._Bl1ndAS.savedMode then
        _G._Bl1ndAS.restoring = true
        pcall(function() setSpeedMode(_G._Bl1ndAS.savedMode) end)
        _G._Bl1ndAS.restoring = false
        _G._Bl1ndAS.savedMode = nil
      end
      _G._Bl1ndAutoCarrySoft.lastScan = 0
    end
    _G._Bl1ndAutoCarryMode = mode
    applyACModeVisual(mode)
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end

  _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector = function()
    applyACModeVisual(_G._Bl1ndAutoCarryMode or "NORMAL")
  end

  local function setExpandedAC(expanded)
    acModeExpanded = expanded
    _G._Bl1ndExpand(acHolder, expanded, 42, acArrow)
  end

  acArrow.Activated:Connect(function()
    setExpandedAC(not acModeExpanded)
  end)
  acNormalClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setACMode("NORMAL")
  end)
  acSoftClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setACMode("SOFT")
  end)

  applyACModeVisual(_G._Bl1ndAutoCarryMode or "NORMAL")

-- Auto Carry Speed toggle (ordine 6, prima di Mode)
_, setAutoCarrySpeedVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Auto Carry Speed", autoCarrySpeedEnabled, 6)
do
  local row = Movement:FindFirstChild("Auto Carry Speed")
  _Bl1ndBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _Bl1ndBtn then
    _Bl1ndBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
      autoCarrySpeedEnabled = not autoCarrySpeedEnabled
      if autoCarrySpeedEnabled ~= true then
        if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.Disable then
          _G.AutoCarrySpeed.Disable()
        end
        -- Reset stato auto switch to carry
        _G._Bl1ndAS.locked = false
        _G._Bl1ndAS.wasLow = false
        if _G._Bl1ndAS.savedMode then
          _G._Bl1ndAS.restoring = true
          setSpeedMode(_G._Bl1ndAS.savedMode)
          _G._Bl1ndAS.restoring = false
          _G._Bl1ndAS.savedMode = nil
        end
      end
      if setAutoCarrySpeedVisual then setAutoCarrySpeedVisual(autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true) end
      saveBl1ndConfig()
    end)
  end
  if row then
    _G._Bl1ndBuildAutoCarryModeSelector(row, Movement)
  end
end

do
  local autoTPButton = autoTPRow and autoTPRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if autoTPButton then
    autoTPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if autoTPClickDebounce then return end
      autoTPClickDebounce = true
      local nextState = not autoTPEnabled
      toggleAutoTP(nextState)
      task.delay(0.15, function()
        autoTPClickDebounce = false
        if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled) end
      end)
    end)
  end
  if autoTPEnabled then
    startAutoTP()
  else
    stopAutoTP()
  end
end

-- Riga "TP Down Method": solo etichetta + freccetta, nessun toggle.
-- Aprendola compare lo slider NORMAL / SLOW FALL / ZIGZAG.
_G._Bl1ndBuildTPDownMethodSelector = function(parentFrame, rowOrder, holderOrder)
  local row = baseRow(parentFrame, "TP Down Method", rowOrder)

  local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
  arrow.Name = "TPDownMethodArrow"
  arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
  arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
  arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
  arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 24)
  arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -12)
  arrow.Text = "\u{25B2}"
  arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
  arrow.TextSize = 15
  arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
  arrow.ZIndex = 8
  arrow.Parent = row
  corner(arrow, 7)
  stroke(arrow, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)

  local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
  holder.Name = "TP Down Method Selector"
  holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
  holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
  holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  holder.LayoutOrder = holderOrder
  holder.ZIndex = 4
  holder.ClipsDescendants = true
  holder.Visible = false
  holder.Parent = parentFrame
  corner(holder, 14)
  stroke(holder, Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175), 1.4, 0.32)
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(holder, nil, "soft")

  -- Tre segmenti: NORMAL, SLOW FALL, ZIGZAG.
  local TPM_MODES = {"NORMAL", "SLOW", "ZIGZAG"}
  local TPM_TEXT  = {"NORMAL", "SLOW FALL", "ZIGZAG"}
  local TPM_N = #TPM_MODES
  local tpmW = 1 / TPM_N

  local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
  slide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
  slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)
  slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
  slide.Size = UDim2.new(tpmW, -8, 1, -8)
  slide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
  slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
  slide.ZIndex = 5
  slide.Parent = holder
  corner(slide, 13)
  local slideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  slideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  slideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
  slideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  slideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  slideStroke.Parent = slide
  local slideGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  slideGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
  })
  slideGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  slideGrad.Rotation = 22
  slideGrad.Parent = slide
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(slide, slideGrad, "slide")

  local tpmTexts = {}

  local function applyVisual(mode)
    local idx = 1
    for i, m in ipairs(TPM_MODES) do if m == mode then idx = i break end end
    tween(slide, {
      Position = UDim2.new(tpmW * (idx - 1), 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    for i, t in ipairs(tpmTexts) do
      local sel = (i == idx)
      tween(t, {
        TextTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.5,
        TextStrokeTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.38
      }, 0.14)
    end
  end

  local function setMode(mode)
    local ok = false
    for _, m in ipairs(TPM_MODES) do if m == mode then ok = true break end end
    if not ok then mode = "NORMAL" end
    _G._Bl1ndTPDownMethod = mode
    applyVisual(mode)
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end

  for i, mode in ipairs(TPM_MODES) do
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = TPM_TEXT[i]
    t.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    t.TextSize = 11
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    t.Size = UDim2.new(tpmW, 0, 1, 0)
    t.Position = UDim2.new(tpmW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    t.ZIndex = 8
    t.Parent = holder
    tpmTexts[i] = t

    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    b.Text = ""
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.Size = UDim2.new(tpmW, 0, 1, 0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(tpmW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    b.ZIndex = 10
    b.Parent = holder
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode(mode) end)
  end

  local expanded = false
  arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
    expanded = not expanded
    _G._Bl1ndExpand(holder, expanded, 42, arrow)
  end)

  _G.Bl1ndRefreshTPDownMethodSelector = function()
    applyVisual(_G._Bl1ndTPDownMethod or "NORMAL")
  end
  applyVisual(_G._Bl1ndTPDownMethod or "NORMAL")
end

_G._Bl1ndBuildTPDownMethodSelector(Movement, 8, 8)

        _G.Bl1ndTPRagdoll.set(not _G.Bl1ndTPRagdollEnabled)
      end

_, _SV.setAntiDieVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Anti Die", antiDieEnabled, 17)
do
  local row = Movement:FindFirstChild("Anti Die")
  _Bl1ndBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _Bl1ndBtn then
    _Bl1ndBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
      local wanted = _G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted == true

      -- Riga spenta ma Anti Die gia' acceso in background da un modulo: il
      -- click non spegne, te lo fa ADOTTARE. Da qui in poi e' roba tua e
      -- resta acceso anche quando il modulo finisce.
      if not wanted and _G._Bl1ndAntiDieAutoOn then
        _G._Bl1ndAntiDieAutoOn = false
        _G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted = true
        antiDieEnabled = true
        if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(true) end
        saveBl1ndConfig()
        return
      end

      -- Tentativo di spegnere il TUO Anti Die mentre un modulo ci conta
      -- sopra: si ignora e si rimette il visivo su ON, cosi' il bottone
      -- sembra bloccato invece di lampeggiare e tornare indietro.
      if wanted and _G.Bl1ndAntiDieLocked and _G.Bl1ndAntiDieLocked() then
        if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(true) end
        return
      end

      setAntiDie(not wanted)
      if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(_G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted == true) end
      saveBl1ndConfig()
    end)
  end
end

-- Costruisce una riga "<nome> Color" a tendina, identica a quella del
-- Tracker Color: freccetta sulla riga indicata, pallino di anteprima e
-- bottone PICK che apre il popup con la palette + i campi RGB.
--
-- cfg = {
--   parent    = frame della tab
--   anchorRow = riga su cui mettere la freccetta
--   rowName   = testo della riga (es. "Tracker Color")
--   rowOrder  = LayoutOrder della riga
--   title     = titolo del popup (es. "TRACKER COLOR")
--   getColor  = function() -> Color3      (colore corrente)
--   onColor   = function(Color3)          (applica il nuovo colore)
-- }
-- Ritorna: row, setPreview(Color3)
_G._Bl1ndBuildColorPickerRow = function(cfg)
  local row = baseRow(cfg.parent, cfg.rowName, cfg.rowOrder)
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
  row.ClipsDescendants = true
  row.Visible = false

  -- ---- FRECCETTA SULLA RIGA PADRE ----
  if cfg.anchorRow then
    local expanded = false
    local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
    arrow.Name = "ColorArrow"
    arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
    arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
    arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 24)
    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, -12)
    arrow.Text = "\u{25B2}"
    arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    arrow.TextSize = 15
    arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
    arrow.ZIndex = 8
    arrow.Parent = cfg.anchorRow
    corner(arrow, 7)
    stroke(arrow, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)
    arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
      expanded = not expanded
      _G._Bl1ndExpand(row, expanded, 42, arrow)
    end)
  end

  -- ---- PALLINO DI ANTEPRIMA ----
  local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
  preview.Name = "ColorPreview"
  preview.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
  preview.Position = UDim2.new(1, -114, 0.5, -14)
  preview.BackgroundColor3 = cfg.getColor() or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
  preview.BorderSizePixel = 0
  preview.ZIndex = 6

  local pickBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  pickBtn.Name = "ColorButton"
  pickBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  pickBtn.Text = "PICK"
  pickBtn.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
  pickBtn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  pickBtn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3

  pickBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

      end)
    end

    setPreview(c)
    if cfg.onColor then cfg.onColor(c) end
  end

  pickBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    if pickerGui and pickerGui.Parent then
      closePicker()
      return

    pickerGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    pickerGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    pickerGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

    titleBar.Parent = pickerFrame
    corner(titleBar, 16)

    titleLabel.Name = "Title"
    titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
    titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
    titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    titleLabel.Text = cfg.title or "COLOR"
    titleLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    titleLabel.TextSize = 15
    titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    titleLabel.ZIndex = 4
    titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

    local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    closeBtn.Name = "CloseBtn"
    closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
    closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 6)
    closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28)
    closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    closeBtn.Text = "X"
    closeBtn.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver

      tween(closeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)}, 0.12)
    end)
    closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      tween(closeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28)}, 0.12)
    end)
    closeBtn.Activated:Connect(closePicker)

    local currentPreview = Instance.new("Frame")
    currentPreview.Name = "CurrentPreview"
    currentPreview.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64)
    currentPreview.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -32, 0, 60)
    currentPreview.BackgroundColor3 = preview.BackgroundColor3
    currentPreview.BorderSizePixel = 0
    currentPreview.ZIndex = 3
    currentPreview.Parent = pickerFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", currentPreview).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local cpStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    cpStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
    cpStroke.Thickness = 2
    cpStroke.Transparency = 0.2
    cpStroke.Parent = currentPreview

    local colorGrid = Instance.new("Frame")
    colorGrid.Name = "ColorGrid"
    colorGrid.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 240)
    colorGrid.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 140)
    colorGrid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    colorGrid.BorderSizePixel = 0
    colorGrid.ZIndex = 3
    colorGrid.Parent = pickerFrame

    local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
    gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
    gridLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    gridLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    gridLayout.Parent = colorGrid

    for i, color in ipairs(_G.Bl1ndColorPresets) do
      local cBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      cBtn.Name = "Color_" .. i
      cBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      cBtn.BackgroundColor3 = color
      cBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
      cBtn.Text = ""
      cBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
      cBtn.LayoutOrder = i
      cBtn.ZIndex = 4
      cBtn.Parent = colorGrid
      Instance.new("UICorner", cBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

      local cGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
      cGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, color),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color),
      })
      cGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),

      cGrad.Rotation = 125
      cGrad.Parent = cBtn

      local cStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
      cStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
      cStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
      cStroke.Thickness = 1.5
      cStroke.Transparency = 0.65
      cStroke.Parent = cBtn

      cBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(cBtn, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0, -4)}, 0.12)
        tween(cStroke, {Transparency = 0, Thickness = 2.6}, 0.12)
      end)
      cBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(cBtn, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}, 0.12)
        tween(cStroke, {Transparency = 0.65, Thickness = 1.5}, 0.12)
      end)
      cBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        applyColor(color)
        currentPreview.BackgroundColor3 = color
        closePicker()
      end)
    end

    local rgbFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    rgbFrame.Name = "RGBFrame"
    rgbFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 36)
    rgbFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -52)
    rgbFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    rgbFrame.ZIndex = 3
    rgbFrame.Parent = pickerFrame

    local rBox = Instance.new("TextBox")

    rBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)

    gBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)

    gBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)

    gBox.Parent = rgbFrame

    stroke(gBox, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100), 1, 0.4)

    local bBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    bBox.Name = "B"
    bBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)
    bBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 0)
    bBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
    bBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(preview.BackgroundColor3.B * 255))
    bBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255)
    bBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    bBox.TextSize = 13
    bBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    bBox.ZIndex = 4
    bBox.Parent = rgbFrame
    corner(bBox, 8)
    stroke(bBox, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255), 1, 0.4)

    local function applyRGB()
      local r = math.clamp(tonumber(rBox.Text) or 0, 0, 255)
      local g = math.clamp(tonumber(gBox.Text) or 0, 0, 255)
      local b = math.clamp(tonumber(bBox.Text) or 0, 0, 255)
      local newColor = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
      applyColor(newColor)
      currentPreview.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
      rBox.Text = tostring(r)
      gBox.Text = tostring(g)
      bBox.Text = tostring(b)
    end

    rBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)
    gBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)
    bBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)

    backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
         or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

section(Combat, "AUTO STEAL", 1)
autoStealSelectorRow(Combat, 2)
_Bl1ndRow, setAutoStealVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Auto Steal", autoStealEnabled, 3)
do
  _Bl1ndBtn = _Bl1ndRow and _Bl1ndRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _Bl1ndBtn then
    _Bl1ndBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
      autoStealEnabled = not autoStealEnabled
      if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled) end
      if _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync then _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync() end
      saveBl1ndConfig()
    end)
  end
end

_, radiusBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Radius", tostring(autoStealRadius), 4)
autoStealRadiusBox = radiusBox
-- Corregge il valore iniziale del box in base al modo caricato dal config
if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
  radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
  radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi or 60)
else
  radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal or 62)
end
radiusBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
  local v = tonumber(radiusBox.Text)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii or {Normal = 62, Semi = 60, SemiV2Radius = 60, SemiV2SemiRadius = 8}
  if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
    -- In V2: Radius = prime range (PRIME_RANGE)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius = v
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2SetRadius then _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2SetRadius(v) end
    end
    radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
  else
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      autoStealRadius = v
    end
    _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii[selectedStealMode] = autoStealRadius
    radiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius)
    if _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealSetRadius then _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoStealSetRadius(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Normal or 62) end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiAutoStealSetRadius then _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiAutoStealSetRadius(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi or 60) end
  end
  if _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync then _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync() end
  saveBl1ndConfig()
end)

-- ===== SEMI SUB-MODE SELECTOR (V1 / V2 / V3) — visibile solo in modalità Semi =====
;(function()
  -- Costruiamo il row slider SEMI V1 / SEMI V2 / SEMI V3 identico allo stile di autoStealSelectorRow
  local semiSubHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
  semiSubHolder.Name = "Semi Sub Mode"
  semiSubHolder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
  semiSubHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  semiSubHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
  semiSubHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  semiSubHolder.LayoutOrder = 2.5
  semiSubHolder.ZIndex = 4
  semiSubHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
  semiSubHolder.Visible = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
  semiSubHolder.Parent = Combat
  corner(semiSubHolder, 14)
  stroke(semiSubHolder, Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175), 1.4, 0.32)
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(semiSubHolder, nil, "soft")

  local subSlide = Instance.new("Frame")
  subSlide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
  subSlide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)
  subSlide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
  subSlide.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -3, 1, -8)
  subSlide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
  subSlide.BorderSizePixel = 0
  subSlide.ZIndex = 5
  subSlide.Parent = semiSubHolder
  corner(subSlide, 13)
  local subSlideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  subSlideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  subSlideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
  subSlideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  subSlideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  subSlideStroke.Parent = subSlide
  local subSlideGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  subSlideGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
  })
  subSlideGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  subSlideGradient.Parent = subSlide
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(subSlide, subSlideGradient, "slide")
  subSlideGradient.Rotation = 22

  local SEMI_MODES = {"V1", "V2", "V3"}
  local semiSegW = 1 / #SEMI_MODES
  local semiTexts = {}

  for i, m in ipairs(SEMI_MODES) do
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Name = m .. "Text"
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = "SEMI " .. m
    lbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(semiSegW, 0, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(semiSegW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    lbl.ZIndex = 8
    lbl.Parent = semiSubHolder
    semiTexts[i] = lbl

    local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
    click.Name = m .. "Click"
    click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    click.Text = ""
    click.AutoButtonColor = false
    click.Size = UDim2.new(semiSegW, 0, 1, 0)
    click.Position = UDim2.new(semiSegW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    click.ZIndex = 10
    click.Parent = semiSubHolder
    local _m = m
    click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSemiSubMode then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSemiSubMode(_m) end
    end)
  end

  local function semiIndexOf(mode)
    for i, m in ipairs(SEMI_MODES) do
      if m == mode then return i end
    end
    return 1
  end

  -- Durata fissa come gli altri slider dell'hub: piu' e' lontano il
  -- segmento, piu' veloce si muove la slide.
  local function applySemiSubVisual(mode)
    local idx = semiIndexOf(mode)
    tween(subSlide, {
      Position = UDim2.new(semiSegW * (idx - 1), (idx == 1) and 4 or -1, 0, 4),
      Size = UDim2.new(semiSegW, -3, 1, -8),
    }, 0.18)
    for i, lbl in ipairs(semiTexts) do
      local sel = (i == idx)
      tween(lbl, {
        TextTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.5,
        TextStrokeTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.38
      }, 0.14)
    end
  end

  -- V1 e V3 usano lo stesso motore, quindi condividono anche il Radius
  -- (slot "Semi"). Solo la V2 ha il suo SemiV2Radius.
  local function applySemiRadiusBox()
    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring((_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2Radius) or 60)
      end
    else
      autoStealRadius = (_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.Semi) or 60
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius)
      end
    end
  end

  local function setSemiSubModeVisualOnly(mode)
    if mode ~= "V2" and mode ~= "V3" then mode = "V1" end
    selectedSemiMode = mode
    applySemiSubVisual(selectedSemiMode)
    applySemiRadiusBox()
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows then _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows() end
  end

  local function setSemiSubMode(mode)
    setSemiSubModeVisualOnly(mode)
    task.spawn(function()
      saveBl1ndConfig()
      if _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync then _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync() end
    end)
  end

  setSemiSubModeVisualOnly(selectedSemiMode)

  _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSubHolder = semiSubHolder
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSemiSubMode = setSemiSubMode
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSemiSubModeVisual = setSemiSubModeVisualOnly
end)()

    lbl.Text = "STEAL " .. m
    lbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    lbl.ZIndex = 8
    lbl.Parent = holder
    texts[i] = lbl
    local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
    click.Name = m .. "Click"
    click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    click.Text = ""
    click.AutoButtonColor = false
    click.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    click.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    click.ZIndex = 10
    click.Parent = holder
    local _m = m
    click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if _G.Bl1ndSetNormalStealVersion then _G.Bl1ndSetNormalStealVersion(_m) end
    end)
  end

  local function applyVisual(v)
    local idx = (v == "V2") and 2 or 1
    tween(slide, {Position = (idx == 2) and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)}, 0.18)
    for i, lbl in ipairs(texts) do
      local sel = (i == idx)
      tween(lbl, {TextTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.5, TextStrokeTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.38}, 0.14)
    end
  end

  _G.Bl1ndSetNormalStealVersion = function(v)
    _G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersion = (v == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
    applyVisual(_G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersion)
    task.spawn(function() saveBl1ndConfig() end)
  end
  applyVisual(_G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersion)
  _G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersionHolder = holder
end)()

-- ===== SEMI STEAL SETTINGS (visibili solo in modalità Semi) =====
;(function()
  local A = _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSteal

  local function getSemi(key, def)
    return A and A[key] or def
  end
  local function setSemi(key, val)
    if A then A[key] = val end
  end

  -- Delay Radius (4.1) — raggio entro cui scatta il trigger nella fase 2 (Semi V1)
  local _, delayRadBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Delay Radius", tostring(getSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", 8)), 4.1)
  _G.Bl1ndDelayRadBox = delayRadBox
  delayRadBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(delayRadBox.Text)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      setSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", v)
    end
    delayRadBox.Text = tostring(getSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", 8))
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end)

  -- Stop Time (4.2) — barra si ferma qui prima di aspettare il raggio (Semi V1)
  local _, stopTimeBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Stop Time (s)", tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopTime", 1.29)), 4.2)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTimeBox = stopTimeBox
  stopTimeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(stopTimeBox.Text)
    -- Tetto a 1.29s: oltre, la barra resterebbe ferma a 100% e il trigger
    -- diventerebbe istantaneo, che non e' il comportamento voluto per la V1.
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 1.29 then
      setSemi("autoGrabStopTime", v)
    end
    stopTimeBox.Text = tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopTime", 1.29))
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end)

  -- Stop Time % (4.25) — come sopra ma espresso in percentuale di riempimento
  -- della barra (Semi V3). Il motore e' lo stesso della V1: la percentuale
  -- viene convertita in secondi dentro executeSemi.
  local _, stopPctBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Stop Time (%)", tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopPercent", 75)), 4.25)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstopPctBox = stopPctBox
  stopPctBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(stopPctBox.Text)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 100 then
      setSemi("autoGrabStopPercent", v)
    end
    stopPctBox.Text = tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopPercent", 75))
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end)

  -- Semi Radius (4.15) — steal range per Semi V2 (= STEAL_RANGE nel vecchio CONFIG)
  local semiV2RadDefault = tostring(tonumber(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8)
  local _, semiV2RadBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Semi Radius", semiV2RadDefault, 4.15)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2RadBox = semiV2RadBox
  semiV2RadBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(semiV2RadBox.Text)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii or {}
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius = v
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2SetSemiRadius then _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiV2SetSemiRadius(v) end
    end
    semiV2RadBox.Text = tostring((_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8)
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end)

  -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE BEGIN
  -- Toggle "Radius Circle": disegna un cerchio viola alla base dei piedi
  -- con il raggio che conta davvero nella modalita' selezionata:
  --   Semi V1 / V3 -> Delay Radius
  --   Semi V2      -> Semi Radius
  -- Serve a capire a occhio quando si e' dentro il raggio di trigger.
  local rcPart = nil
  local rcConn = nil

  local function rcRadius()
    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      return tonumber(_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8
    end
    return tonumber(getSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", 8)) or 8
  end

  local function rcDestroy()
    if rcConn then pcall(function() rcConn:Disconnect() end); rcConn = nil end
    if rcPart then pcall(function() rcPart:Destroy() end); rcPart = nil end
  end

  -- Le versioni precedenti creavano anche un secondo disco ("...Rim")
  -- appeso alla camera. Rieseguendo lo script quello restava li' e si
  -- vedeva ancora l'anello: qui si spazza via qualunque residuo.
  local function rcClearStray()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    for _, o in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do
      if o ~= rcPart and typeof(o) == "Instance"
         and string.sub(o.Name, 1, 20) == "Bl1ndRadiusCircl" then
        pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
      end
    end
  end

  local function rcEnsurePart()
    if rcPart and rcPart.Parent then return rcPart end
    rcClearStray()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = "Bl1ndRadiusCircle"
    p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    p.Anchored = true
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.CanQuery = false
    p.CanTouch = false
    p.CastShadow = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    p.Color = _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleColor or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
    p.Transparency = 0.72
    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 2, 2)
    -- Parent alla camera: resta puramente locale e fuori dai query di workspace.
    p.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
    rcPart = p
    return p
  end

  local function rcStep()
    if not (_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled == true) then rcDestroy() return end
    -- Solo in modalita' Semi: fuori di li' il raggio non vuol dire niente.
    if selectedStealMode ~= "Semi" then
      if rcPart then rcPart.Transparency = 1 end
      return
    end
    local char = LP.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp then
      if rcPart then rcPart.Transparency = 1 end
      return
    end
    local p = rcEnsurePart()
    p.Transparency = 0.72
    local d = math.clamp(rcRadius(), 0.5, 500) * 2
    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, d, d)

    -- Quota: dai piedi del personaggio, come in origine.
    local footY = hrp.Position.Y - (hrp.Size.Y * 0.5) - ((hum and hum.HipHeight) or 2)

    -- Atterrando il personaggio schiaccia e rimbalza di qualche centesimo:
    -- con un margine minimo dal suolo il disco ci finiva sotto per un frame
    -- e sembrava sparire. Si smorzano SOLO gli sbalzi piccoli (sotto 1.5
    -- stud, cioe' il rimbalzo); salti e dislivelli veri restano istantanei.
    local prev = _G._AmbRCLastY
    if prev and math.abs(footY - prev) < 1.5 then
      footY = prev + (footY - prev) * 0.4
    end
    _G._AmbRCLastY = footY

    -- Cylinder e' orientato lungo X: lo si ruota per appoggiarlo a terra.
    p.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, footY + 0.2, hrp.Position.Z)
              * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
  end

  local function rcSetEnabled(on)
    _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled = on and true or false
    if _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled then
      if not rcConn then
        rcConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
          local ok = pcall(rcStep)
          if not ok and rcPart then rcPart.Transparency = 1 end
        end)
      end
    else
      rcDestroy()
    end
  end
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircle = rcSetEnabled

  -- Colore del cerchio: applicato subito anche se e' gia' a schermo.
  _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircleColor = function(c)
    if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return end
    _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleColor = c
    if rcPart and rcPart.Parent then
      pcall(function() rcPart.Color = c end)
    end
  end

  -- La riga viene costruita DOPO il Synchronize After Hit (che nasce piu'
  -- in basso nel file): a parita' di LayoutOrder vince l'ordine di
  -- creazione, quindi cosi' finisce esattamente sotto di esso.
  local rcRow, rcColorRow = nil, nil
  _G._Bl1ndBuildRadiusCircleRow = function(order)
    if rcRow then return rcRow end
    local row, rcSetVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Radius Circle", _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled == true, order or 3)
    rcRow = row
    _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleSetVisual = rcSetVisual
    local rcBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if rcBtn then
      rcBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        local on = not (_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled == true)
        rcSetEnabled(on)
        if rcSetVisual then rcSetVisual(on) end
        saveBl1ndConfig()
      end)
    end
    -- Tendina del colore, identica a quella del Tracker Color
    local colorRow, setRcPreview = _G._Bl1ndBuildColorPickerRow({
      parent    = Combat,
      anchorRow = row,
      rowName   = "Radius Circle Color",
      rowOrder  = order or 3,
      title     = "RADIUS CIRCLE COLOR",
      getColor  = function()
        return _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleColor or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
      end,
      onColor   = function(c)
        if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircleColor then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircleColor(c) end
        saveBl1ndConfig()
      end,
    })
    rcColorRow = colorRow
    _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleSetColorPreview = setRcPreview

    -- Allinea subito la visibilita' delle righe alla modalita' corrente
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows then _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows() end
    return row
  end

  -- Stato iniziale dal config
  rcSetEnabled(_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled == true)
  -- <<< RADIUS CIRCLE END

  -- Funzione per mostrare/nascondere le righe in base alla modalità
  local function refreshSemiRowsVisibility()
    local onSemi = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
    local onV2   = onSemi and selectedSemiMode == "V2"
    local onV3   = onSemi and selectedSemiMode == "V3"
    local onV1   = onSemi and not onV2 and not onV3

    -- slider V1/V2/V3
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSubHolder then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelsemiSubHolder.Visible = onSemi
    end

    -- Delay Radius: usato sia dalla V1 che dalla V3 (stesso motore)
    if delayRadBox and delayRadBox.Parent then delayRadBox.Parent.Visible = onV1 or onV3 end

    -- Stop Time in secondi: solo V1
    if stopTimeBox and stopTimeBox.Parent then stopTimeBox.Parent.Visible = onV1 end

    -- Stop Time in percentuale: solo V3
    if stopPctBox and stopPctBox.Parent then stopPctBox.Parent.Visible = onV3 end

    -- riga Semi V2
    if semiV2RadBox and semiV2RadBox.Parent then semiV2RadBox.Parent.Visible = onV2 end

    -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE: le righe vivono solo in modalita' Semi <<<
    if rcRow then rcRow.Visible = onSemi end
    if rcColorRow and not onSemi then rcColorRow.Visible = false end

    -- aggiorna i valori quando si torna nei rispettivi tab
    if A then
      if onV1 then
        stopTimeBox.Text = tostring(A.autoGrabStopTime or 1.29)
      end
      if onV3 then
        stopPctBox.Text = tostring(A.autoGrabStopPercent or 75)
      end
      if onV1 or onV3 then
        delayRadBox.Text = tostring(A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8)
      end
    end
    if onV2 then
      semiV2RadBox.Text = tostring((_G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii and _G.Bl1ndDuelstealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8)
    end
  end

  -- Mostra subito lo stato corretto
  refreshSemiRowsVisibility()

  -- Espone la funzione per essere chiamata dal mode switcher (Normal/Semi slider e V1/V2/V3 slider)
  _G.Bl1ndRefreshSemiStealRows = function(...)
    if _G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersionHolder then
      _G.Bl1ndNormalStealVersionHolder.Visible = selectedStealMode ~= "Semi"
    end
    return refreshSemiRowsVisibility(...)
  end
end)()

-- ===== SYNCHRONIZE AFTER HIT (condiviso Normal + Semi) =====
-- Ordine 3 come il toggle Auto Steal: essendo creata dopo, finisce
-- subito sotto di esso e sopra il Radius (4).
do
  local syncRow, _setSyncVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Synchronize After Hit", _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled, 3)
  _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual = _setSyncVisual
  local syncBtn = syncRow and syncRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if syncBtn then
    syncBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
      _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled = not _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled
      if _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual then _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual(_G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled) end
      if _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled then
        _startSyncAfterHitWatcher()
      else
        _stopSyncAfterHitWatcher()
      end
      saveBl1ndConfig()
    end)
  end
  -- applica stato iniziale al watcher (già avviato sopra, ma rifà il visual)
  if _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual then _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual(_G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.enabled) end
end

-- Selettore NORMAL / BYPASS per l'inseguimento di un aimbot.
-- key = "V1" oppure "V2". Cambia solo la logica di chase.
_G._Bl1ndBuildAimbotChaseSelector = function(parent, key, titleText, order)
  local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
  holder.Name = "Aimbot Chase " .. key
  holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
  holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
  holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  holder.LayoutOrder = order
  holder.ZIndex = 4
  holder.ClipsDescendants = true
  holder.Visible = (selectedAimbotMode == key)
  holder.Parent = parent
  corner(holder, 14)
  stroke(holder, Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175), 1.4, 0.32)
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(holder, nil, "soft")

  local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
  slide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
  slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)
  slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
  slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 1, -8)
  slide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
  slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
  slide.ZIndex = 5
  slide.Parent = holder
  corner(slide, 13)
  local slideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  slideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  slideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
  slideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  slideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  slideStroke.Parent = slide
  local slideGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  slideGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
  })
  slideGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  slideGrad.Rotation = 22
  slideGrad.Parent = slide
  _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(slide, slideGrad, "slide")

  local function mkText(txt, xScale)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = txt
    t.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    t.TextSize = 11
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    t.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    t.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, 0)
    t.ZIndex = 8
    t.Parent = holder
    return t
  end

  local function mkClick(xScale)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    b.Text = ""
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, 0)
    b.ZIndex = 10
    b.Parent = holder
    return b
  end

  local normalText = mkText("NORMAL", 0)
  local bypassText = mkText("BYPASS", 0.5)
  local normalClick = mkClick(0)
  local bypassClick = mkClick(0.5)

  local function applyVisual(mode)
    local isBypass = (mode == "BYPASS")
    tween(slide, {
      Position = isBypass and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(normalText, {
      TextTransparency = isBypass and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isBypass and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(bypassText, {
      TextTransparency = isBypass and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isBypass and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end

  local function setMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "BYPASS" then mode = "NORMAL" end
    _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase = _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase or { V1 = "NORMAL", V2 = "NORMAL" }
    _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase[key] = mode
    applyVisual(mode)
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end

  normalClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode("NORMAL") end)
  bypassClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode("BYPASS") end)

  _G["_Bl1ndAimbotChaseHolder" .. key] = holder
  _G["_Bl1ndRefreshAimbotChase" .. key] = function()
    applyVisual((_G._Bl1ndAimbotChase and _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase[key]) or "NORMAL")
  end
  applyVisual((_G._Bl1ndAimbotChase and _G._Bl1ndAimbotChase[key]) or "NORMAL")
  return holder
end

      TextStrokeTransparency = isV2 and 0.38 or 0.2

    tween(v2Text, {
      TextTransparency = isV2 and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isV2 and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)

    if mode ~= "V2" then mode = "V1" end
    batCounterMode = mode
    applyBatModeVisual(batCounterMode)
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end

  _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector = function()
    applyBatModeVisual(batCounterMode)

    setBatMode("V1")
  end)
  v2Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setBatMode("V2")
  end)

  applyBatModeVisual(batCounterMode)
end

  BoxedESPOptions = BoxedESPOptions or {box=false, tracker=false, trackerColor=Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)}
  BoxedESPData = BoxedESPData or {}

function startPlayerESP()
    if PlayerESP.enabled then return end
    PlayerESP.enabled = true

    function cleanup(plr)
        local d = PlayerESP.playerData[plr]; if not d then return end
        pcall(function() if d.highlight then d.highlight:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() if d.billboard then d.billboard:Destroy() end end)
        if d.conns then for _,c in ipairs(d.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end
        PlayerESP.playerData[plr] = nil
    end

    function setup(plr, char)
        if not PlayerESP.enabled or plr == LP then return end
        cleanup(plr)
        local hrp = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",5))
        local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head",5))
        if not hrp or not head then return end

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "Bl1ndHubESP"; hl.Adornee = char; hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35); hl.FillTransparency = 0.72
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245); hl.OutlineTransparency = 0; hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop; hl.Parent = char

        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "Bl1ndHubESPTag"; bb.Adornee = head; bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,124,0,34); bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.7,0); bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.LightInfluence = 0; bb.Parent = head

        local box = Instance.new("Frame", bb); box.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); box.BackgroundTransparency = 1; box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)

        -- Label velocità (dimensione più grande)
        local n = Instance.new("TextLabel", box)
        n.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,17)
        n.Position = UDim2.new(0,5,0,2)
        n.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        n.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
        n.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        n.TextSize = 22
        n.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.38

        -- GRADIENTE GALATTICO PER LA VELOCITÀ DEL NEMICO
        local speedGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", n)
        speedGrad.Rotation = 0
        speedGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        speedGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
        })

        local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not PlayerESP.enabled or not hrp.Parent then return end
            local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or hrp.Velocity
            n.Text = string.format("%d speed", math.floor(Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z).Magnitude+0.5))
        end)

        PlayerESP.playerData[plr] = {highlight = hl, billboard = bb, conns = {conn}}
    end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
            if plr.Character then setup(plr, plr.Character) end
            table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(setup, plr, c) end))
        end
    end
    table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
        if plr ~= LP then
            table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(setup, plr, c) end))
        end
    end))
    table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(cleanup))
end

  function stopPlayerESP()
    PlayerESP.enabled = false
    for _, c in ipairs(PlayerESP.conns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    PlayerESP.conns = {}
    for plr, d in pairs(PlayerESP.playerData or {}) do
      pcall(function() if d.highlight then d.highlight:Destroy() end end)
      pcall(function() if d.billboard then d.billboard:Destroy() end end)
      -- La Heartbeat che aggiorna la velocita' del nemico va chiusa qui,
      -- altrimenti resta viva a girare a vuoto e se ne accumula una per
      -- giocatore ad ogni spegnimento.
      if d.conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(d.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
      end
    end
    PlayerESP.playerData = {}
  end

  function _Bl1ndEspColor()
    if BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor then
      return BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor
    end
    return THEME_ACCENT or Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
  end

  function _safeDrawing(kind, props)
    if not Drawing or not Drawing.new then return nil end
    local ok, obj = pcall(function() return Drawing.new(kind) end)
    if not ok or not obj then return nil end
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do pcall(function() obj[k] = v end) end
    return obj
  end

  function _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
    local data = BoxedESPData[player]
    if not data then return end
    for _, obj in pairs(data) do
      pcall(function()
        obj.Visible = false
        if obj.Remove then obj:Remove() end
      end)
    end
    BoxedESPData[player] = nil
  end

  function _cleanupBoxedESP()
    for player, _ in pairs(BoxedESPData) do _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player) end
  end

  local function getEdgePoint(cam, targetWorldPos)
    local view = cam.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(view.X / 2, view.Y / 2)

    local targetScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(targetWorldPos)
    local targetV2 = Vector2.new(targetScreen.X, targetScreen.Y)

    if targetScreen.Z > 0 then
      local margin = 50
      if targetV2.X >= -margin and targetV2.X <= view.X + margin
         and targetV2.Y >= -margin and targetV2.Y <= view.Y + margin then
        return targetV2
      end
    end

    local dir = targetV2 - center

    if targetScreen.Z <= 0 then
      local playerPos = cam.CFrame.Position
      local toTarget = (targetWorldPos - playerPos).Unit
      local right = cam.CFrame.RightVector
      local up = cam.CFrame.UpVector
      local dotRight = toTarget:Dot(right)
      local dotUp = toTarget:Dot(up)
      dir = Vector2.new(dotRight, -dotUp) * 1000
    end

    local mag = dir.Magnitude
    if mag < 0.001 then
      return Vector2.new(center.X, view.Y - 20)
    end
    dir = dir / mag

    local edgePad = 20
    local halfW = (view.X / 2) - edgePad
    local halfH = (view.Y / 2) - edgePad

    local tX = math.huge
    local tY = math.huge

    if math.abs(dir.X) > 0.001 then
      tX = halfW / math.abs(dir.X)
    end
    if math.abs(dir.Y) > 0.001 then
      tY = halfH / math.abs(dir.Y)
    end

    local t = math.min(tX, tY)

    return Vector2.new(
      math.clamp(center.X + dir.X * t, edgePad, view.X - edgePad),
      math.clamp(center.Y + dir.Y * t, edgePad, view.Y - edgePad)
    )
  end

  function _updateBoxedESP()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end

    local showTracker = BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker == true

    if not showTracker then
      _cleanupBoxedESP()
      return
    end

    -- Tracker parte DAL PETTO del tuo personaggio (non dai piedi)
    local function getMyScreenPos()
        local myChar = LP.Character
        if not myChar then return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y) end
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot then return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y) end
        -- Offset -1.5: parte dal petto/zona superiore
        local myPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myRoot.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
        if onScreen then
            return Vector2.new(myPos.X, myPos.Y)
        end
        return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y - 10)
    end

    local fromPoint = getMyScreenPos()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LP then continue end

        local char = player.Character
        if not char then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end

        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not root or not head then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end

        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end

        -- Calcola la posizione 3D del TORSO (metà tra testa e HumanoidRootPart)
        local torsoPos = (root.Position + head.Position) / 2
        -- Sposta leggermente in alto per puntare al petto (non alla pancia)
        torsoPos = torsoPos + Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0)
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        -- Nemico fuori dalla safe zone: il tracker punta all'ultima
        -- posizione valida invece di seguirlo nel vuoto.
        if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then
          local gp, isGhost = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.posFor(player, root.Position)
          if isGhost then torsoPos = gp + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0) end
        end
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END

        -- Converti in coordinate schermo
        local torsoScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(torsoPos)

        if torsoScreen.Z <= 0 then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end

        local data = BoxedESPData[player]
        if not data then
            data = {
                tracker = _safeDrawing("Line", {
                    Thickness = 2.5,
                    Transparency = 0.4,
                    Color = _Bl1ndEspColor(),
                    Visible = false
                }),
            }
            BoxedESPData[player] = data
        end

        local color = _Bl1ndEspColor()

        if data.tracker then
            data.tracker.Color = color
            data.tracker.Thickness = 2.5
            data.tracker.From = fromPoint
            -- Punta al TORSO del nemico (calcolato in 3D)
            data.tracker.To = Vector2.new(torsoScreen.X, torsoScreen.Y)
            data.tracker.Visible = true
        end
    end

    for player, _ in pairs(BoxedESPData) do
        if not player.Parent then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
        end
    end
  end

  -- indice stretch salvato prima di attivare il tracker
  local _trackerSavedStretchIndex = nil

function refreshBoxedESP()
    local trackerOn = BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker == true
    _G.Bl1ndTrackerActive = trackerOn   -- <-- NUOVO

    if BoxedESPConn then
        BoxedESPConn:Disconnect()
        BoxedESPConn = nil
    end

    if trackerOn then
        if stretchCurrentIndex ~= 1 then
            _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex = stretchCurrentIndex   -- <-- NUOVO
            _G._Bl1ndDuelstretchUILock = true
            applyStretchPreset(1)
            _G._Bl1ndDuelstretchUILock = false

            task.defer(function()
                if _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex and _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex ~= 1 then
                    local restoreIdx = _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex
                    applyStretchPreset(restoreIdx)
                end
            end)
        else
            _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex = nil
        end

        BoxedESPConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_updateBoxedESP)
    else
        _cleanupBoxedESP()
        _G.Bl1ndTrackerSavedStretchIndex = nil   -- <-- NUOVO
    end
end

  Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(_cleanupBoxedESPPlayer)

    end
  end

  -- applyCustomSky è definita globalmente nel blocco SKY CHANGER (versione completa con anti-destroy).

  function applyCustomSky(mode)
    -- sarà sovrascritta dalla definizione globale; questo è solo un fallback precoce
