      corner(fpClose, 10)
      stroke(fpClose, Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105), 1, 0.4)

      fpClose.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(fpClose, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)}, 0.12)
      end)
      fpClose.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(fpClose, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28)}, 0.12)
      end)
      fpClose.Activated:Connect(closeFontPicker)

      local fpScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
      fpScroll.Name = "Scroll"
      fpScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -64)
      fpScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 56)
      fpScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      fpScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
      fpScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
      fpScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
      fpScroll.ZIndex = 3
      fpScroll.Parent = fpFrame

      -- RIUSO DELLE CARD (niente UIGridLayout)
      -- I font sono centinaia: creare una card per ognuno vuol dire
      -- migliaia di istanze in un colpo solo, ed e' quello lo scatto
      -- all'apertura. Qui le card create sono solo quelle che entrano
      -- nello schermo piu' una riga di margine: scorrendo non se ne
      -- creano altre, si riscrive il contenuto di quelle che ci sono.
      -- La griglia viene calcolata a mano perche' un UIGridLayout
      -- pretenderebbe che tutte le celle esistessero davvero: le misure
      -- pero' sono identiche a quelle dello Sky Picker (108 + 10 di gap).
      local FP_COLS, FP_CELL, FP_GAP = 3, 108, 10
      local FP_STEP = FP_CELL + FP_GAP
      local fpList = _G.Bl1ndFonts.list()
      local fpRows = math.ceil(#fpList / FP_COLS)
      -- L'altezza del canvas e' quella che avrebbero TUTTE le righe: la
      -- barra di scorrimento resta giusta anche se le card non esistono.
      fpScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 16 + fpRows * FP_STEP)

      local fpPool = {}

      local function fpEntryOf(card)
        local idx = card:GetAttribute("FontIdx")
        return idx and fpList[idx] or nil
      end

      local function fpPaint()
        for _, c in ipairs(fpPool) do
          local e = fpEntryOf(c)
          local sel = (e ~= nil and _G.Bl1ndFontChoice == e.key)
          local st = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if st then
            tween(st, {
              Color = sel and Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 58),
              Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.55,
              Thickness = sel and 2.4 or 1.2,
            }, 0.12)
          end
        end
      end

      local function fpBind(card, idx)
        local e = fpList[idx]
        if not e then
          card:SetAttribute("FontIdx", nil)
          card.Visible = false
          return
        end
        local row = math.floor((idx - 1) / FP_COLS)
        local col = (idx - 1) % FP_COLS
        card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + col * FP_STEP, 0, 8 + row * FP_STEP)
        card:SetAttribute("FontIdx", idx)
        local prv = card:FindFirstChild("Preview")
        if prv then
          if e.font then prv.FontFace = e.font else prv.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack end
        end
        local nl = card:FindFirstChild("FontName")
        if nl then nl.Text = e.label end
        card.Visible = true
      end

      -- Quante card servono davvero: le righe visibili piu' due di
      -- margine, cosi' scorrendo non si vede mai un buco.
      for j = 1, (math.ceil(456 / FP_STEP) + 2) * FP_COLS do
        local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
        card.Name = "FontCard_" .. tostring(j)
        card.Size = UDim2.new(0, FP_CELL, 0, FP_CELL)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.Text = ""
        card.AutoButtonColor = false
        card.Visible = false
        card.ZIndex = 4
        card.ClipsDescendants = true
        card.Parent = fpScroll
        corner(card, 18)

        local cardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        cardStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        cardStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 58)
        cardStroke.Thickness = 1.2
        cardStroke.Transparency = 0.55
        cardStroke.Parent = card

        -- ANTEPRIMA. L'attributo la mette fuori dalla portata del motore
        -- dei font: senza, il font appena scelto verrebbe applicato anche
        -- a lei — sta dentro la hub come tutto il resto — e i campioni
        -- diventerebbero tutti uguali.
        local prv = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        prv.Name = "Preview"
        prv.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        prv.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 58)
        prv.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 8)
        prv.Text = "Aa"
        prv.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
        prv.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        prv.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        prv.TextSize = 34
        prv.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        prv.ZIndex = 5
        prv.Parent = card
        prv:SetAttribute("AmbFontLock", true)

        local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLbl.Name = "FontName"
        nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 32)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -36)
        nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLbl.Text = ""
        nameLbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
        nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        nameLbl.TextSize = 9
        nameLbl.TextWrapped = true
        nameLbl.ZIndex = 6
        nameLbl.Parent = card
        nameLbl:SetAttribute("AmbFontLock", true)

        card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
          tween(cardStroke, {Transparency = 0, Thickness = 2.4}, 0.12)
          tween(prv, {TextSize = 40}, 0.12)
        end)
        card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
          local e = fpEntryOf(card)
          local sel = (e ~= nil and _G.Bl1ndFontChoice == e.key)
          tween(cardStroke, {
            Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.55,
            Thickness = sel and 2.4 or 1.2,
          }, 0.12)
          tween(prv, {TextSize = 34}, 0.12)
        end)

        card.Activated:Connect(function()
          local e = fpEntryOf(card)
          if not e then return end
          _G.Bl1ndFonts.set(e.key)
          fpPaint()
        end)

        fpPool[#fpPool + 1] = card
      end

      -- Si ridisegna solo quando cambia la prima riga visibile: durante
      -- uno scorrimento fluido la maggior parte dei frame non fa nulla.
      local fpFirstRow = -1
      local function fpRender()
        local first = math.max(0, math.floor((fpScroll.CanvasPosition.Y - 8) / FP_STEP) - 1)
        if first == fpFirstRow then return end
        fpFirstRow = first
        for j, card in ipairs(fpPool) do
          fpBind(card, first * FP_COLS + j)
        end
        fpPaint()
      end
      fpScroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(fpRender)
      fpRender()

      fpBack.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeFontPicker()
        end
      end)

      fpFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      fpFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      TweenService:Create(fpFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 520),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0.5, -260)
      }):Play()
    end)
  end)()

    end

  function stepperRow(parent, labelText, defaultValue, order, callback, minValue, maxValue)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Name = labelText
    row.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 42)
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0

    row.ZIndex = 4

    stroke(row, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1.15, 0.32)

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

    local value = defaultValue
    local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")

      _G.Bl1ndMusicRefreshUI = nil
      if mpGui and mpGui.Parent then
        local fr = mpGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
        if fr then TweenService:Create(fr, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play() end
        local g = mpGui
        mpGui = nil
        task.delay(0.25, function()

        end)
      else
        mpGui = nil
      end

    _G._Bl1ndRegAccent(pillBg, pillBgGrad, "toggle")

    -- Testo (trasparente, sopra lo sfondo)
    local pill = Instance.new("TextButton")
    pill.Name = "Pill"
    pill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pill.Text = "OFF"
    pill.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver

    pill.Parent = f
    corner(pill, 12)

    local function apply(v)
        local isGrey = _G._Bl1ndAccentIsGrey and _G._Bl1ndAccentIsGrey() or false
        local onBase, onEdge = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220), Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
        if _G._Bl1ndToggleOnColor then
            local b, e = _G._Bl1ndToggleOnColor()
            if b then onBase = b end
            if e then onEdge = e end
        end

        if v then
            pill.Text = "ON"
            pill.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver   -- BIANCO
            pillBg.BackgroundColor3 = onBase
            pillBgGrad.Enabled = true   -- SEMPRE ATTIVO, ma il gradiente avrà colori appropriati (viola o grigio) grazie al registrazione
            pillBgStroke.Color = onEdge
            pillBgStroke.Transparency = 0.15
        else
            pill.Text = "OFF"
            pill.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
            pillBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 14)
            pillBgGrad.Enabled = false
            pillBgStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105)
            pillBgStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        end
    end

    apply(getVal() == true)

    pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local nv = not (getVal() == true)
        setVal(nv)
        apply(nv)
    end)

    -- HOVER: la pill si ingrandisce, stesso feeling del pulsante PLAY.
    -- Si animano sia pillBg (sfondo + gradiente) sia pill (testo),
    -- perche' sono due oggetti fratelli sovrapposti.
    pill.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(pillBg, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0.5, -14)}, 0.12)

    end)
    pill.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(pillBg, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.5, -12)}, 0.12)
        tween(pill,   {Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.5, -12)}, 0.12)
    end)

    return f, apply
end

      -- REFRESH UI
      local function refresh()
        if not (mpGui and mpGui.Parent) then return end
        nameLbl.Text = getMusicSongName()
        counterLbl.Text = "TRACK " .. tostring(selectedMusicSong) .. " / " .. tostring(#MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS)
        volValue.Text = string.format("%.2f", musicPlayerVolume)
        spdValue.Text = string.format("%.1fx", musicPlayerSpeed)
        -- Le pill rispecchiano sempre lo stato reale delle variabili
        if applyAutoNext then applyAutoNext(musicAutoPlayNext == true) end
        if applyShuffle then applyShuffle(musicShuffleEnabled == true) end
        if applyLoop then applyLoop(musicLoopEnabled == true) end
        local s = _musicPlayerSound
        local alive = s and s.Parent
        playBtn.Text = (alive and s.IsPlaying) and "PAUSE" or "PLAY"
        if alive then
          -- Durata e posizione mostrate come tempo REALE di ascolto: a 2x
          -- la canzone dura la meta', a 0.5x il doppio. TimeLength e
          -- TimePosition di Roblox sono sempre in tempo della traccia, non
          -- tengono conto di PlaybackSpeed, quindi si divide qui.
          local sp = tonumber(musicPlayerSpeed) or 1
          if sp <= 0 then sp = 1 end
          local len = (s.TimeLength or 0) / sp
          local pos = (s.TimePosition or 0) / sp
          if len > 0 then
            barFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
            curLbl.Text = _mpFmtTime(pos)
            totLbl.Text = _mpFmtTime(len)
          else
            barFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            curLbl.Text = "0:00"
            totLbl.Text = "--:--"
          end
        else
          barFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
          curLbl.Text = "0:00"
          totLbl.Text = "0:00"
        end
      end
      _G.Bl1ndMusicRefreshUI = refresh
      refresh()

      task.spawn(function()
        while mpGui and mpGui.Parent do
          pcall(refresh)
          task.wait(0.2)
        end
      end)

      backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeMusicPlayer()
        end
      end)

      frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, POPUP_W, 0, POPUP_H),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -POPUP_W / 2, 0.5, -POPUP_H / 2)
      }):Play()
    end)
  end

      if radiusBox then radiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius) end

      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSemiSubModeVisual then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetSemiSubModeVisual("V1") end

      if skyValueLabel then skyValueLabel.Text = "Off" end
      savedStealBarPositionTable = nil
      if _G.Bl1ndResetStealBarPosition then pcall(_G.Bl1ndResetStealBarPosition) end
      if _G.Bl1ndResetMobileButtons then _G.Bl1ndResetMobileButtons() end
      if _G.Bl1ndRefreshStretchSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshStretchSelector() end
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates then _G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates() end
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter() end
      if _G.Bl1ndRefreshInfJumpModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshInfJumpModeSelector() end
      if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector() end
      if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector() end
      if _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector() end
      if _SV.setLookAtVisual then pcall(function() _SV.setLookAtVisual(false) end) end
      if _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadiusBox then _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadiusBox.Text = "20" end

      -- >>> RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK BEGIN
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRainbowJoystick then
        pcall(_G.Bl1ndDuelsetRainbowJoystick, false)
      end
      _G.Bl1ndRainbowJoystickEnabled = false
      -- <<< RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK END

      -- >>> RESET VISUALS BEGIN
      -- Dieci toggle venivano spenti nella logica ma la loro riga restava
      -- accesa a schermo: il reset non chiamava mai il loro setVisual.
      -- Il risultato era che dopo un Reset All Settings la GUI mentiva, e
      -- al rientro successivo (dove il config, salvato qui sotto, viene
      -- riletto) comparivano spenti senza che nessuno li avesse spenti.
      -- E' esattamente il caso di Synchronize After Hit.
      if _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit and _G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual then
        pcall(_G._Bl1ndDuelsyncAfterHit.setVisual, false)
      end
      for _, _vn in ipairs({
        "setAntiDieVisual",
        "setAntiLagVisual",
        "setAutoTPVisual",
        "setFOVVisual",
        "setNoCamCollisionVisual",
        "setPlayerESPVisual",
        "setRagdollCountdownVisual",
        "setTrackerESPVisual",
        "setUnwalkVisual",
        "setRainbowJoystickVisual",
      }) do
        local _fn = _SV[_vn]
        if type(_fn) == "function" then pcall(_fn, false) end
      end
      -- <<< RESET VISUALS END

      saveBl1ndConfig()
    end)
    task.wait(0.35)
    setResetDoneTheme()
    task.wait(0.6)
    pcall(function()
      local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
      TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, Players.LocalPlayer)
    end)
  end)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
  local isControllerInput = tostring(input.UserInputType):find("Gamepad") ~= nil
  local isMB3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3

  -- Helper: verifica se un keybind (KeyCode o "MB3") corrisponde all'input corrente
  local function isKeyMatch(boundKey)
    if not boundKey then return false end
    if boundKey == "MB3" then return isMB3 end
    return (not isMB3) and input.KeyCode == boundKey
  end

  if gameProcessed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not listeningForSpeedKey and not listeningForTPDownKey then return end
  if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
  -- Lascia passare: tastiera, gamepad, oppure MB3 (durante listening o come tasto bindato)
  if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not isControllerInput and not isMB3 then return end
  -- Blocca KeyCode.Unknown solo per input che NON sono MB3
  if not isMB3 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end


  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.ToggleUI) then
    if Main.Visible then
      if _G.Bl1ndHubClose then _G.Bl1ndHubClose(true)
      else Main.Visible = false; MiniFrame.Visible = true end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndHubOpen then _G.Bl1ndHubOpen()
      else Main.Visible = true; MiniFrame.Visible = false; Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE end
    end
    saveBl1ndConfig()
    return
  end

  if listeningForSpeedKey then
    if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
    local targetKey = listeningForSpeedKey
    -- Escape annulla il listening (solo tastiera)
    if not isMB3 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
      listeningForSpeedKey = nil
      refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
      return
    end
    -- Backspace/Delete rimuove il binding (solo tastiera)
    if not isMB3 and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete) then
      speedKeybinds[targetKey] = nil
    else
      -- Il tasto da bindare: "MB3" oppure il KeyCode premuto
      local pressedKey = isMB3 and "MB3" or input.KeyCode
      -- Rimuove eventuali duplicati su altri keybind
      for otherKeyId, boundKey in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
        if otherKeyId ~= targetKey and boundKey == pressedKey then
          speedKeybinds[otherKeyId] = nil
        end
      end
      if tpDownKeybind == pressedKey then
        tpDownKeybind = nil
        refreshTPDownKeybind()
      end
      speedKeybinds[targetKey] = pressedKey
    end
    listeningForSpeedKey = nil
    refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
    saveBl1ndConfig()
    return
  end

  if listeningForTPDownKey then
    if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
    if not isMB3 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
      listeningForTPDownKey = false
      refreshTPDownKeybind()
      return
    end
    if not isMB3 and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete) then
      tpDownKeybind = nil
    else
      local pressedKey = isMB3 and "MB3" or input.KeyCode
      for keyId, boundKey in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
        if boundKey == pressedKey then
          speedKeybinds[keyId] = nil
        end
      end
      tpDownKeybind = pressedKey
    end
    listeningForTPDownKey = false
    refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
    refreshTPDownKeybind()
    saveBl1ndConfig()
    return
  end

  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.SpeedToggle) then
    toggleCarryMode()
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.LaggerToggle) then
    toggleLaggerMode()
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.Aimbot) then
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked() then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop then _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
      return
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot()
    elseif selectedAimbotMode == "V2" and _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2 and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 then
      if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2() else _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2() end
    elseif _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot and _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot then
      if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot() else _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot() end
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.TPBat) then
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked() then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop then _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
      return
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBatManual then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBatManual()
    elseif _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat()
    end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.DropBrainrot) then
    if selectedDropMode == "Stand Still" then
      runDropStandStill()
    else
      runDropBrainrot()
    end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.AutoPlay) then
    if _G.Bl1ndAutoPlayToggle then _G.Bl1ndAutoPlayToggle() end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.AntiTPBat) then
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat.toggle()
    elseif _G.Bl1ndToggleAntiTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleAntiTPBat()
    end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.Float) then
    if _G.Bl1ndFloatToggle then _G.Bl1ndFloatToggle() end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.InstantReset) then
    if _G.Bl1ndInstantReset then _G.Bl1ndInstantReset() end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(tpDownKeybind) then
    runTPFloor()
    return
  end
end)

setTab("MOVEMENT")

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsSetupStealBar = function()
  local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
  local UIS = UserInputService
  local TS = TweenService

  local existingStealBar = HubGui and HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubStealBarGui")
  if existingStealBar then existingStealBar:Destroy() end
  -- copia rimasta in PlayerGui da una versione precedente dello script
  existingStealBar = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubStealBarGui")
  if existingStealBar then existingStealBar:Destroy() end

  -- ============================================================
  -- Niente barra separata: e' TUTTA la card che si colora.
  -- Sfondo = stesso background scelto nell'hub (built-in o custom),
  -- in semi trasparenza.
  -- ============================================================
  local W, H = 380, 44
  local RADIUS = 11

  local C = {
    line   = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 195),
    txt    = Color3.fromRGB(176, 178, 184),
    txtDim = Color3.fromRGB(176, 178, 184),
    good   = Color3.fromRGB(130, 245, 160),
    warn   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 100),
    bad    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 105),
  }

  local GRAD_ACTIVE = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.78, Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
  })
  local GRAD_IDLE = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB( 60,  56,  78)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(108, 100, 132)),
  })
  local GRAD_DONE = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB( 30, 150, 130)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.fromRGB( 80, 220, 170)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 205)),
  })

  local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
  gui.Name = "Bl1ndHubStealBarGui"
  gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
  gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
  gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
  gui.DisplayOrder = 50
  gui.Parent = HubGui

  function drag(frame)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if _G.Bl1ndGuiLocked == true then return end
      if frame.Name == "StealBar" and _G.Bl1ndStealBarLocked == true then return end
      if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
          if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            dragging = false
            if frame and frame.Name == "StealBar" then
              savedStealBarPositionTable = udim2ToTable(frame.Position)
              pcall(saveBl1ndConfig)
            end
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
      if dragging and frame.Name == "StealBar" and _G.Bl1ndStealBarLocked == true then dragging = false return end
      if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
      end
    end)
  end

  -- ===================== CARD =====================
  local pbFrame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
  pbFrame.Name = "StealBar"
  pbFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, W, 0, H)
  _G.Bl1ndDuelstealBarDefaultPosition = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(W / 2), 1, -128)
  pbFrame.Position = tableToUDim2(savedStealBarPositionTable, _G.Bl1ndDuelstealBarDefaultPosition)
  savedStealBarPositionTable = udim2ToTable(pbFrame.Position)
  pbFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  pbFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
  pbFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
  pbFrame.Active = true
  pbFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
  pbFrame.ZIndex = 2
  Instance.new("UICorner", pbFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, RADIUS)

  local cardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", pbFrame)
  cardStroke.Color = C.line
  cardStroke.Thickness = 1.2
  cardStroke.Transparency = 0.4

  drag(pbFrame)

  pbFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
    savedStealBarPositionTable = udim2ToTable(pbFrame.Position)
  end)

  _G.Bl1ndResetStealBarPosition = function()
    if pbFrame and pbFrame.Parent then
      pbFrame.Position = _G.Bl1ndDuelstealBarDefaultPosition or UDim2.new(0.5, -176, 1, -128)
      savedStealBarPositionTable = udim2ToTable(pbFrame.Position)
    else
      savedStealBarPositionTable = nil
    end
  end

  _G.Bl1ndApplyStealBarPosition = function()
    if pbFrame and pbFrame.Parent then
      pbFrame.Position = tableToUDim2(savedStealBarPositionTable, _G.Bl1ndDuelstealBarDefaultPosition or UDim2.new(0.5, -176, 1, -128))
      savedStealBarPositionTable = udim2ToTable(pbFrame.Position)
    end
  end

  local pbScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
  pbScale.Name = "Bl1ndProgressBarScale"
  pbScale.Scale = Bl1ndProgressBarScaleValue or 1
  pbScale.Parent = pbFrame

  -- Le scritte vengono scalate a mano: qui alla creazione e ad ogni nuova
  -- label aggiunta dopo, altrimenti nascerebbero con la misura piena.
  task.defer(function()

  local bgSrcConn = nil
  local function syncBarBackground()
    local src = hubBgSource()
    if src and src.Image and src.Image ~= "" then
      bgImage.Image = src.Image
      bgImage.Visible = true
      if not bgSrcConn then
        bgSrcConn = src:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
          if src.Image ~= "" then
            bgImage.Image = src.Image
            bgImage.Visible = true
          else
            bgImage.Visible = false
          end
        end)
      end
      return true
    end
    bgImage.Visible = false
    return false
  end

  progressPct.Name = "Percent"

  progressPct.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  progressPct.Text = "0%"

  progressPct.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack

  -- Riga inferiore: stato
  local stateRow = Instance.new("Frame", textStack)

  stateRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  stateRow.ZIndex = 10

  local stealLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", stateRow)
  stealLbl.Name = "StateLabel"
  stealLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  stealLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  stealLbl.Text = "STEAL"
  stealLbl.TextColor3 = C.txtDim
  stealLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack

  stealLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  stealLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
  stealLbl.ZIndex = 10

  -- ===================== DESTRA: FPS sopra, linea, MS sotto =====================
  local STAT_W = 60

  local rightHolder = Instance.new("Frame", pbFrame)
  rightHolder.Name = "Stats"
  rightHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
  rightHolder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
  rightHolder.Size = UDim2.new(0, STAT_W, 0, 32)
  rightHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  rightHolder.ZIndex = 10

  local rList = Instance.new("UIListLayout", rightHolder)
  rList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
  rList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
  rList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
  rList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
  rList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)

  local function statRow(order, caption)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame", rightHolder)
    row.Name = caption .. "Row"
    row.LayoutOrder = order
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.ZIndex = 10

    local rl = Instance.new("UIListLayout", row)
    rl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    -- Centrato: valore + sigla vengono trattati come un blocco unico,
    -- cosi' stanno esattamente a meta' della lineetta divisoria
    rl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    rl.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

    val.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X

    local cap = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
    cap.LayoutOrder = 2
    cap.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)

  local sbFpsLabel = statRow(1, "FPS")
  sbFpsLabel.Name = "SBFps"

  statDiv.Name = "StatDivider"

  statDiv.ZIndex = 10

  sbPingLabel.Name = "SBPing"

  progressRadLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  progressRadLbl.Visible = false

  -- ===================== STATO =====================
  local barState = "IDLE"
  local targetP, shownP = 0, 0

  function setBarState(state)
    state = tostring(state or "IDLE"):upper()
    barState = state
    local active = (state ~= "IDLE")
    local done = (state == "DONE" or state == "SUCCESS" or state == "STOLEN")

    stealLbl.Text = (state == "IDLE") and "STEAL" or state
    washGrad.Color = done and GRAD_DONE or (active and GRAD_ACTIVE or GRAD_IDLE)

    local col = active and C.txt or C.txtDim
    TS:Create(stealLbl,    TweenInfo.new(0.18), {TextColor3 = col}):Play()
    TS:Create(progressPct, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {TextColor3 = col}):Play()
    TS:Create(cardStroke,  TweenInfo.new(0.22), {Transparency = active and 0.1 or 0.45}):Play()
  end

  -- Riempimento agganciato 1:1 al progresso reale.
  -- Lo smoothing serve solo a togliere il tremolio tra un update e l'altro:
  -- e' molto rapido e non anticipa mai il valore vero.
  local renderConn
  renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not pbFrame.Parent then
      pcall(function() renderConn:Disconnect() end)
      return
    end

    if shownP ~= targetP then
      local a = 1 - math.exp(-38 * math.min(dt, 0.1))
      shownP = shownP + (targetP - shownP) * a
      if math.abs(targetP - shownP) < 0.004 then shownP = targetP end
    end

    washClip.Size = UDim2.new(shownP, 0, 1, 0)
    progressPct.Text = math.floor(shownP * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"

    -- La testina si spegne prima di toccare il bordo: altrimenti a fine
    -- riempimento restava una lineetta chiara incollata al bordo destro
    -- La puntina compare solo a riempimento gia' avviato e sparisce prima
    -- del bordo: cosi' non lampeggia sulla posizione vecchia dopo un reset.
    if shownP > 0.05 and shownP < 0.94 and targetP > 0.05 and targetP < 0.999 and barState ~= "IDLE" then
      edge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
      edge.Position = UDim2.new(shownP, 0, 0, 0)
    else
      edge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    end
  end)

  -- ===================== API =====================
  local StealBar = {}

  function StealBar.SetProgress(p)
    p = math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1)
    targetP = p
    -- A fondo corsa niente interpolazione: il pieno deve comparire subito
    if p >= 0.999 then
      shownP = 1
      washClip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      edge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      progressPct.Text = "100%"
    end
  end

  function StealBar.Reset()
    targetP = 0
    shownP = 0
    washClip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    wash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    edge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    edge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    progressPct.Text = "0%"
    setBarState("IDLE")
  end

  function StealBar.SetState(state)
    setBarState(state)
  end

  setBarState("IDLE")

  -- ===================== FPS / PING =====================
  task.spawn(function()
    local sbFpsLastTime = tick()
    local sbFpsFrameCount = 0
    local sbFpsCurrent = 0
    local sbPingCurrent = 0
    local sbLastPingUpdate = tick()

    local sbFpsConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
      sbFpsFrameCount = sbFpsFrameCount + 1
      local now = tick()
      local elapsed = now - sbFpsLastTime
      if elapsed >= 0.25 then
        sbFpsCurrent = math.floor(sbFpsFrameCount / elapsed + 0.5)
        sbFpsFrameCount = 0
        sbFpsLastTime = now
      end
    end)

    while pbFrame and pbFrame.Parent do
      local now = tick()
      if now - sbLastPingUpdate >= 0.5 then
        sbLastPingUpdate = now
        pcall(function()
          local rawPing = LP:GetNetworkPing()
          if rawPing then sbPingCurrent = math.floor(rawPing * 1000 + 0.5) end
        end)
      end

      sbFpsLabel.Text = tostring(sbFpsCurrent)
      sbPingLabel.Text = tostring(sbPingCurrent)

      if sbFpsCurrent >= 120 then
        sbFpsLabel.TextColor3 = C.good
      elseif sbFpsCurrent >= 60 then
        sbFpsLabel.TextColor3 = C.warn
      else
        sbFpsLabel.TextColor3 = C.bad
      end

      if sbPingCurrent <= 50 then
        sbPingLabel.TextColor3 = C.good
      elseif sbPingCurrent <= 100 then
        sbPingLabel.TextColor3 = C.warn
      else
        sbPingLabel.TextColor3 = C.bad
      end

      -- Il background dell'hub puo' essere cambiato dalle impostazioni
      pcall(syncBarBackground)

      -- ===== HIGH PING WARNING POPUP =====
      -- Il Kick Warning ha la precedenza: finche' il suo popup e' vivo
      -- (anche durante la sua animazione di uscita) il ping warning aspetta.
      local kwBusy = (_G._Bl1ndKickWarn and _G._Bl1ndKickWarn.active == true)
        or (HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubKickWarning") ~= nil)

      if highPingWarningEnabled and not kwBusy and sbPingCurrent > 120 and tick() >= (_G._Bl1ndHPWNextAllowed or 0) then
        local existingWarning = HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubPingWarning")
        if not existingWarning then
          local warningGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
          warningGui.Name = "Bl1ndHubPingWarning"
          warningGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
          warningGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
          warningGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
          warningGui.DisplayOrder = 99999
          warningGui.Parent = HubGui
          _G._Bl1ndHPWNextAllowed = tick() + 13.5

          local warningFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
          warningFrame.Name = "WarningFrame"
          warningFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 52)
          warningFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0, -60)
          warningFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30)
          warningFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
          warningFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
          warningFrame.ZIndex = 1000
          warningFrame.Parent = warningGui
          Instance.new("UICorner", warningFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

          local warningStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", warningFrame)
          warningStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
          warningStroke.Thickness = 2
          warningStroke.Transparency = 0.15
          warningStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

          local warningIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          warningIcon.Name = "WarningIcon"
          warningIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 1, 0)
          warningIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
          warningIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          warningIcon.Text = "⚠️"
          warningIcon.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
          warningIcon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
          warningIcon.TextSize = 26
          warningIcon.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
          warningIcon.ZIndex = 1001
          warningIcon.Parent = warningFrame

          local warningText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          warningText.Name = "WarningText"
          warningText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 1, 0)
          warningText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 0)
          warningText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          warningText.Text = "MORE THAN 120 PING DONT DUEL"
          warningText.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
          warningText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
          warningText.TextSize = 16
          warningText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
          warningText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
          warningText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
          warningText.ZIndex = 1001
          warningText.Parent = warningFrame

          TweenService:Create(warningFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0, 18)
          }):Play()

          task.delay(3, function()
            if warningGui and warningGui.Parent then
              TweenService:Create(warningFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0, -60),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
              }):Play()
              TweenService:Create(warningText, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
              TweenService:Create(warningIcon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
              task.wait(0.35)
              pcall(function() warningGui:Destroy() end)
              _G._Bl1ndHPWNextAllowed = tick() + 10
            end
          end)
        end
      end

      task.wait(0.5)
    end

    pcall(function() sbFpsConn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() renderConn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() if bgSrcConn then bgSrcConn:Disconnect() end end)
  end)

  _G.StealBar = StealBar
end

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsSetupStealBar()

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsSetupMinimizeToggle = function()
  _G.__Bl1ndDuelsMinimized = false
  Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    -- Si guarda lo stato REALE della finestra, non un flag che puo' essere
    -- rimasto indietro.
    if Main.Visible then
      if _G.Bl1ndHubClose then _G.Bl1ndHubClose(true)
      else _G.__Bl1ndDuelsMinimized = true; Main.Visible = false; MiniFrame.Visible = true end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndHubOpen then _G.Bl1ndHubOpen()
      else _G.__Bl1ndDuelsMinimized = false; Main.Visible = true; MiniFrame.Visible = false; Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE end
    end
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end)
end

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsSetupMinimizeToggle()

_G.__Bl1ndDuelsRunIntro = function()
  local TS = TweenService
  local introGuiParent = Gui and Gui.Parent or HubGui
  local origSize = FULL_MAIN_SIZE or Main.Size
  local wasMinimizedBeforeIntro = (_G.__Bl1ndDuelsMinimized == true)

  if not _introEnabled then
    stopIntroPlayback()
    stopIntroPreview()
    Main.Size = origSize
    if not wasMinimizedBeforeIntro then
      Main.Visible = true
      MiniFrame.Visible = false
    else
      Main.Visible = false
      MiniFrame.Visible = true
    end
    return
  end

  playIntroMusic()
  Main.Visible = false
  MiniFrame.Visible = false
  Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

  task.spawn(function()
    local introGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    introGui.Name = "Bl1ndHubIntro"
    introGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    introGui.DisplayOrder = 100
    introGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    introGui.Parent = introGuiParent
    local introActive = true

    function finishIntro()
      if not introActive then return end
      introActive = false
      stopIntroPlayback()
      MiniFrame.Visible = false
      Main.Visible = true
      pcall(function()
        TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = origSize}):Play()
      end)
      task.delay(0.75, function()
        pcall(function() introGui:Destroy() end)
      end)
    end

    local darkBg = Instance.new("Frame", introGui)
    darkBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    darkBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    darkBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    darkBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    darkBg.ZIndex = 1


    local redWash = Instance.new("Frame", introGui)
    redWash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    redWash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    redWash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    redWash.BorderSizePixel = 0
    redWash.ZIndex = 2


local center = Instance.new("Frame", introGui)
center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
center.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
center.Size = UDim2.new(0,660,0,250)
center.BackgroundTransparency = 1
center.ZIndex = 40

local lineTop = Instance.new("Frame", center)
lineTop.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0)
lineTop.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,58)
lineTop.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,2)  -- parte da 0, poi si espande
lineTop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)  -- base per gradiente
lineTop.BackgroundTransparency = 0
lineTop.BorderSizePixel = 0
lineTop.ZIndex = 41

local lineTopGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", lineTop)
lineTopGrad.Rotation = 0
lineTopGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
lineTopGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
})

    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
})

    local titleShadow = Instance.new("TextLabel", center)
    titleShadow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,86)
    titleShadow.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,83)
    titleShadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    titleShadow.Text = "BL1ND DUELS"
    titleShadow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
    titleShadow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    titleShadow.TextSize = 72
    titleShadow.TextTransparency = 1
    titleShadow.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
    titleShadow.ZIndex = 42

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", center)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,86)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,78)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "BL1ND DUELS"
title.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextSize = 72
title.TextTransparency = 1
title.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
title.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
title.ZIndex = 43

local titleGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", title)
titleGrad.Rotation = 0
titleGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
titleGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)),
})








    local pressLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", center)
    pressLbl.Name = "PressToContinue"
    pressLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28)
    pressLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,174)
    pressLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    pressLbl.Text = "PRESS TO CONTINUE"
    pressLbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    pressLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    pressLbl.TextSize = 20
    pressLbl.TextTransparency = 1
    pressLbl.ZIndex = 43

    TS:Create(darkBg, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
    task.wait(0.85)

    TS:Create(lineTop, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0,500,0,2)}):Play()
    TS:Create(lineBot, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0,500,0,2)}):Play()

    task.wait(0.12)
    TS:Create(titleShadow, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 0.35, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 0, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.18}):Play()

    task.wait(0.42)

    for i = 1, 3 do
      if not introActive then break end
      TS:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.06), {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185,185,185)}):Play()
      task.wait(0.06)
      TS:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.06), {TextColor3 = COLORS.silver}):Play()
      task.wait(0.06)
    end

    -- Attesa input: click / tap / qualsiasi tasto (spazio incluso).
    -- Nessun timer: l'intro resta finche' non premi.
    TS:Create(pressLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.42), {TextTransparency = 0.1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.45)
    pcall(function()
      TS:Create(pressLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {TextTransparency = 0.65}):Play()
    end)

    local pressed = false
    local function onPress()
      if introActive then pressed = true end
    end
    local catcher = Instance.new("TextButton", introGui)
    catcher.Name = "PressCatcher"
    catcher.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    catcher.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    catcher.Text = ""
    catcher.AutoButtonColor = false
    catcher.ZIndex = 90
    catcher.Activated:Connect(onPress)
    local keyConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
      if gp then return end
      local t = input.UserInputType
      if t == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or t == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
        onPress()
      end
    end)
    while introActive and not pressed do task.wait(0.05) end
    pcall(function() keyConn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() catcher:Destroy() end)
    if not introActive then return end

    -- La musica sfuma (1.25s) mentre la hub entra.
    stopIntroPlayback()
    TS:Create(pressLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()

    TS:Create(center, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)}):Play()
    TS:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.36), {TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(titleShadow, TweenInfo.new(0.36), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(lineTop, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,2)}):Play()
    TS:Create(lineBot, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,2)}):Play()
    TS:Create(darkBg, TweenInfo.new(0.75), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

    Main.Visible = true
    MiniFrame.Visible = false
    TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = origSize}):Play()
    task.wait(0.9)
    introActive = false
    pcall(function() introGui:Destroy() end)
  end)
end
