_G.Bl1ndDuelsForceSyncLoadedButtons = function()
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled) end
    if autoTPEnabled then startAutoTP() else stopAutoTP() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setInfJumpVisual then setInfJumpVisual(infJumpEnabled) end
    if setInfJumpInternal then setInfJumpInternal(infJumpEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshInfJumpModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshInfJumpModeSelector() end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshTPDownMethodSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshTPDownMethodSelector() end   -- >>> TP DOWN METHOD <<<
    -- >>> CUSTOM FONTS <<< la GUI a questo punto esiste: si applica il
    -- font salvato e si agganciano i listener per quello che nascera' dopo.
    if _G.Bl1ndFonts then
      pcall(_G.Bl1ndFonts.applyAll)
      pcall(_G.Bl1ndFonts.hook)
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setLookAtVisual then _SV.setLookAtVisual(_G.Bl1ndLookAtEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadiusBox then _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadiusBox.Text = tostring(tonumber(_G.Bl1ndLookAtRadius) or 20) end
    if _G.Bl1ndLookAtEnabled then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt() end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopLookAt then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopLookAt() end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoCarrySpeedVisual then setAutoCarrySpeedVisual(autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAntiRagdollVisual then setAntiRagdollVisual(antiRagdollEnabled) end
    if _SV.setTPRagdollVisual then _SV.setTPRagdollVisual(_G.Bl1ndTPRagdollEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector() end
    setAntiRagdoll(antiRagdollEnabled)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(_G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted == true) end
    setAntiDie(_G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted == true)
    -- Un modulo poteva aver gia' armato l'Anti Die: setAntiDie(false)
    -- staccherebbe tutto senza che nessuno lo rimetta.
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync then _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoLeft then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoLeft(autoLeftEnabled, true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoRight then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAutoRight(autoRightEnabled, true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync then _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync() end
    -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE <<<
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircle then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircle(_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleSetVisual(_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircleColor then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetRadiusCircleColor(_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleColor) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleSetColorPreview then _G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleSetColorPreview(_G.Bl1ndRadiusCircleColor) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoSwingSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndNormalAutoSwingSetVisual(autoSwingEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndMirrorTPDownSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndMirrorTPDownSetVisual(mirrorTPDownEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatAutoSwingSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndTPBatAutoSwingSetVisual(tpBatAutoSwingEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatCameraLockSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndTPBatCameraLockSetVisual(_G._Bl1ndGetTPBatCameraLock and _G._Bl1ndGetTPBatCameraLock() or false) end
    -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS: allinea lo slider al valore caricato <<<
    _G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion) or 1, 1, 5)
    if _G._Bl1ndTPBatSetVersionVisual then _G._Bl1ndTPBatSetVersionVisual(_G.Bl1ndTPBatVersion) end
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatSetVisual then _G.Bl1ndTPBatSetVisual(_G.Bl1ndTPBatOn == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndTPBatOn and _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat()
    elseif _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
      if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStop then _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStop() end
      if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On and _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Start then
        _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Start()
      elseif _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop then
        _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop()
      end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop then _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop() end
      if _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn and _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStart then
        _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStart()
      elseif _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStop then
        _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStop()
      end
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setBatCounterVisual then setBatCounterVisual(batCounterEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector() end
    if setMedCounterVisual then setMedCounterVisual(medCounterEnabled) end
    if _SV.setSafeModeVisual then _SV.setSafeModeVisual(antiKickEnabled) end
    if batCounterEnabled then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter() end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounter() end
    end
    if medCounterEnabled then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter(LP.Character) end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter() end
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetNoPlayerCollisionVisual then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetNoPlayerCollisionVisual(_G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled) end
    if _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled then
      if enableNoPlayerCollision then enableNoPlayerCollision() end
    else
      if disableNoPlayerCollision then disableNoPlayerCollision() end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setPlayerESPVisual then _SV.setPlayerESPVisual(espEnabled) end
    if espEnabled then if startPlayerESP then startPlayerESP() end; if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.box = true end else if stopPlayerESP then stopPlayerESP() end; if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.box = false end end
    if _SV.setTrackerESPVisual then _SV.setTrackerESPVisual(showTrackerEnabled) end
    if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.tracker = showTrackerEnabled end
    if refreshBoxedESP then refreshBoxedESP() end
    if _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual then _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual(ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
    -- Forza restart: stopRagdollCountdown + StopEnemy azzerano i flag-guard interni prima di riavviare
    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopEnemyRagdollCountdown then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopEnemyRagdollCountdown() end
      hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character)
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartEnemyRagdollCountdown then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartEnemyRagdollCountdown() end
    else
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopEnemyRagdollCountdown then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopEnemyRagdollCountdown() end
    end
    if _SV.setFPSBoostVisual then _SV.setFPSBoostVisual(fpsBoostEnabled) end
    if fpsBoostEnabled then enableStretchRez() else disableStretchRez() end
    if _SV.setAntiLagVisual then _SV.setAntiLagVisual(antiLagVisualEnabled) end
    if antiLagVisualEnabled then enableAntiLag() else disableAntiLag() end
    if _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual then _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual(vividGraphicsEnabled) end
    if vividGraphicsEnabled then enableVividGraphics() else disableVividGraphics() end
    if _SV.setXRayVisual then _SV.setXRayVisual(xrayEnabled) end
    if setXRay then pcall(setXRay, xrayEnabled) end
    if _SV.setHighPingWarningVisual then _SV.setHighPingWarningVisual(highPingWarningEnabled) end
    if _SV.setKickWarningVisual then _SV.setKickWarningVisual(_G._Bl1ndKickWarn.enabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshUAKVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshUAKVisual() end
    if _SV.setFOVVisual then _SV.setFOVVisual(fovEnabled) end
    if fovEnabled then enableCustomFov() else disableCustomFov() end
    if _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual then _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual(noCamCollisionEnabled) end
    if noCamCollisionEnabled then enableNoCamCollision() else disableNoCamCollision() end
    if type(applyCustomSky) == "function" then
      applyCustomSky((skyTheme and skyTheme ~= "") and skyTheme or "Off")
    end
    if skyValueLabel then skyValueLabel.Text = skyTheme or "Off" end
  end)
  pcall(saveBl1ndConfig)
end

task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.35)
  if type(applyCustomSky) == "function" then
    pcall(function() applyCustomSky((skyTheme and skyTheme ~= "") and skyTheme or "Off") end)
  end
  if skyValueLabel then skyValueLabel.Text = skyTheme or "Off" end
end)

task.defer(_G.Bl1ndDuelsForceSyncLoadedButtons)
task.delay(1, function()
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsForceSyncLoadedButtons then _G.Bl1ndDuelsForceSyncLoadedButtons() end
end)

task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.2)
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsyncToggleVisuals then _G.Bl1ndDuelsyncToggleVisuals() end
end)

customFontVisualEnabled = false
if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end

function enableCustomFont()
  customFontVisualEnabled = false
  if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end
end

function disableCustomFont()
  customFontVisualEnabled = false
  if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end
end

_G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates = function()
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled == true) end
    if autoTPEnabled then startAutoTP() else stopAutoTP() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setInfJumpVisual then setInfJumpVisual(infJumpEnabled == true) end
    if setInfJumpInternal then setInfJumpInternal(infJumpEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshInfJumpModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshInfJumpModeSelector() end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshTPDownMethodSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshTPDownMethodSelector() end   -- >>> TP DOWN METHOD <<<
    -- >>> CUSTOM FONTS <<< la GUI a questo punto esiste: si applica il
    -- font salvato e si agganciano i listener per quello che nascera' dopo.
    if _G.Bl1ndFonts then
      pcall(_G.Bl1ndFonts.applyAll)
      pcall(_G.Bl1ndFonts.hook)
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setLookAtVisual then _SV.setLookAtVisual(_G.Bl1ndLookAtEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadiusBox then _G.Bl1ndLookAtRadiusBox.Text = tostring(tonumber(_G.Bl1ndLookAtRadius) or 20) end
    if _G.Bl1ndLookAtEnabled then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartLookAt() end
    else
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelstopLookAt then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopLookAt() end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoCarrySpeedVisual then setAutoCarrySpeedVisual(autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAntiRagdollVisual then setAntiRagdollVisual(antiRagdollEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector() end
    if setAntiRagdoll then setAntiRagdoll(antiRagdollEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(_G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted == true) end
    setAntiDie(_G._Bl1ndAntiDieUserWanted == true)
    -- Un modulo poteva aver gia' armato l'Anti Die: setAntiDie(false)
    -- staccherebbe tutto senza che nessuno lo rimetta.
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync then _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync then _G.Bl1ndAutoStealSync() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setBatCounterVisual then setBatCounterVisual(batCounterEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector then _G.Bl1ndRefreshBatCounterModeSelector() end
    if batCounterEnabled and _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatCounter() elseif _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounter then _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatCounter() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setMedCounterVisual then setMedCounterVisual(medCounterEnabled == true) end
    if medCounterEnabled and _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstartMedCounter(LP.Character)
    elseif _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstopMedCounter()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetNoPlayerCollisionVisual then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetNoPlayerCollisionVisual(_G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndNoPlayerCollisionEnabled then enableNoPlayerCollision() else disableNoPlayerCollision() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(unwalkEnabled == true) end
    -- Forza il restart dal load: i guard interni di startUnwalk/stopUnwalk controllano
    -- la variabile unwalkEnabled, quindi temporaneamente la resettiamo per bypassarli.
    if unwalkEnabled then
      unwalkEnabled = false  -- adesso stopUnwalk passa il suo guard e pulisce il loop
      stopUnwalk()           -- pulisce unwalkLoopConnection residua
      -- unwalkEnabled è rimasto false dopo stopUnwalk (lo setta lui stesso)
      startUnwalk()          -- il guard "if unwalkEnabled then return end" non scatta → avvia il loop
    else
      unwalkEnabled = true   -- forza stopUnwalk a passare il suo guard e fare pulizia
      stopUnwalk()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setSafeModeVisual then _SV.setSafeModeVisual(antiKickEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setPlayerESPVisual then _SV.setPlayerESPVisual(espEnabled == true) end
    if espEnabled then if startPlayerESP then startPlayerESP() end else if stopPlayerESP then stopPlayerESP() end end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setTrackerESPVisual then _SV.setTrackerESPVisual(showTrackerEnabled == true) end
    if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.tracker = showTrackerEnabled == true end
    if refreshBoxedESP then refreshBoxedESP() end
    pcall(function()
      local gui = HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHub")
      if gui then
        for _, obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
          if obj.Name == "ColorPreview" and obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name == "Tracker Color" then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = (BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor) or Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual then _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual(ragdollCountdownEnabled == true) end
    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
      -- Forza il restart dal load: stopRagdollCountdown pulisce le connessioni residue,
      -- poi hookRagdollCountdown parte da zero senza guard che blocchino.
      -- Per il sistema enemy, StopEnemy azzera enemyRagdollConn (il flag-guard di StartEnemy).
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstopEnemyRagdollCountdown()
      hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character)
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstartEnemyRagdollCountdown()
    else
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      _G.Bl1ndDuelstopEnemyRagdollCountdown()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setFPSBoostVisual then _SV.setFPSBoostVisual(fpsBoostEnabled == true) end
    if fpsBoostEnabled then enableStretchRez() else disableStretchRez() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAntiLagVisual then _SV.setAntiLagVisual(antiLagVisualEnabled == true) end
    if antiLagVisualEnabled then enableAntiLag() else disableAntiLag() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual then _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual(vividGraphicsEnabled == true) end
    if vividGraphicsEnabled then enableVividGraphics() else disableVividGraphics() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setXRayVisual then _SV.setXRayVisual(xrayEnabled == true) end
    if setXRay then setXRay(xrayEnabled) end
    -- >>> BRAINROT X-RAY <<<
    if _SV.setBrainrotXRayVisual then _SV.setBrainrotXRayVisual(_G.Bl1ndBrainrotXRayEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsetBrainrotXRay then _G.Bl1ndDuelsetBrainrotXRay(_G.Bl1ndBrainrotXRayEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setFOVVisual then _SV.setFOVVisual(fovEnabled == true) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshFovValueBox then _G.Bl1ndRefreshFovValueBox() end   -- >>> FOV VALUE ARROW <<<
    if fovEnabled then enableCustomFov() else disableCustomFov() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual then _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual(noCamCollisionEnabled == true) end
    if noCamCollisionEnabled then enableNoCamCollision() else disableNoCamCollision() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setHeadlessVisual then _SV.setHeadlessVisual(headlessEnabled == true) end
    if headlessEnabled then enableHeadless() else disableHeadless() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setKorbloxVisual then _SV.setKorbloxVisual(korbloxEnabled == true) end
    if korbloxEnabled then enableKorblox() else disableKorblox() end
  end)

  -- >>> ANTI TP BAT BEGIN
  pcall(function()
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat.setSpam(_G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatSpam == true, true)
      _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat.setVersion(_G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatVersion or 1, true)
      _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat.setEnabled(_G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatEnabled == true, true)
    end
    if _G._Bl1ndAntiTPBatRefreshUI then _G._Bl1ndAntiTPBatRefreshUI() end
  end)
  -- <<< ANTI TP BAT END
  -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.Bl1ndAntiVoidEnabled == true
    if _SV.setAntiVoidVisual then _SV.setAntiVoidVisual(on) end
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid then _G.Bl1ndAntiVoid.setEnabled(on) end
  end)
  -- <<< ANTI VOID END
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.Bl1ndRainbowToolsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setRainbowToolsVisual then _SV.setRainbowToolsVisual(on) end
    if _G.Bl1ndRainbowTools then _G.Bl1ndRainbowTools.setEnabled(on) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.Bl1ndTransparentToolsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setTransparentToolsVisual then _SV.setTransparentToolsVisual(on) end
    if _G.Bl1ndTransparentTools then _G.Bl1ndTransparentTools.setEnabled(on) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.Bl1ndCustomToolsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setCustomToolsVisual then _SV.setCustomToolsVisual(on) end
    if _G.Bl1ndCustomTools then _G.Bl1ndCustomTools.setEnabled(on) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.Bl1ndCustomSoundsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setCustomSoundsVisual then _SV.setCustomSoundsVisual(on) end
    if _G.Bl1ndCustomSounds then _G.Bl1ndCustomSounds.setEnabled(on) end
  end)

  pcall(function()
    if type(applyCustomSky) == "function" then applyCustomSky((skyTheme and skyTheme ~= "") and skyTheme or "Off") end
    if skyValueLabel then skyValueLabel.Text = skyTheme or "Off" end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if selectedAnimPackIndex and selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 and _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAnimPack then
      _G.Bl1ndDuelsetAnimPack(selectedAnimPackIndex)
    end
    if setAnimPackVisual then setAnimPackVisual(selectedAnimPackIndex or 1) end
    -- >>> VISIBILE SOLO CON CUSTOM <<< allineamento dopo il load config
    if _G.Bl1ndCustomAnimSetRowVisible then
      _G.Bl1ndCustomAnimSetRowVisible((selectedAnimPackIndex or 1) == 7, false)
    end
  end)
end

task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.25)
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates then _G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates() end
end)

task.delay(1.25, function()
  if _G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates then _G.Bl1ndDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates() end
end)

task.delay(3, function()
  if antiLagVisualEnabled and type(applyKTMOptimization) == "function" then pcall(applyKTMOptimization) end
end)

_G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreWanted = _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreWanted or false
_G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil or 0

function Bl1ndAnyAimbotActive()
  return (_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true) or (_G.Bl1ndTPBatOn == true)
end

_G.Bl1ndDuelstopAutoTPForAction = function()
  if autoTPEnabled then
    _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreWanted = true
    _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.35
    stopAutoTP()
    if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(false) end
  end
end

function Bl1ndTryRestoreAutoTP()
  if not _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreWanted then return end
  if tick() < (_G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil or 0) then return end
  if Bl1ndAnyAimbotActive() then return end
  if dropBrainrotActive then return end
  _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreWanted = false
  startAutoTP()
  if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(true) end
  saveBl1ndConfig()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(Bl1ndTryRestoreAutoTP)

_G._oldBl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot
_G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot = function(...)
  local r = {_G._oldBl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot(...)}
  _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
  task.delay(0.08, Bl1ndTryRestoreAutoTP)
  return unpack(r)
end
_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStop = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot

_G._oldBl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2
_G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2 = function(...)
  local r = {_G._oldBl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2(...)}
  _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
  task.delay(0.08, Bl1ndTryRestoreAutoTP)
  return unpack(r)
end
_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2

-- >>> ANTI DIE AUTO BEGIN
-- Wrapper sui punti che accendono/spengono i moduli: qui le funzioni
-- esistono gia' tutte, quindi si possono avvolgere in blocco.
do
  -- L'armamento dell'Anti Die NON sta piu' qui: e' la prima riga dentro le
  -- funzioni di avvio stesse, cosi' vale per qualunque chiamante e anche
  -- prima che questi wrapper esistano. Qui resta solo la sync a valle, che
  -- tiene i conti (chi l'ha acceso) e si occupa dello spegnimento.
  local function wrap(name)
    local old = _G[name]
    if type(old) ~= "function" then return end
    _G[name] = function(...)
      local r = {old(...)}
      if _G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync then pcall(_G.Bl1ndAntiDieAutoSync) end
      return unpack(r)
    end
  end
  wrap("Bl1ndDuelstartTPBat")
  wrap("Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat")
  wrap("Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot")
  wrap("Bl1ndDuelstopNormalAimbot")
  wrap("Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2")
  wrap("Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2")

  -- Gli alias erano stati presi PRIMA di questo punto, quindi puntavano
  -- ancora alle funzioni originali e chi li usava (il ripristino dello
  -- stato dal config) scavalcava sia l'armamento sia la sync. Si
  -- ripuntano alle versioni avvolte.
  _G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotStart = _G.Bl1ndDuelstartNormalAimbot
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Start  = _G.Bl1ndDuelstartBatAimbotV2
  _G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2Stop   = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopBatAimbotV2
end
-- <<< ANTI DIE AUTO END

_G._oldBl1ndDuelstopTPBat = _G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat
_G.Bl1ndDuelstopTPBat = function(...)
  local r = {_G._oldBl1ndDuelstopTPBat(...)}
  _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
  task.delay(0.08, Bl1ndTryRestoreAutoTP)
  return unpack(r)
end

task.spawn(function()
  local wasDropping = false
  while task.wait(0.05) do
    if dropBrainrotActive then
      wasDropping = true
    elseif wasDropping then
      wasDropping = false
      _G.Bl1ndAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
      task.delay(0.08, Bl1ndTryRestoreAutoTP)
    end
  end
end)

function Bl1ndRepairKeybinds()
  for keyId, defaultKey in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    if speedKeybinds[keyId] == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      speedKeybinds[keyId] = defaultKey
    end
  end
  if tpDownKeybind == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then tpDownKeybind = DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND end
  if refreshAllSpeedKeybinds then refreshAllSpeedKeybinds() end
  if refreshTPDownKeybind then refreshTPDownKeybind() end
end

_G._oldSaveBl1ndConfigStable = saveBl1ndConfig
saveBl1ndConfig = function()
  Bl1ndRepairKeybinds()
  return _G._oldSaveBl1ndConfigStable()
end

Bl1ndRepairKeybinds()
task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.2)
  Bl1ndRepairKeybinds()
  saveBl1ndConfig()
end)

-- ============================================================
-- MOBILE BUTTONS
-- ============================================================
task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.35)
  local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
  local old = HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubMobileButtons")
  if old then old:Destroy() end
  -- copia rimasta in PlayerGui da una versione precedente dello script
  old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubMobileButtons")
  if old then old:Destroy() end

  local mobileGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
  mobileGui.Name = "Bl1ndHubMobileButtons"
  mobileGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
  mobileGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
  mobileGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
  mobileGui.DisplayOrder = 1000
  mobileGui.Parent = HubGui

  _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonRefs = {}
  local mobileButtons = _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonRefs

  -- >>> HIDE PER SINGOLO BOTTONE <<<
  -- Prima si spegneva l'intera ScreenGui. Ora la GUI resta accesa e si
  -- nasconde bottone per bottone, cosi' si possono fare eccezioni: nella
  -- lista un bottone spento resta visibile anche col toggle acceso.
  -- La lista e l'helper Bl1ndMobileHideIncluded sono definiti in cima
  -- al file, perche' la UI li usa prima che questo blocco esista.
  function _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonsHidden()
    local g = HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHubMobileButtons")
    if g then g.Enabled = true end
    local hideAll = (_G.Bl1ndHideMobileButtons == true)
    for key, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
      local holder = entry and entry.holder
      if holder then
        holder.Visible = not (hideAll and _G.Bl1ndMobileHideIncluded(key))
      end
    end
    if setHideMobileButtonsVisual then pcall(setHideMobileButtonsVisual, hideAll) end
  end

  function _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonSize()
    _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale) or 0.75, 0.30, 1.35)
    for _, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
      local holder = entry and entry.holder
      if holder then
        local sc = holder:FindFirstChild("MobileButtonScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
        sc.Name = "MobileButtonScale"
        sc.Scale = _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale
        sc.Parent = holder
      end
    end
    pcall(function()
      local gui = HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHub") or HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHub") or HubGui:FindFirstChild("Bl1ndHub")
      local root = gui or HubGui
      for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "Mobile Buttons Size" then
          local valueBox = obj:FindFirstChild("Value")
          if valueBox and valueBox:IsA("TextLabel") then
            valueBox.Text = string.format("%.2f", _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  local function setActive(btn, state)
    if not btn then return end
    local pressed = btn:GetAttribute("Bl1ndMobilePressed") == true
    state = (state == true) or pressed
    local visualState = state and "on" or "off"
    if btn:GetAttribute("Bl1ndMobileVisualState") == visualState then return end
    btn:SetAttribute("Bl1ndMobileVisualState", visualState)
    local holder = btn.Parent
    local glow = holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Glow")
    local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
      BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(238,238,238) or Color3.fromRGB(8,8,8),
      TextColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0) or COLORS.silver,
      TextTransparency = 0,
    }):Play()
    if st then
      TS:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
        Color = state and Color3.fromRGB(190,190,190) or Color3.fromRGB(85,85,85),
        Thickness = 1,
        Transparency = state and 0 or 0.4,
      }):Play()
    end
    if glow then
      glow.Visible = false
      glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      local gs = glow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if gs then gs.Transparency = 1 end
    end
  end

  local function pulse(btn)
    if not btn then return end
    btn:SetAttribute("Bl1ndMobilePressed", true)
    setActive(btn, true)
    task.delay(0.18, function()
      if btn and btn.Parent then
        btn:SetAttribute("Bl1ndMobilePressed", false)
        setActive(btn, false)
      end
    end)
  end

local function makeButton(key, label, pos, onPress)
    -- Contenitore
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name = "MBH_" .. key
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 58)

    local savedPos = _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonPositions and _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonPositions[key]
    if savedPos and type(savedPos) == "table" then
        holder.Position = tableToUDim2(savedPos, pos)
    else
        holder.Position = pos
    end

    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    holder.ZIndex = 1000
    holder.Active = true
    holder.Parent = mobileGui

    -- Pulsante principale
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", holder)
    btn.Name = "MB_" .. key
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset
    btn.Text = label
    btn.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    btn.TextSize = 10
    btn.TextWrapped = true
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.ZIndex = 1002
    btn.Active = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    -- Gradiente testo OFF - silver/white like logo
    local txtGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btn)
    txtGrad.Name = "_Bl1ndDuelshimmerGradient"
    txtGrad.Rotation = 90
    txtGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
    txtGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175)),
    })

    -- Gradiente sfondo ON - bright silver
    local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btn)
    bgGrad.Name = "BgGradient"
    bgGrad.Rotation = 90
    bgGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
    bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 195)),
    })
    bgGrad.Enabled = false

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    stroke.Name = "BtnStroke"
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.2
    stroke.Transparency = 0.55
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local glow = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 1, 6)
    glow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -3, 0, -3)
    glow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
    glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    glow.ZIndex = 1000
    Instance.new("UICorner", glow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)

    local function updateButton(state)
        if state then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10)
            txtGrad.Enabled = false
            bgGrad.Enabled = true
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            stroke.Transparency = 0.15
            stroke.Thickness = 1.6
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            btn.TextColor3 = COLORS.silver
            txtGrad.Enabled = true
            bgGrad.Enabled = false
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
            stroke.Transparency = 0.55
            stroke.Thickness = 1.2
        end
    end

    -- Funzione per ottenere lo stato logico
    local function getLogicalState()
        if key == "autoPlay" then
            return _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay and _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay.active() or false
        elseif key == "aimbot" then
            return (_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true)
        elseif key == "tpBat" then
            return _G.Bl1ndTPBatMobileActive and _G.Bl1ndTPBatMobileActive() or false
        elseif key == "antiTPBat" then
            return _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatEnabled == true
        elseif key == "carry" then
            return currentSpeedMode == "Carry"
        elseif key == "laggerNormal" then
            return currentSpeedMode == "Lagger"
        elseif key == "laggerCarry" then
            return currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry"
        else
            return false
        end
    end

    -- Gestione input
    local pressing = false
    local dragging = false
    local pressPos = nil
    local holderStart = nil

    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            pressing = true
            dragging = false
            pressPos = i.Position
            holderStart = holder.Position
            updateButton(true)
        end
    end)

    btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if pressing and not dragging then
                pcall(onPress)
            end

            if dragging then
                if _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonPositions then
                    _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonPositions[key] = udim2ToTable(holder.Position)
                end
                pcall(saveBl1ndConfig)
            end

            pressing = false
            dragging = false

            task.delay(0.02, function()
                if btn and btn.Parent then
                    updateButton(getLogicalState())
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if _G.Bl1ndGuiLocked == true or _G.Bl1ndMobileLocked == true or not pressing then return end
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local delta = i.Position - pressPos
        if not dragging and (math.abs(delta.X) > 6 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 6) then
            dragging = true
        end
        if dragging then
            holder.Position = UDim2.new(
                holderStart.X.Scale,
                holderStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                holderStart.Y.Scale,
                holderStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    mobileButtons[key] = {
        holder = holder,
        btn = btn,
        setActive = function(state) updateButton(state) end
    }

    -- Stato di visibilita' subito coerente col toggle e con la lista
    if _G.Bl1ndMobileHideIncluded then
        holder.Visible = not ((_G.Bl1ndHideMobileButtons == true)
                              and _G.Bl1ndMobileHideIncluded(key))
    end

    updateButton(getLogicalState())

    return btn
end

  local x1, x2, x3 = -218, -154, -90
  local y1, y2, y3, y4 = -150, -102, -54, -6
local defaults = {
    drop         = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y1),
    autoPlay     = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y1),
    tpBat   = UDim2.new(1, x1, 0.5, y1),
    aimbot       = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y2),
    instantReset = UDim2.new(1, x1, 0.5, y2),
    antiTPBat    = UDim2.new(1, x1, 0.5, y3),
    -- Float sta nella casella sotto Auto Play, quella lasciata libera da
    -- Auto Right quando i due bottoni sono diventati uno solo.
    float        = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y2),
    tp           = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y3),
    carry        = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y3),
    laggerNormal = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y4),
    laggerCarry  = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y4),
}
  function _G.Bl1ndResetMobileButtons()
    _G.Bl1ndMobileButtonScale = 0.75
    _G.Bl1ndHideMobileButtons = false
    -- >>> HIDE PER BOTTONE <<< si torna a "tutti inclusi"
    _G.Bl1ndMobileHideList = {}
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileHideList then pcall(_G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileHideList) end
    for key, defaultPos in pairs(defaults) do
      local entry = mobileButtons[key]
      local holder = entry and entry.holder
      if holder then
        holder.Position = defaultPos
        holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 58)
        local btn = entry.btn
        if btn then
          btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
          btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
          btn:SetAttribute("Bl1ndMobilePressed", false)
          btn:SetAttribute("Bl1ndMobileVisualState", nil)
        end
      end
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonSize then _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonSize() end
    if _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonsHidden then _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonsHidden() end
    if showActionNotification then pcall(function() showActionNotification("MOBILE BUTTONS RESET") end) end
    saveBl1ndConfig()
  end

  makeButton("drop", "DROP\nBR", defaults.drop, function(btn)
    if selectedDropMode == "Stand Still" then
      if runDropStandStill then runDropStandStill() end
    else
      if runDropBrainrot then runDropBrainrot() elseif runDrop then runDrop() end
    end
    pulse(btn)
  end)

  makeButton("autoPlay", "AUTO\nPLAY", defaults.autoPlay, function(btn)
    if _G.Bl1ndAutoPlayToggle then _G.Bl1ndAutoPlayToggle() end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      -- Non basta guardare "in ascolto": a lato gia' rilevato il bottone
      -- rappresenta la direzione accesa, e quella e' un'altra cosa.
      setActive(btn, _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay and _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay.active() or false)
    end)
  end)

  makeButton("tpBat", "TP\nBAT", defaults.tpBat, function(btn)
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked() then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop then _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
      return
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBatManual then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBatManual()
    elseif _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleTPBat()
    end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      setActive(btn, _G.Bl1ndTPBatMobileActive and _G.Bl1ndTPBatMobileActive() or false)
    end)
  end)

  local function _getAimbotMobileLabel()
    if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then return "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV2" end
    return "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV1"
  end

  makeButton("aimbot", _getAimbotMobileLabel(), defaults.aimbot, function(btn)
    if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked and _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeIsLocked() then
      if _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop then _G.Bl1ndDuelsafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
      return
    end
    if _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot then _G.Bl1ndToggleSelectedAimbot() end
    if _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.Bl1ndRefreshAimbotVisual() end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      setActive(btn, (_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true))
    end)
  end)

  makeButton("instantReset", "INSTANT\nRESET", defaults.instantReset, function(btn)
    if _G.Bl1ndInstantReset then _G.Bl1ndInstantReset() end
    pulse(btn)
  end)

  makeButton("antiTPBat", "ANTI\nTP BAT", defaults.antiTPBat, function(btn)
    if _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBat.toggle()
    elseif _G.Bl1ndToggleAntiTPBat then
      _G.Bl1ndToggleAntiTPBat()
    end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      setActive(btn, _G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatEnabled == true)
    end)
  end)

  makeButton("float", "FLOAT", defaults.float, function(btn)
    if _G.Bl1ndFloatToggle then _G.Bl1ndFloatToggle() end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      setActive(btn, _G.Bl1ndFloatOn == true)
    end)
  end)

  makeButton("tp", "TP\nDOWN", defaults.tp, function(btn)
    if runTPFloor then runTPFloor() end
    pulse(btn)
  end)

  makeButton("carry", "CARRY\nSPEED", defaults.carry, function(btn)
    if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Carry" and "Normal" or "Carry") end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      if mobileButtons.carry then mobileButtons.carry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Carry") end
      if mobileButtons.laggerNormal then mobileButtons.laggerNormal.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger") end
      if mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") end
    end)
  end)

  makeButton("laggerNormal", "LAGGER\nNORMAL", defaults.laggerNormal, function(btn)
    if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" and "Normal" or "Lagger") end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      if mobileButtons.carry then mobileButtons.carry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Carry") end
      if mobileButtons.laggerNormal then mobileButtons.laggerNormal.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger") end
      if mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") end
    end)
  end)

  makeButton("laggerCarry", "LAGGER\nCARRY", defaults.laggerCarry, function(btn)
    if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" and "Normal" or "Lagger Carry") end
    task.delay(0.03, function()
      if mobileButtons.carry then mobileButtons.carry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Carry") end
      if mobileButtons.laggerNormal then mobileButtons.laggerNormal.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger") end
      if mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") end
    end)
  end)


  _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonSize()
  _G.Bl1ndApplyMobileButtonsHidden()

  -- Nessun Heartbeat: i bottoni vengono aggiornati event-driven
  -- tramite _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates() chiamata
  -- nelle funzioni che cambiano effettivamente lo stato.
  function _G.Bl1ndRefreshMobileButtonStates()
    if mobileButtons.autoPlay then
      mobileButtons.autoPlay.setActive(_G.Bl1ndAutoPlay and _G.Bl1ndAutoPlay.active() or false)
    end
    if mobileButtons.aimbot then
      mobileButtons.aimbot.setActive((_G.Bl1ndNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.Bl1ndBatAimbotV2On == true))
      -- Aggiorna il testo in base alla versione selezionata
      local aimbotMobileBtn = mobileButtons.aimbot.btn
      if aimbotMobileBtn then
        aimbotMobileBtn.Text = (selectedAimbotMode == "V2") and "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV2" or "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV1"
      end
      -- e la stessa versione nella lista Hide Mobile Buttons
      if _G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot then pcall(_G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot) end
    end
    if mobileButtons.float then
      mobileButtons.float.setActive(_G.Bl1ndFloatOn == true)
    end
    if mobileButtons.tpBat then
      mobileButtons.tpBat.setActive(_G.Bl1ndTPBatMobileActive and _G.Bl1ndTPBatMobileActive() or false)
    end
    if mobileButtons.antiTPBat then
      mobileButtons.antiTPBat.setActive(_G.Bl1ndAntiTPBatEnabled == true)
    end
    if mobileButtons.carry then mobileButtons.carry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Carry") end
    if mobileButtons.laggerNormal then mobileButtons.laggerNormal.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger") end
    if mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") end
  end
end)

local _oldLoadBl1ndConfig = loadBl1ndConfig
loadBl1ndConfig = function()
    _oldLoadBl1ndConfig()
    -- Applica lo stato di Stretch Rez dopo il caricamento
    if _G.StretchRez and _G.StretchRez.apply then
        local idx = stretchCurrentIndex or 1
        _G.StretchRez.apply(idx)
    end
end

-- >>> FORCE SILVER TEXT (keeps all hub writing silver at all times)
task.spawn(function()
  local SILVER = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 198)
  local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
  local plrGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
  local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
  local function isText(o)
    return o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")
  end
  local function paint(o)
    if not isText(o) then return end
    for _, c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
      if c:IsA("UIGradient") then c.Enabled = false end
    end
    if o.TextColor3 ~= SILVER then o.TextColor3 = SILVER end
    if not hooked[o] then
      hooked[o] = true
      o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(function()
        if o.TextColor3 ~= SILVER then o.TextColor3 = SILVER end
      end)
      o.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if c:IsA("UIGradient") then task.defer(function() c.Enabled = false end) end
      end)
    end
  end
  local function hookGui(g)
    if not g:IsA("ScreenGui") or not tostring(g.Name):find("Bl1nd") then return end
    if hooked[g] then return end
    hooked[g] = true
    for _, d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do paint(d) end
    g.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) task.defer(paint, d) end)
  end
  local roots = { plrGui }
  pcall(function() table.insert(roots, CoreGui) end)
  pcall(function() if gethui then table.insert(roots, gethui()) end end)
  for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
    pcall(function()
      for _, g in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do hookGui(g) end
      r.ChildAdded:Connect(function(g) task.defer(hookGui, g) end)
    end)
  end
  while task.wait(1) do
    for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
      pcall(function() for _, g in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do hookGui(g) end end)
    end
  end
end)
-- <<< FORCE SILVER TEXT END
